As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking an elite Product Sales Specialist to champion our Storage & Analysis product lines, the newest, most technically differentiated products in Cribl’s portfolio. Elite here means something specific: you don’t need a playbook handed to you, you write it. A successful Product Sales Specialist at Cribl thrives in white space, creating demand where none exists, developing messaging from first principles, and earning credibility with technical practitioners and executive buyers alike. You will own the full motion from pipeline creation through close, partner closely with Regional Sales Managers to drive deals forward, and provide the product and go-to-market insights that shape how we take these products to market. This role is ideal for elite overlay sellers, top-performing Solutions Engineers ready to make the leap into a sales role, or early-stage sellers who have built motions from scratch and want to do it again at a company defining a category.

If you're ready to join a team that's redefining what it means to be a true Data Engine for IT and Security, this is your moment. This position will be our first team member in EMEA and needs to be based in either the UK, Germany, Spain, or the Netherlands.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Develop a business plan to exceed sales goals alongside the CEO and cross-functional partners including dedicated Storage & Analysis Solution Engineers
  • Engage with Regional Sales Managers on qualified opportunities, actively collaborating with them on account, close, and success plans
  • Work cross-functionally to develop and implement tactics and strategies to grow Cribl’s Storage & Analysis business, including influencing the product roadmap to meet customer requirements
  • Manage and maintain the entire sales ecosystem from generating leads through closing
  • Help customers understand the value of Cribl’s Storage & Analysis products during the sales process
  • Articulate our value proposition up and down the organization, from engineer up to CxO

  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 5+ years of Enterprise/Strategic sales or pre-sales experience in Security (SIEM & Observability) or IT infrastructure, including direct sellers, overlay specialists, or Solutions Engineers ready to transition into a closing role
  • Experience working with at least one earlier stage start-up organization <1,000 employees or has demonstrated entrepreneurial skills throughout their career
  • A demonstrated ability to successfully land large upsell & cross-sell / expansion deals and run complex sales process
  • Experience selling through a channel-led motion
  • Comfortable operating without a playbook. You’ve built pipeline and messaging in greenfield territory and know how to create demand for un-budgeted, emerging solutions
  • Background using MEDDIC

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.title: Remote Clinical Therapist - AZ
jobs.excerpt: About WellQor: WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online.
jobs.description:
About WellQor:
WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online. We're a new model in care that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches.

Unlike other online providers, our clinical therapists are one member of a team, collaborating with peers and a Clinical Director who is responsible for developing and guiding their team, all in pursuit of achieving the best possible outcome for you and your client. We’re not a directory service, we’re a full service psychology practice. Our clinicians enjoy the full support of a treatment team, and our patients benefit from the full attention of a robust clinical organization.

Our practice is growing rapidly, and we owe our success to a team-oriented culture that puts people first. As a new provider, expect to feel loved, appreciated, and supported in a way that’s truly unique to WellQor.

Your Role as a Remote Clinical Therapist:

At WellQor, you’ll help your clients overcome mental health challenges, forge better relationships, and be the best versions of themselves. You’ll make a real, tangible difference in the lives of others, and feel good about the way you bring joy to the lives of others.

And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback to help advance you in your career.

You will define your own availability, make your own schedules, and work according to your lifestyle. Some WellQor therapists work part time, and others carry full caseloads. Whatever your lifestyle demands, we’re here to meet you where you’re at.

Why WellQor?
  • You’ll develop long-term relationships with patients via teletherapy.
  • Have access to the full support and camaraderie of a clinical team.
  • Select how much and when you work.
  • Connect with therapists across the country using our Clinician Connect platform.
  • Receive credentialing, billing, and administrative services so you can do what you do best, therapy!
  • Opportunities to expand experience through CEU sponsorship.
Join the WellQor Family and let us build a caseload for you that fits your lifestyle.
Title: WellQor Clinical Therapist

Reports to: Clinical Director / Lead Psychologist

Requirements:
  • LPCC, LMFT, LMHC, LCSW, LICSW, PsyD or equivalent licensed to practice independently.
  • Empanelment / Participation with commercial insurance plans helpful but not required
  • Strong computer skills and comfort using mobile devices and electronic medical records systems for patient charting and communication
Responsibilities:
  • Conduct regular teletherapy sessions with clients.
  • Typical issues that your patients may face include:
    • Adjustment issues, anxiety, depression, personality disorders, grief, behavioral issues PTSD, substance abuse.
  • Enter and maintain appropriate documentation in WellQor’s, easy to use web based EHR system according to company guidelines.
  • Utilize our unique WellQor Clinician Connect™ platform to share ideas with and obtain support from other WellQor clinicians and leadership nationwide.
Compensation:

WellQor Telehealth Therapists are paid by the billable hour and have the flexibility to take on the caseload that they’re interested in carrying at any given time. Hourly compensation varies based on licensure level, relevant experience, and caseload requirements.

Course Mentor, Part-Time

About Kaplan University Partners

Kaplan University Partners provides pre-college students with exceptional, career-minded enrichment/certificate programs taught online by world-class experts.

Students will receive guidance from mentors who will provide encouragement and direction on assignments, inspire and motivate students to succeed and offer brainstorming and ideation help as students prepare for their final project. Kaplan University Partners (KUP) is seeking part-time Medicine mentors to precollege students enrolled in online programs. Course mentors will engage and support students throughout the course.   • Experience working with adolescents/teens ages 13-17 from diverse geographical and socio-economic backgrounds
  • Passion for helping others achieve their goals with an emphasis on delighting and engaging students
  • Ability to work in the absence of direct supervisory relationships
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and work in digital communications platforms such as email, Zoom, Google Hangouts or Canvas

Responsible for providing leadership, governance, industry expertise and best practices to our clients, client projects and the teams dedicated to serving them. Responsible for staff management and directing and managing services for client projects to assure high quality, on-time, and on-budget services while promoting excellent customer service.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we are transforming lives by unlocking better evidence. As a Clinical Project Manager, you will lead the successful delivery of clinical research projects, partnering with sponsors, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure studies are executed efficiently, compliantly, and with exceptional quality. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on clinical development programs while contributing to innovative solutions that help bring therapies to patients faster.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Provide leadership and oversight for global clinical study management and project delivery, ensuring projects remain on schedule, within budget, and aligned with contractual obligations.
  • Evaluate study progress, resource allocation, and team workload, implementing adjustments and mitigation strategies as needed.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks across assigned programs and studies.
  • Manage escalations and resolve operational, client, and project challenges while maintaining issue tracking and documentation.
  • Support Clinical Project Managers in client communications regarding study status, risks, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful project execution and study completion.
  • Coordinate and facilitate routine status meetings to monitor study progress, resource utilization, and key project milestones.
  • Serve as Project Manager for assigned studies when required, including oversight of start-up, execution, and closeout activities for complex, high-profile customer programs.
  • Guide study teams to maintain consistency across Therapeutic Areas and programs, promoting operational efficiency and alignment with customer objectives.
  • Partner with senior leadership to prioritize deliverables, address resource needs, and communicate critical project updates.
  • Influence strategic decision-making and drive operational excellence through continuous process improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, tools, procedures, and service delivery within therapeutic or imaging teams.
  • Lead departmental initiatives, including planning, execution, communication, training, and progress reporting.
  • Serve as a Therapeutic Area and/or Imaging Lead for operational readiness and implementation of new processes and procedures.
  • Monitor operational challenges and recommend solutions to improve study delivery, quality, and efficiency.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop Project Management team members through performance management, career development, and ongoing feedback.
  • Support onboarding and training of new team members while ensuring compliance with required training completion and documentation.
  • Manage team assignments and workload distribution to encourage growth, accountability, and high performance.
  • Establish, maintain, and enforce departmental standards, SOP compliance, and study management best practices.
  • Review and update procedures related to project management and therapeutic team operations to ensure quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Perform additional duties, assignments, and special projects as required.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related discipline required; Master's degree preferred.
  • 5-10 years of clinical research experience within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related clinical development environment, including significant project management responsibility.
  • Previous people management and leadership experience within clinical development, clinical operations, or clinical trial management.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, project management methodologies, and drug development practices.
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines, and FDA regulations.
  • Experience supporting global clinical studies and leading cross-functional, geographically dispersed teams.
  • Medical Imaging experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively communicate in English with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project management tools.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt effectively to changing business needs.
  • Valid passport and ability to travel up to 20% as needed.


At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Position Summary


RTS is seeking an organized, proactive, and results-driven Project Manager to lead projects from planning through successful completion. The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating project activities, managing timelines and deliverables, engaging stakeholders, identifying and resolving risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and in alignment with business objectives.

This role requires strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead projects from initiation through planning, execution, monitoring, and completion.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Define project scope, objectives, requirements, roles, and responsibilities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and ensure project activities remain aligned with established goals and timelines.
  • Facilitate project meetings, document decisions, and track action items through completion.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and potential delays.
  • Develop mitigation plans and escalate critical issues when appropriate.
  • Provide regular project status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and maintain clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Track project performance against established milestones, KPIs, and success criteria.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk and issue logs, and decision records.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project management processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Support change management and implementation activities to promote successful adoption of project outcomes.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining attention to detail and quality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3–5+ years of project management, program management, operations, or related experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience developing project plans, status reports, executive updates, and project documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common project management and collaboration tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a cross-functional or matrixed organization.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Experience with project management platforms such as Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday.com, or Microsoft Project.
  • PMP, CAPM, Scrum, or other relevant project management certification is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Project Planning & Execution
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Communication
  • Risk & Issue Management
  • Organization & Prioritization
  • Problem Solving
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Change Management
  • Process Improvement
  • Accountability & Results Orientation

jobs.excerpt: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is a high-growth SaaS observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, enabling businesses to troubleshoot modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the Snowflake platform. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.

We’re looking for an Implementation Engineer to help enterprise customers successfully deploy, configure, and operationalize Observe.

This is a hands-on, post-sales technical role focused on delivering strong first outcomes, accelerating time-to-value, and establishing a solid foundation for long-term customer success. Implementation Engineers are deeply technical, customer-facing practitioners who work closely with customer platform, SRE, DevOps, and application teams during onboarding and early adoption.

In this role, you’ll translate existing observability architectures (including OpenTelemetry-based pipelines, Splunk, ELK, and other monitoring solutions) into scalable, production-ready implementations on Observe—using best practices while balancing speed, quality, and customer enablement.

Implementation Engineers focus on initial deployments and time-to-value. They set the technical foundation and tone for the customer relationship by ensuring early success, sound architecture, and a clear path forward. Once customers are live and operational, Observability Engineers and Architects build on this foundation—driving deeper adoption, new use cases, and long-term value.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead structured implementations for enterprise customers, from kickoff through initial production readiness

  • Design and configure telemetry ingestion pipelines across logs, metrics, and traces, including parsing, enrichment, normalization, and routing

  • Work hands-on with OpenTelemetry instrumentation and collectors, helping customers adopt modern, vendor-neutral observability standards

  • Migrate and modernize existing observability environments (e.g., Splunk, ELK, cloud-native monitoring tools) into Observe

  • Configure datasets, dashboards, alerts, and core observability assets aligned to customer use cases

  • Establish implementation plans, milestones, and success criteria in partnership with customers

  • Deliver practical, hands-on guidance that enables customers to become self-sufficient on the platform

  • Identify technical risks, data quality issues, or architectural gaps early and proactively address them

  • Capture implementation patterns, best practices, and reusable assets to improve consistency and scalability across the team

  • Collaborate closely with Observability Engineers, Architects, Support, Product, and Engineering to ensure smooth transitions and ongoing success

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as implementation engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant, or SRE

  • Strong hands-on experience with observability platforms and telemetry pipelines

  • Practical experience with OpenTelemetry (instrumentation, collectors, exporters, pipelines)

  • Experience working with one or more commercial or open-source observability solutions (e.g., Splunk, ELK/Elastic, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, Grafana)

  • Solid understanding of logs, metrics, and traces, including data modeling and tradeoffs at scale

  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern application architectures

  • Ability to work directly with technical customer teams and communicate clearly at multiple levels

  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working through ambiguity in fast-moving environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience migrating customers from Splunk or ELK to modern observability platforms

  • Background in SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering roles

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and cloud-native tooling

  • Experience creating implementation templates, runbooks, or enablement content

  • Exposure to multiple observability vendors or hybrid observability environments

This role is ideal for a technically strong practitioner who enjoys building real solutions with customers, delivering early wins, and helping shape repeatable, scalable post-sales practices.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information:

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $210,000.
  • Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

Job Title: Remote Industrial Automation Consultant

Hiring Company: The Hive Careers

Client: One of our leading FMCG manufacturing clients (based in the Caribbean)
Location: Remote (Site visits may be required)
Employment Type: Contract / Project-Based

About the Client

Our client is a well-established and rapidly growing FMCG manufacturing company in the Caribbean region. With an ambition to scale operations through smart manufacturing, the company is undergoing a digital transformation and seeks to upgrade its plant through industrial automation and Industry 4.0 integration.

About the Role

The Hive Careers is seeking a highly skilled Industrial Automation Consultant to join our team on a remote contract basis and work with one of our FMCG clients. This role involves leading the assessment, design, and deployment of automation technologies to optimize manufacturing efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance product quality.

This is a remote-first role, but occasional on-site travel may be required during critical phases of implementation (travel expenses covered).

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct a remote audit of existing manufacturing systems and identify automation opportunities.
  • Design and propose automation workflows across production, refrigeration, packaging, and quality assurance.
  • Develop and guide deployment of PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems, coordinating with local teams.
  • Implement IoT-based predictive maintenance systems for equipment health monitoring.
  • Integrate AI-driven vision systems for automated quality control using smart cameras.
  • Enable ERP and MES system integration to create a unified, intelligent production environment.
  • Ensure food safety and compliance throughout the automation design and rollout.
  • Provide comprehensive documentation and remote training to client teams.
  • Offer ongoing virtual consultation, support, and system optimization.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, preferably in FMCG or food production.
  • Advanced knowledge of PLC programming (e.g., Siemens, Allen Bradley), and SCADA/HMI systems.
  • Experience with remote automation consulting, including supporting on-site teams.
  • Strong understanding of industrial IoT, sensor integration, and control system architecture.
  • Familiarity with food-grade automation and hygiene compliance standards.

Preferred Expertise

  • Experience automating dairy, ice cream, beverage, or frozen food production environments.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML-powered visual inspection systems.
  • Experience integrating with ERP and MES platforms for process visibility and control.
  • Familiarity with Industry 4.0 tools and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in remote settings.

Engagement Details

  • Duration: 36 months (extendable)
  • Working Style: Remote-first with possible short-term site visits
  • Timezone Flexibility: Caribbean (GMT-5) collaboration required

jobs.title: Senior Geospatial Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: RYZ Labs is seeking a Senior Geospatial Software Engineer to help build and evolve a platform that works with complex construction and location-based data.
jobs.description:
RYZ Labs is seeking a Senior Geospatial Software Engineer to help build and evolve a platform that works with complex construction and location-based data.
This role combines strong software engineering skills with practical experience handling maps, coordinates, geometry, and geospatial information. You will be involved in building the systems that transform information from construction documents into accurate, usable geographic data that can support real-world field operations.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain production systems while contributing to technical architecture and engineering decisions.
  • Build functionality around maps, geographic coordinates, spatial relationships, and geometric data.
  • Develop solutions that can extract, process, validate, and transform geometry from unstructured or semi-structured documents.
  • Work on functionality involving geographic measurements, distances, routing, asset locations, and other location-based calculations.
  • Translate real-world geographic information into reliable data that can be visualized, measured, and used in the field.
  • Handle imperfect data sources, including inconsistent formats, incomplete information, and ambiguous inputs.
  • Establish approaches that prioritize data accuracy and clearly identify cases where a reliable result cannot be produced.
  • Contribute to code reviews, engineering standards, testing, and continuous integration practices.
  • Help improve system reliability through monitoring, observability, and safe failure mechanisms.
  • Take increasing ownership of technical decisions and architectural areas as the product and engineering team grow.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of taking ownership of technical decisions and production systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Previous experience developing software involving GIS, mapping, coordinates, geometry, or other geospatial data.
  • Practical knowledge of one or more areas such as GeoJSON, KML, GIS platforms, routing, mapping systems, fleet tracking, logistics, agriculture, drones, or location-based applications.
  • Experience processing data that may be incomplete, inconsistent, noisy, or difficult to interpret.
  • Strong attention to accuracy, data integrity, and system correctness, particularly when software outputs impact real-world decisions.
  • Ability to reason about edge cases and design systems that behave safely when information is insufficient or uncertain.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote and distributed engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience or education related to civil engineering, surveying, construction, asphalt, or estimating.
  • Familiarity with construction concepts such as plans, alignments, stationing, quantities, and pay items.
  • Experience working with routing, logistics, hauling, or distance calculations.
  • Exposure to DOT bid packages or construction documentation.
  • Familiarity with construction estimating platforms such as Bluebeam, B2W, HeavyBid, or HardDollar.
  • Experience with 3D geospatial information, including terrain models, surface models, point clouds, or cut-and-fill calculations.
  • Experience with technologies such as Turf.js, proj4js, PostGIS, or similar spatial libraries and databases.

What You'll Own

As you grow into the role, you will take ownership of important areas of the platform, including:
  • Geospatial capabilities: how the product represents, processes, measures, and exports geographic information.
  • Map and geometry workflows: transforming information extracted from documents into accurate real-world coordinates and usable geometry.
  • Distance and routing functionality: supporting location-based calculations and hauling-related use cases.
  • Core engineering: production code, technical design, architecture, and key engineering decisions.
  • Reliability and quality: code reviews, testing, observability, monitoring, and engineering standards.
  • Data correctness: ensuring the platform can distinguish between reliable results and situations where available information is insufficient.

About RYZ Labs

RYZ Labs is a startup studio founded in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs with extensive experience across technology and consumer businesses. The company brings together talented professionals across the US and Latin America to build and scale technology companies.
Our teams are remote and distributed across the US and Latam, working with modern technologies to develop scalable, resilient products across different industries.
At RYZ Labs, you'll have the opportunity to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of meaningful projects, and collaborate with experienced professionals. You'll be exposed to challenging technical problems while continuing to develop your skills in a fast-moving startup environment.

Join Us in Redefining Care

At Advocate Health, we are committed to helping people live well by delivering exceptional care with compassion, innovation, and expertise. We are seeking an accomplished Associate Vice President, Benefits to lead the strategy, design, and performance of our enterprise medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, and clinical well-being programs.

As a key member of our Total Rewards leadership team, you will shape benefit strategies that support the health and well-being of our teammates and their families. You will bring together clinical, financial, operational, and market insights to deliver competitive, sustainable programs across a large, complex organization.


About This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to influence the future of health benefits at an enterprise level. You will oversee a comprehensive portfolio of health and pharmacy programs, guide population health and clinical strategies, and manage critical partnerships with health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, third-party administrators, and specialty vendors.

You will also lead and develop a high-performing team while partnering with senior leaders to translate complex healthcare trends, financial considerations, and regulatory requirements into clear recommendations and thoughtful business decisions.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, ongoing management, and performance of medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, and clinical well-being programs.
  • Develop clinical program and care management strategies aligned with population health priorities.
  • Provide market expertise and strategic recommendations that shape the enterprise health benefits roadmap and broader Total Rewards strategy.
  • Monitor healthcare, pharmacy, regulatory, and clinical innovation trends and translate emerging developments into actionable recommendations.
  • Manage relationships and performance across medical, pharmacy, clinical, and point-solution vendors, including third-party administrators, carriers, pharmacy benefit managers, and specialty partners.
  • Establish clear service expectations and drive vendor accountability through data-informed performance reviews, service-level agreements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead requests for proposals, contract negotiations, implementations, and vendor transitions for health and pharmacy programs.
  • Oversee pharmacy strategy, including formulary management, rebate contracting, specialty pharmacy, clinical trend management, GLP-1 medications, and biosimilars.
  • Evaluate and integrate clinical programs, Centers of Excellence, care management services, and point solutions.
  • Ensure program compliance with applicable federal and state requirements, including ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, HITECH, COBRA, MHPAEA, the No Surprises Act, the Consolidated Appropriations Act, and relevant pharmacy transparency requirements.
  • Monitor emerging legislation and regulatory guidance and assess the potential impact on benefit programs and enterprise strategy.
  • Apply strong analytical and financial capabilities to cost forecasting, healthcare trend analysis, vendor evaluation, and program performance measurement.
  • Develop executive-level presentations that clearly communicate complex clinical, financial, and strategic information.
  • Influence senior leaders and support enterprise-level decision-making through a collaborative, consultative approach.
  • Select, coach, and develop a high-performing team, establishing clear objectives aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Lead performance management, succession planning, talent development, and recognition within the assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Support large-scale implementations, enterprise transformations, and merger and acquisition activity.
  • Promote a culture of ethical conduct, accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional teammate service.

  • Five or more years of leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to build, coach, and develop high-performing teams.

  • Significant experience managing pharmacy benefit manager relationships, formulary strategy, rebate contracting, specialty pharmacy, and clinical trend management.
  • Experience designing and evaluating clinical programs, care management strategies, Centers of Excellence, and point solutions.
  • Strong understanding of medical and pharmacy benefit design, network management, clinical program strategy, and population health analytics.
  • Working knowledge of applicable federal and state benefit laws and regulations, including ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, HITECH, COBRA, MHPAEA, the No Surprises Act, the Consolidated Appropriations Act, and IRS Sections 105, 125, and 129.
  • Strong financial, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, including cost forecasting, trend analysis, and vendor performance evaluation.
  • Experience leading requests for proposals, contract negotiations, vendor implementations, and program transitions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and translate complex clinical and financial concepts for executive audiences.
  • Experience supporting large-scale implementations, organizational transformations, or merger and acquisition activity.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, presentation, and change management skills.
  • A consultative leadership style with the ability to influence across functions without direct authority.
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate emerging issues, and solve complex problems.
  • A strong commitment to teammate service and organizational values.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, human resources, or a related field.

  • Experience within a Fortune 500 organization or large, integrated health system.
  • Experience working with HR enterprise resource planning platforms such as Workday, Oracle, or SAP.
  • Experience with benefits administration systems and related technology platforms.

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

What You’ll Do

  • Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

  • Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

  • Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

  • Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

  • Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

  • Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

  • Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

  • Outcomes & Measurement: Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections aging, and billing support ticket load. Use them to set priorities and hold the team accountable for results.

What You’ll Bring

  • Have at least 6 years of product management experience in SaaS, with 2 or more spent directly in a billing, monetization, or pricing domain.

  • Can reason about the moving parts of a billing stack well enough to co-design the architecture with your engineering partner.

  • Have carried a pricing or packaging change from proposal through to production, including financial modeling, plan configuration, grandfathering logic, migrations, sales enablement, and customer communication.

  • Have built or scaled consumption-based monetization and understand the tradeoffs between simplicity, accuracy, and customer trust when metering drives the invoice.

  • Pull your own numbers when you need them (SQL, Snowflake, Hex, or equivalent) and use data to set priorities rather than to decorate decisions already made.

  • Have worked directly with Stripe or a metered billing platform (Metronome, Orb, OpenMeter), not through an engineer.

  • Hold billing surfaces (plan pages, checkouts, invoices, usage dashboards) to the same design standard as the rest of the product.

  • Have worked in or adjacent to API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products, and are comfortable with the technical context that comes with that territory.

  • Independently define and execute the long-term vision to bring billing, fulfillment, and provisioning to best-in-class for the company's success.

Bonus Points

  • Experience leading an end-to-end pricing transformation or building a billing system from scratch.

  • Shipped cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure) or Salesforce CPQ-to-billing integrations.

  • Proficiency using LLMs and coding agents as part of your day-to-day product management workflow.

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. Using adult learning principles, the Program Trainer will facilitate engaging and effective training programs utilizing manufacturer-provided and client approved materials to build team confidence and capability in reimbursement processes. Are you passionate about making a difference in people's lives? Do you enjoy working in a service-oriented industry? If so, this opportunity may be the right fit for you!

Modivcare is looking for an experienced MDM Architect to join our team. As an MDM Architect, you will play a critical role in shaping the enterprise data foundation that powers healthcare operations, analytics, AI-driven decision-making, and digital transformation. You will lead the design and implementation of modern Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities that establish trusted, governed, and high-quality data across our Member, Provider, Facility, and other enterprise domains. Your work will directly improve the accuracy of critical business processes, enhance experiences for members and providers, accelerate innovation, and enable strategic growth across the organization.

We’re looking for a collaborative technology talent who enjoys solving complex enterprise data challenges, influencing enterprise architecture, and building scalable solutions that create lasting business value. The ideal candidate is passionate about modern data platforms, embraces continuous learning, and is excited to help shape the future of healthcare by delivering trusted, high-quality data that powers better decisions, stronger operational outcomes, and improved member experiences.

This is an opportunity to build enterprise-scale data products that become foundational assets for operational systems, advanced analytics, regulatory reporting, and emerging AI initiatives. Working closely with business and technology leaders, you will establish scalable architecture, modern engineering practices, and enterprise governance standards that transform data into a strategic business asset while supporting Modivcare’s mission of delivering better care through better data.

This role…

Master Data Management & Solution Architecture

  • Design and implement enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, including canonical data models, entity relationships, hierarchies, reference data, and enterprise data standards.

  • Establish trusted Golden Records through identity resolution, survivorship rules, and deterministic and probabilistic matching techniques.

  • Configure, implement, and optimize enterprise MDM platforms such as Ataccama ONE, Reltio, or similar technologies.

  • Define and maintain canonical data models and governance standards that improve consistency across enterprise applications.

  • Ensure master data is accurate, governed, reusable, and available across Member, Provider, Facility, and other enterprise domains.

  • Design scalable architecture that supports operational excellence, enterprise growth, advanced analytics, and AI initiatives.

Data Integration & APIs

  • Design and develop secure, scalable APIs and enterprise data services that expose mastered data to operational systems, analytics platforms, and downstream applications.

  • Build integration solutions supporting real-time, near real-time, and batch data exchange.

  • Develop scalable integration patterns that enable enterprise-wide consumption of trusted master data.

  • Ensure secure, governed access to enterprise master data across cloud and hybrid environments.

Data Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain cloud-native data pipelines using AWS Redshift, Glue, Lambda, Amazon S3, Athena, and Step Functions.

  • Develop scalable transformation logic using SQL and dbt.

  • Leverage dbt capabilities including data testing, schema validation, referential integrity, documentation, lineage tracking, exposures, metric definitions, and environment-based deployment controls.

  • Support CI/CD deployment pipelines and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Implement enterprise best practices for testing, documentation, deployment, observability, and governance.

  • Optimize SQL, data processing, and query performance across large-scale healthcare datasets.

  • Build modern data platforms that enable advanced analytics, machine learning, AI, and enterprise reporting while improving operational efficiency.

Data Quality & Stewardship

  • Collaborate with Data Governance teams to implement enterprise metadata management, stewardship, lineage, and governance processes.

  • Define, measure, and monitor master data quality metrics, governance KPIs, and service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, PHI, PII, privacy, security, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Promote enterprise adoption of governed and standardized master data practices.

  • Champion governance processes that enable innovation while protecting critical enterprise information assets.

  • This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

We are interested in speaking with individuals with the following…

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Ten (10) plus years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, enterprise data management, or related disciplines.

  • Four (4) plus years of hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions.

  • Experience implementing enterprise MDM platforms such as Ataccama ONE, Reltio, or similar solutions.

  • Experience designing scalable cloud-based data platforms and enterprise integration solutions.

  • Experience developing enterprise APIs and modern data service layers.

  • Experience with AWS data services including Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon Athena, and AWS Step Functions.

  • Hands-on experience with dbt, including transformation development, testing, documentation, lineage, governance, and deployment practices.

  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Advanced SQL expertise and strong data modeling skills, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions (SCDs), canonical data models, and analytical data design.

  • Experience implementing automated data quality, observability, monitoring, and remediation frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise Master Data Management principles including Golden Record management, identity resolution, survivorship rules, reference data management, and enterprise data governance.

  • Experience with enterprise data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview) for metadata management, business glossary, data lineage, stewardship, and governance workflows supporting Master Data Management (MDM).

  • Experience working with healthcare data domains including Member, Provider, Facility, Claims, or Care Management data preferred.

  • Experience working in regulated healthcare environments with HIPAA, PHI, and PII compliance requirements.

  • Experience collaborating with distributed and offshore engineering teams.

  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to solve complex enterprise data challenges.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence executive leadership, technical teams, and business stakeholders.

  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and maintainable enterprise data solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

  • Ability to balance business priorities with technical excellence while collaborating across cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
Hi. We’re Hummingbird.

We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it. We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Responsibilities

About the Role


Build the platforms that power patient access, and help a growing engineering team do the best work of their careers.


As a Sr. Principal Platform Engineer at Hummingbird, you’ll be the technical anchor for the team that builds our production platforms. You’ll spend most of your day hands on in the code: designing and building features, making the architecture decisions that shape our applications, and reviewing the work of earlier-career engineers so the whole team grows stronger. You’ll bring deep, independent engineering skill to the work and use AI tools to move faster without relying on them to do the thinking for you.


You’ll work closely with your team and partner regularly with IT Security and Data and Analytics to keep our systems connected, reliable, and built to last. For a few engineers just starting their careers, you’ll be the person who helps them understand not just what we build, but why we build it the way we do.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the core of our production platforms, spending most of your time hands on in the codebase.
  • Own the architecture decisions for our production applications, choosing where logic should live and how systems should connect.
  • Review pull requests and designs from earlier-career engineers, reinforcing standards for quality and consistency.
  • Mentor engineers who are early in their careers, helping them understand the reasoning behind technical decisions.
  • Develop across the full stack, working in both front-end and back-end code as the work requires.
  • Partner with IT Security and Data and Analytics to align on data access, integration, and system design.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, from failed integrations to system reliability problems, and resolve them at the root.
  • Use AI-powered development tools to speed up delivery while keeping full ownership of quality and design judgment.
  • Document decisions and tradeoffs so the team can build consistently and maintain systems over time.

The Details

  • Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
  • Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent Internet service
  • Work Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Expected range is $162,500 to $211,250. New hires usually start between $162,500 and $195,000, depending on experience and internal equity.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more

Required & Desired Skills

What You’ll Bring

  • 8 to 10+ years of software engineering experience, with deep hands-on skill building and shipping production systems.
  • Strong, independent programming ability across the full stack, working comfortably in both front-end and back-end code.
  • Hands-on experience with our stack or closely related technologies: TypeScript, Python, React, and Vite.
  • Strong system design and architecture skills, with the judgment to review designs and sign off on technical direction.
  • A track record of mentoring and growing earlier-career engineers, including those in their first role out of school.
  • A process-oriented mindset and the ability to reinforce standards through code and design review.
  • Comfort using AI-powered development tools to work faster, paired with the discipline not to rely on them for core engineering judgment.

Nice to Have

  • A computer science degree or equivalent formal background in software engineering.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-paced environment where you’ve built structure while moving quickly.

ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfill its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Clinical Specialist will be primarily responsible for training and supporting users of our products. This includes teaching and training users in the correct manner to ensure our products are used safely and effectively - both for the preservation of organs prior to transplant, and for various clinical and non-clinical research studies. The role of Clinical Specialist will involve global travel, primarily within North America, visiting leading sites of transplantation surgery. This means the Clinical Specialist will be required to work after business hours, including nights, weekends and some very long days, which is the norm due to the unpredictable nature of organ donation and transplantation.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Train and support organ retrieval and transplant teams in the use of the OrganOx metra according to OrganOx’s policies and procedures.
  • Generally, on-call 24/7 for about 15 days a month (including holidays and weekends) for remote and onsite support.
  • Organize Site Initiation & Refresher Visits, training sessions (in person and remote) and centralized training events.
  • Effective and timely communication with transplant teams, internal management and coworkers.
  • Create and write case study review with guidance for senior colleagues.
  • When not on call, the clinical specialist will support managers, directors and other internal staff in various assignments, either remotely or onsite.
  • May participate in R&D activities in lab settings under the direction of management.
  • Work with the liver transplant teams to collect data on livers perfused and preserved on the metra to build up a database of product performance and use.
  • Ensure vendor credentialing requirements are current and able to pass routine background checks and drug screens.
  • Attend local, regional, national, and international meetings and conferences, in person or virtually, on behalf of OrganOx as a supporter, participant, or presenter as needed.

  • Perform administrative tasks related to expenses, email, and other communication activities.
  • Ensure personal understanding of all quality policy/system items that are personally applicable.
  • Follow all work/quality procedures to ensure quality system compliance and high-quality work.
  • Other duties as assigned by Director of Clinical Support.

Requirements

Essential Requirements:

  • BS degree in combination with equivalent medical experience, with 3+ years’ experience in ICU, ECMO, Cath Lab, OR, Transplant, and ED
  • Regardless of professional background, must possess the following qualifications:
  • Must be highly flexible and willing to support sites as needed within and across North America
  • Must be detail oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills; able to work collaboratively and build rapport with internal and external contacts
  • Excellent customer facing skills.
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally under pressure
  • Must be able to enthusiastically work at fast pace in dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities
  • Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint proficiency

Preferred Requirements:

  • A licensed RN, RT, RD and/or a health science-related degree
  • Industry experience in pharmaceutical or medical device

Other Qualifications:

  • Travel: Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time for training, investigator meetings, monitoring responsibilities, corporate meetings, and educational seminars.
  • Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, and speak. The position may require sitting for significant periods of the day while working on the computer. The employee must occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Work Environment: This is a work-from-anywhere, remote job wherein meetings and collaborations can occur across multiple time zones.
  • Work Accessibility: Must live within an hour of a major airport.

A job description does not imply that the duties stated are the only ones to be performed by the job holder. Job holder will be required to follow any other job-related instruction as reasonably requested by their line manager or their designate.

Benefits

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits available from day one, including health, dental, vision, disability coverage, and flexible spending accounts. Additionally, we offer a 401(k)-retirement plan with company matching after 90 days, paid time off, holidays, and additional leave benefits, as well as employee discounts and access to our onsite wellness facility. Visa: H-1B transfers and TN visas sponsored; O-1 considered case-by-case


About the Role

We’re hiring an AI Field Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our AI’s high-velocity team

You’ll work directly with ambitious AI-native companies to turn complex AI challenges into production-ready systems. This is a highly hands-on role sitting at the intersection of AI engineering, product, and customer delivery.

You’ll build POCs, MVPs, and production integrations while working directly with customers, account executives, and engineering teams. You’ll also engage with technical and executive stakeholders to discuss architecture, strategy, and business outcomes.

This is not a traditional consulting or solutions role you’ll be hands-on-keyboard, writing code, deploying systems, solving technical problems, and contributing directly to our products and platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their technical and business challenges.

  • Design and build POCs, MVPs, and production AI applications.

  • Deploy and optimize LLM and generative AI workloads in production.

  • Work with open-source models, inference infrastructure, and AI/ML platforms.

  • Collaborate with customer engineering teams, account executives, and Fireworks product/engineering teams.

  • Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Troubleshoot complex AI, infrastructure, and deployment challenges.

  • Communicate technical architecture and tradeoffs to both engineers and executive stakeholders.

  • Contribute code and product improvements directly to the codebase.

  • Turn customer learnings into product feedback and help shape our roadmap.

  • Take ownership of projects from initial discovery through production deployment.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong technical depth with excellent customer-facing skills.

You may come from backgrounds such as:

  • Forward Deployed Engineer

  • AI/ML Engineer

  • Applied AI Engineer

  • AI Solutions Engineer

  • Solutions Architect

  • Sales Engineer

  • Customer Engineer

  • ML/AI Infrastructure Engineer

  • Customer Success Engineer with strong technical depth


Required

  • 3–10 years of experience in a client-facing technical or AI/ML engineering role.

  • Strong Python programming skills.

  • Experience building and deploying AI/ML or generative AI applications.

  • Experience working with LLMs and/or open-source AI models.

  • Ability to work directly with customers and communicate technical concepts clearly.

  • Experience building POCs and taking solutions toward production.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.

  • Willingness to work hands-on across engineering, customer delivery, and product.


Technical Experience

Experience with some of the following is highly relevant:

  • Python

  • vLLM

  • SGLang

  • TensorRT-LLM

  • Kubernetes

  • AWS, Azure, or GCP

  • AWS Bedrock / SageMaker

  • Azure AI Foundry

  • GCP Vertex AI

  • LLM fine-tuning, including SFT, DPO, or RFT

  • GPU infrastructure

  • Model inference and optimization

You do not need experience with every technology listed, but you should have strong fundamentals in AI/ML engineering and be comfortable learning quickly.


Why Join?

  • Work directly with cutting-edge AI companies.

  • Build real AI systems that move from prototype to production.

  • Work across engineering, product, and customer delivery.

  • Contribute directly to an AI infrastructure platform.

  • Join a highly technical, builder-first team.

  • Competitive compensation of $220K–$285K OTE + meaningful equity.

  • US visa support including H-1B transfers and TN visas.

jobs.title: Director, Email & Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAt BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better.
jobs.description:
About the Role

At BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better. Email is central to how we engage our members and drive results for our advertising and merchant partners—and this role runs that engine.

We’re seeking a highly hands-on Director of Email & Lifecycle Marketing who lives and breathes newsletter strategy, deliverability, engagement, and monetization. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work—building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume program of 40+ campaigns per week plus automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization, and Partner Performance

  • Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
  • Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
  • Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
  • Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
  • Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

  • Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns—from planning through send and post-send analysis.
  • Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
  • Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
  • Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
  • Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets—IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops—monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
  • Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

  • Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
  • Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
  • Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys—activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back—to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
  • Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub’s own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team, and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle—including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation—and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
  • Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
  • Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
  • Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
  • Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

  • 9+ years of hands-on email, CRM, or lifecycle marketing in a high-volume program, including monetizing a newsletter or email audience through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance, and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
  • Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack—our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics—across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.
  • Proven success managing and developing a high-performing team.
  • Strong command of segmentation, personalization, automation workflows, triggered campaigns, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and performance measurement, building KPIs and dashboards and translating performance data into insights for partners and executives—with the judgment to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart—Preferred

  • Background at an ecommerce, marketplace, perks/benefits, affiliate, deals, or media/ad-monetization company (e.g., PerkSpot, EBG / Perks at Work, LifeMart, Rakuten, Groupon, RetailMeNot, or similar).
  • Understanding of the HR, benefits, and employee-engagement landscape.
  • Experience with multi-tenant programs, product-marketing/GTM email, global multi-market programs, and evaluating or migrating ESPs.

Benefits include:

  • Medical and Dental (employer pays 75% of monthly contributions)
  • Telehealth (employer paid 100%)
  • Vision insurance (employer pays 100% of monthly contributions)
  • Domestic partner coverage for all insurance plans
  • 100% employer-paid life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan options, including employer contribution
  • Generous paid time off (PTO)
  • Generous sick time off (STO) program
  • Generous paid paternity and maternity leave policies
  • 11 holidays, including office closed the day after Thanksgiving
  • Flexible spending account program
  • Voluntary benefit programs (STD, LTD, life insurance, accident, cancer)

About BenefitHub

BenefitHub is the premier employee lifestyle benefits platform, connecting millions of employees with exclusive discounts, rewards, and perks. Our mission is to enhance the lives of employees worldwide while helping organizations attract, retain, and engage top talent through meaningful benefits.
