jobs.description:
Manager of Efficacy and Learning Research

Location: Remote US--Must live and work with in US.

Job Overview:


The Manager of Efficacy and Learning Research is a core strategic leader and member of the R&D leadership team at ExploreK12. This is a team that seeks empirical answers to crucial questions such as: are all students succeeding? under what conditions? How do we best communicate our ROI to stakeholders? What improvements should we make to our products and services to optimize student success? As a key cross-functional partner, this role drives the vision and execution of research across the organization.


This position will work in close collaboration with the SVP, Product Strategy to set the research roadmap for ExploreK12. The Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Data Analytics, Learning Experience Design, UX/UI Design, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Growth Marketing, and Customer Success to scope and lead research projects that generate actionable insights to guide product development, validate product effectiveness, and support sales and marketing efforts with compelling, evidence-based impact stories. This position also manages and mentors a growing team of researchers, developing efficient systems for research execution and impact across the company.


Qualified candidates will have deep expertise in designing, conducting and supervising education research and the demonstrated ability to successfully implement innovative studies to address strategic research objectives. This position calls for an education research expert with the abilities to think strategically, delegate responsibility, and communicate effectively.

Job Responsibilities:


Strategic Research Leadership

  • Define and lead the company-wide research roadmap in alignment with product, sales, and marketing goals.
  • Serve as the central research point of contact for internal stakeholders, scoping research needs and translating them into high-impact studies.
  • Ensure that research efforts deliver clear value to internal teams and external audiences by turning data into compelling, actionable insights.
  • Represent the research team in cross-functional planning, contributing research-informed perspectives to strategic decisions across the business.

Project Management

  • Oversee all phases of research, including the design, planning, and execution of research projects that assess product efficacy, inform product design, and identify key conditions for success.
  • Simultaneously manage several complex research projects from conception to completion.
  • Ensure that research projects are conducted with methodological rigor and in alignment with industry standards, privacy laws, and internal priorities.
  • Develop and refine efficient research processes, timelines, and reporting systems to support research scalability.
  • Oversee technical outputs and provide hands-on support for study design, data collection, analysis, and reporting.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, manage and grow a high-performing team of researchers to execute on strategic priorities.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and professional development support tailored to each team member’s career goals and growth areas.
  • Guide resource allocation and task delegation across team members to meet strategic priorities efficiently.

Organizational Thought Leadership

  • Collaborate with Marketing to translate research findings into accessible formats (e.g., blog posts, infographics, talking points, whitepapers) for external audiences.
  • Represent ExploreK12’s research at conferences, webinars, and industry events, contributing to our visibility as a leader in edtech efficacy.
  • Proactively identify gaps and opportunities in how research is integrated into product, sales, and customer success strategies.

Job Requirements:


  • Proven track record of designing and leading impactful education research studies in the U.S. K-12 EdTech industry..
  • 5+ years of experience in education research, data science, or analytics, preferably in applied or industry settings.
  • Deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodology, including study design, recruitment and data collection, and data interpretation.
  • Excellent analytic skills, including expertise in statistical analysis and experience using tools for statistical analysis (SPSS, SAS, Python, or R)
  • Demonstrated success turning research into actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Exemplary project management, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Exceptional collaborative mindset and interpersonal skills to work across product, marketing, and sales functions.
  • Excellent communication and writing skills for both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with experimental design or program evaluation in the context of education or learning sciences and/or in EdTech
  • Experience working closely with cross-functional teams, including product, marketing, sales, and customer success
  • Experience working with external research partners or firms
  • Experience with learning analytics, educational data mining, and/or evidence-centered design
  • Track record of building systems that scale research insights across product and customer touchpoints.
  • Master’s degree in education, learning sciences, social science, or closely related field; PhD degree

Why Work for Us

When you join ExploreK12™, you become part of a mission to help educators unlock brighter futures for every student.


As a trusted leader in educational technology, we serve more than 17 million students and educators across 150+ countries with innovative, research-backed learning solutions that truly make a difference. Our flagship products—Gizmos™, Raz-Plus®, and Reflex™—are beloved by educators and students alike for being as practical and effective as they are fun.


To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .


Remote First Work Environment

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.


If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.


The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note-taking tools, reference materials, or AI-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance.


As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office.


An Equal Opportunity Employer

We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history).


We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are + What We Do:Booster is a mission-driven school fundraising company focused on cultivating virtuous leaders who want to change the world.
jobs.description:
Who We Are + What We Do:

Booster is a mission-driven school fundraising company focused on cultivating virtuous leaders who want to change the world. Booster partners with over 6,000 schools each year and impacts over 3 million students across all 50 states. At the heart of our culture, our six virtues guide everything we do: Gratitude, Wisdom, Care, Courage, Grit, and Celebration. We deliver engaging, innovative, and active fundraising experiences for elementary and middle schools nationwide. From high-energy fun runs to all-in-one fundraising platforms and custom gear, we’ve helped schools raise over $1 billion for education. Booster is a fun, fast-paced, and purpose-filled place to work, where every day offers the opportunity to make a real impact in the lives of students and school communities.


Are You Booster’s Next Centralized Lead Qualifier?

As a Centralized Lead Qualifier on Booster’s Revenue team, you’ll help create a seamless experience for prospective customers while supporting several initiatives that help Booster reach and serve more schools.

You’ll be one of the first points of contact for inbound prospects—managing and qualifying leads, identifying the right Booster solution for their needs, and connecting qualified opportunities with the appropriate sales team. You’ll also support Commercial and MyBooster sales efforts, contribute to Booster’s social media presence, and help create resources that equip our Field Sales teams. This role is a great fit for someone who is an excellent communicator, highly organized, comfortable talking with prospective customers, and excited by a role that blends sales, relationship-building, administrative work, and creativity.

How You’ll Impact Booster’s Mission:

  • Manage and qualify inbound leads: Monitor incoming leads, filter non-sales inquiries, route opportunities to the appropriate owners, enter leads received through other channels, and maintain accurate information within our CRM.
  • Connect prospects with the right solution: Communicate with prospective customers through calls, texts, and emails to understand their needs, determine fit, schedule discovery meetings with Account Executives, and maintain engagement throughout the qualification process.
  • Redirect alternative opportunities: Develop an understanding of Booster’s broader products and solutions and help prospective clients who aren't a fit for our traditional program identify other potential options. Connect appropriate prospects with internal teams and potential pilot opportunities.
  • Support Commercial and MyBooster sales: Prepare for and lead virtual sales conversations, communicate with prospective buyers, send follow-up materials and contracts, maintain accurate records, and connect new clients with the teams that will support their partnership.
  • Support Sales projects and resources: Organize data, create and update presentations and resources, proofread sales materials, and provide project support that equips Field Sales teams to engage prospective customers effectively.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with Marketing, Sales, Account Executives, Research & Development, and other teams to improve the inbound lead experience, share insights, and identify opportunities to strengthen processes and workflows.

What You’ll Bring to the Table:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to build relationships and establish trust with prospective customers
  • Strong time management, organization, and follow-through
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately manage data and information
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and shift comfortably between sales, administrative, and creative work
  • Curiosity and active listening skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams
  • Comfort leading virtual conversations with prospective customers
  • Ability to consistently work MST/PST business hours

Compensation: $18-$23/hour + commission

Location: Remote

Work Hours: Part time (15-20 hours/week)

Exempt/non-exempt: non-exempt

jobs.description:
We’re seeking a strategic, results-driven Regional Sales Director to lead a high-performing team of Account Executives (AEs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) responsible for driving new business growth, expanding existing relationships, and ensuring customer success and retention.

This player-coach role combines strategic leadership with operational execution. You’ll own the region’s ARR target, set the vision for growth, and ensure seamless collaboration between Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven and empathetic leader who inspires excellence, develops talent, and delivers measurable impact across the full customer lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Growth

  • Define and execute the regional go-to-market strategy across new business, renewals, and expansions.
  • Own the region’s full ARR target, including pipeline generation, win rates, renewals, and customer growth.
  • Partner with GTM and Sales leadership to set annual plans, quotas, and coverage models aligned with company priorities.
  • Translate business objectives into actionable territory and segment strategies.

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Lead, coach, and develop AEs and CSMs to consistently exceed revenue, renewal, and adoption goals.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular pipeline and forecast reviews to ensure accuracy and focus on high-impact opportunities.
  • Coach team members on discovery, consultative selling, and executive engagement.
  • Identify and mentor future leaders to strengthen team depth and succession planning.

Revenue Growth & Retention

  • Drive strategies for new business acquisition and customer expansion in partnership with Marketing, Product, and Enablement.
  • Ensure balanced coverage across territories to maximize market penetration and customer value.

Customer Success & Advocacy

  • Ensure high customer satisfaction, adoption, and measurable outcomes across all accounts.
  • Support CSMs in developing success plans, executive business reviews, and expansion strategies.
  • Cultivate customer advocates to strengthen brand reputation and influence in the market.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain high standards of forecast accuracy, data integrity, and CRM discipline (Salesforce, Gainsight, etc.).
  • Monitor key performance metrics—pipeline coverage, renewal risk, and expansion velocity—and proactively address gaps.
  • Leverage analytics and market intelligence to inform territory planning and resource allocation.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless customer experience from onboarding through renewal.

Market & Strategy

  • Stay current on market trends, competitive dynamics, and institutional challenges in the education technology sector.
  • Provide feedback to Product and Marketing based on customer insights and emerging opportunities.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences and events as a thought leader and advocate for innovation in education.
  • 10+ years of experience in EdTech SaaS or enterprise software sales, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Proven record of leading teams to exceed aggressive ARR and retention targets across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Deep understanding of the education market, including institutional decision-making and procurement processes.
  • Exceptional leadership, strategic thinking, and executive communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, operational, and forecasting acumen with proficiency in Salesforce, Gainsight, and related GTM tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred.

Success Metrics

  • Achievement of regional new business, expansion, and renewal targets.
  • Growth in market share and customer advocacy within the assigned segment.
  • Improved win rates, pipeline velocity, and forecast accuracy.
  • High team engagement and retention of top performers.
  • Consistent operational excellence and data discipline.

The expected annual base salary range for this position is: $125,550/year to $209,250/year. This position is commission-based.

Actual compensation will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if extended, and is determined by work location and a range of other relevant factors, including but not limited to: experience, skills, degrees, licensures, certifications, and other job-related factors. Internal equity, market and organizational factors are also considered.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.

Our Values underpin everything we do.

  • Customer Centric: Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
  • Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
  • Integrity: Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
  • Action & Ownership: We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
  • One Team: We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
  • Global Mindset: We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

Global Benefits

  • Remote First Culture
  • Health Care Coverage
  • Education Reimbursement*Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Self-Care Days
  • National Holidays
  • 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Charitable Contribution Match
  • Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (mental health platform)
  • Parental Leave
  • Retirement Plan with match/contribution

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

Turnitin, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer- vets/disabled.

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.

das erwartet dich bei uns

Berufseinstieg | Vollzeit | Remote – Wohnort im Ruhrgebiet (Raum Essen/Bottrop)

Du erkennst gute Geschichten, recherchierst gern und willst von Anfang an Verantwortung übernehmen?

Wir entwickeln ein digitales B2B-Produkt im HR-Bereich – einem Markt, der sich durch Technologie und künstliche Intelligenz gerade grundlegend verändert. Für den weiteren Aufbau unserer Marke und unserer Kommunikation suchen wir eine Person, die von Anfang an mitgestaltet.

Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht nur darum, einzelne Social-Media-Kanäle zu bespielen. Wir wollen relevante Themen erkennen, daraus gute Inhalte entwickeln und diese über die jeweils passenden Formate und Kanäle sichtbar machen.

über uns

Wir bauen eine HR-Tech-Lösung, die künstliche Intelligenz in die Personalarbeit von Unternehmen bringt. Hinter dem Produkt steht ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, das Erfahrung aus IT-Beratung, Personalarbeit und Produktentwicklung verbindet. welche menschen wir suchen

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht einfach einen bestehenden Redaktionsplan abarbeitet, sondern sich fragt: Welches Thema interessiert unsere Zielgruppe? Welche Geschichte steckt dahinter? Und welches Format und welcher Kanal sind dafür am besten geeignet?

Dafür bekommst du früh Gestaltungsspielraum und arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und dem Produktteam zusammen.

  • Reichweite, Interaktion und Performance der Inhalte analysieren und daraus Verbesserungen ableiten
  • Markt, Wettbewerber und relevante Trends im HR-Tech-Umfeld beobachten und neue Formate ausprobieren
Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für einzelne Kanäle, Kampagnen oder Themenbereiche.

Wenn du gerne recherchierst, gute Geschichten erkennst und Lust hast, aus einem jungen digitalen Unternehmen eine sichtbare Marke zu machen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – gern mit Links zu Arbeitsproben oder eigenen Kanälen.

jobs.excerpt: ¡Trabaja en DaCodes! Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
jobs.description:
¡Trabaja en DaCodes!

Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. Nuestro equipo colabora en proyectos con clientes en LATAM y Estados Unidos, logrando resultados sobresalientes.
En DaCodes, tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar tu desarrollo profesional, trabajar en diversos proyectos dentro de distintas industrias, y contribuir al diseño, implementación y optimización de infraestructuras en la nube.
Nuestros DaCoders tienen un gran impacto en el éxito de nuestro negocio y el de nuestros clientes. Serás el experto que participará en nuestros proyectos y tendrás acceso a startups disruptivas y marcas globales.

¿Te interesa?

Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Datos Senior especializado/a en Snowflake para construir un almacén de datos confiable a partir de sistemas fuente como SAP ASE (Sybase), SQL Server, APIs REST y archivos.

Serás responsable de la capa de datos completa: extracción, modelado, calidad, conciliación, seguridad y operación. El objetivo es habilitar el consumo de información por agentes de IA capaces de responder preguntas de negocio con cifras exactas, trazables y sujetas a los permisos de cada usuario.

Trabajarás directamente con usuarios de negocio y con el ingeniero de IA para definir métricas, homologar información entre sistemas y validar que los resultados coincidan con las fuentes originales.

Modalidad: Remoto · Tiempo completo.
Ubicación: México y LATAM.
Seniority: Senior.
Idioma: Español nativo o profesional e inglés intermedio, con capacidad para comprender documentación técnica.

Requirements

Principales responsabilidades y funciones

Ingesta e integración

  • Construir procesos de extracción desde SAP ASE (Sybase) y SQL Server mediante ODBC, utilizando Openflow como patrón de conectores.
  • Integrar APIs REST con autenticación, renovación de tokens, paginación, control de límites de peticiones y reintentos.
  • Incorporar archivos y otras fuentes al almacén de datos, preservando el dato original y su marca de extracción.
  • Permitir el reproceso de datos desde la capa de aterrizaje sin volver a consultar los sistemas fuente.

Modelado y capa semántica

  • Construir las capas Bronze, Silver y Gold con dimensiones conformadas, historización y hechos de negocio con métricas certificadas.
  • Desarrollar modelos y transformaciones con dbt, incluyendo pruebas declarativas, materializaciones incrementales y documentación generada.
  • Definir con el cliente catálogos maestros homologados para unificar identificadores y nombres entre sistemas, mediante tablas de equivalencia versionadas y métricas de cobertura.
  • Diseñar con el ingeniero de IA modelos semánticos, consultas verificadas y un glosario de métricas para el consumo de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la trazabilidad de cada cifra a su fuente, tabla y fecha de corte, y exponer la información mediante vistas de consumo.

Calidad y operación

  • Implementar reglas de calidad y mecanismos de cuarentena para registros que no cumplan los criterios definidos.
  • Orquestar la ventana nocturna de procesamiento, con monitoreo y bitácoras de ejecución.
  • Conciliar la capa Gold contra los reportes vigentes del cliente y documentar las diferencias y sus causas.
  • Controlar el consumo de créditos y configurar mecanismos de monitoreo de recursos en Snowflake.
  • Colaborar en la evaluación de precisión y repetibilidad de las respuestas generadas por los agentes de IA.

Gobernanza y transferencia

  • Implementar RBAC, row access policies y políticas de masking conforme a la matriz de accesos acordada con el cliente.
  • Asegurar que los agentes consulten y respondan únicamente sobre información autorizada para cada rol.
  • Documentar el linaje, la operación de los pipelines y los procedimientos de reproceso.
  • Preparar la transferencia técnica y operativa al equipo del cliente.

Perfil deseado y requisitos obligatorios

  • Al menos cinco años construyendo almacenes de datos en producción y al menos dos años trabajando con Snowflake.
  • Dominio avanzado de Snowflake: warehouses, RBAC, row access policies, masking y resource monitors.
  • Experiencia avanzada en modelado dimensional: dimensiones conformadas, historización y esquemas estrella.
  • Dominio avanzado de dbt: pruebas declarativas, materializaciones incrementales y documentación generada.
  • SQL avanzado y experiencia en extracción desde SAP ASE (Sybase) y SQL Server, incluyendo ingeniería inversa de esquemas sin documentación.
  • Experiencia avanzada en ingesta desde APIs REST: autenticación, paginación, control de ritmo y reintentos.
  • Experiencia avanzada en orquestación de pipelines y calidad de datos con cuarentena.
  • Experiencia intermedia a avanzada integrando modelos LLM con almacenes de datos: modelos semánticos, text-to-SQL gobernado, consultas verificadas y evaluación de precisión y repetibilidad.
  • Experiencia intermedia diseñando capas de datos para agentes, con trazabilidad a la fuente y fecha de corte, vistas de consumo y control de créditos.
  • Experiencia trabajando directamente con usuarios de negocio para definir reglas, homologar catálogos y validar cifras.
  • Español nativo o profesional e inglés intermedio, con comprensión de documentación técnica.
  • Residencia en México o LATAM y disponibilidad para trabajar de tiempo completo de forma remota.

Habilidades clave

  • Ownership: asumir la responsabilidad de la capa de datos completa y dar seguimiento autónomo hasta su entrega.
  • Rigor con las cifras: validar la exactitud de los resultados y resolver diferencias contra la fuente.
  • Criterio de negocio: acordar las reglas de homologación con el cliente y documentar sus implicaciones.
  • Comunicación clara: explicar diferencias de conciliación a usuarios de negocio y decisiones técnicas a desarrolladores.
  • Capacidad para investigar sistemas sin documentación y convertir los hallazgos en soluciones mantenibles.

Deseables

  • Experiencia con Snowflake Intelligence, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search o Snowflake CoCo.
  • Implementación de RAG sobre documentos no estructurados integrado al almacén de datos.
  • Experiencia con Openflow, Dynamic Tables o Snowpark.
  • Experiencia con ERPs de nicho sobre Sybase o SQL Server.
  • Certificación SnowPro Core o Advanced.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.

📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.

🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.

🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).

🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.

📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.

📢 Clases de inglés.

🏅 Orgullosamente certificados como Great Place to Work.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking
jobs.excerpt: About the roleWe are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO.
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.

You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.

As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.

This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Reference architecture

  • Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.

  • Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.

  • Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.

  • Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.

  • Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.

Host and platform networking

  • Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.

  • Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).

  • Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.

Research and exploration

  • Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.

  • Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.

  • Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.

  • Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.

Code and proofs of concept

  • Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.

  • Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.

  • Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib_write_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.

Customers, partners and community

  • Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.

  • Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.

  • Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.

  • Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.

  • Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.

Education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.

  • Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.

Required technical skills

  • Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.

  • InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.

  • RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.

  • Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.

  • Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.

  • Linux networking: how the kernel and drivers manage NICs, PCI passthrough, SR-IOV, IOMMU, NUMA affinity, and tools such as iproute2, ethtool and devlink.

  • Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins (e.g. Cilium, Calico, OVN-Kubernetes), Multus and secondary networks, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, network policy and service exposure.

  • Virtualisation on Kubernetes: KubeVirt, and how VM networking, passthrough and SR-IOV are configured there.

  • Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure-as-code.

How you work

We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each.

  • Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way.

  • Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it.

  • Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them.

  • Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments.

  • Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time-to-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers.

Communication and collaboration

  • Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from.

  • Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands-on workshops.

  • Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives.

  • Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories.

  • Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments.

  • Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API.

  • Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents.

  • Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress).

  • Familiarity with Software-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage).

  • Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking.

  • Contributions to open-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing.

  • Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers.

  • Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language.

Location, travel and working model

This role is remote, open to candidates based in he United States (East Coast).

  • You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours.

  • Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US.

  • Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement.

Why you’ll love Mirantis

  • Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises

  • Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence

  • Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Job Description — Technical Recruiter (Remote / Offshore)

Work model: Remote (offshore), with 3–4 hours daily overlap with Sydney (AEDT/AEST)
Type: Contract (preferred) with potential to extend

About Komforce

Komforce is a specialist resource augmentation firm focused on Salesforce Industries / Communications Cloud (Vlocity) talent. We help telcos, digital service providers, and Salesforce partners/SIs build delivery teams fast with clear SLAs, strong candidate quality, and consistent reporting.

Role Summary

We're hiring a highly independent, reliable Technical Recruiter to own end-to-end sourcing and first-stage recruiting for niche Salesforce talent. This is not a post-and-pray role, you'll be doing deep research, targeted outreach, and structured pipeline management.

You'll succeed here if you're comfortable operating with autonomy, you're rigorous about process and data hygiene, and you can consistently produce strong shortlists for hard-to-find profiles (Architects, Developers, QA Leads, Solution Consultants, Project Leads) in the Salesforce Industries ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

1) Talent Research & Market Mapping (Core)

  • Build and maintain talent maps for priority skill sets (e.g., OmniStudio, Industries CPQ, EPC, Order Management, TMF-aligned telco processes, integrations).
  • Identify candidate pools across multiple channels: LinkedIn, communities, referrals, GitHub (where relevant), niche groups, and targeted databases.
  • Produce role-specific Boolean strings and sourcing strategies per market (APAC + global).

2) Outreach & Pipeline Generation (Core)

  • Run high-quality outbound outreach (email/LinkedIn) with personalised messaging and structured follow-ups.
  • Manage outreach sequences, track response rates, and iterate messaging based on results.
  • Keep warm pipelines for recurring roles so we can move quickly when demand spikes.

3) Screening, Shortlisting & Candidate Packaging

  • Conduct initial screens (skills, domain fit, communication, availability, rate expectations).
  • Validate fundamentals relevant to the role (practical delivery experience, project context, what they actually built).
  • Produce a clear candidate brief for each shortlisted profile: summary, strengths, risks/concerns, rate, notice period, timezone, and interview availability.

4) Interview Coordination & Process Discipline

  • Schedule interviews, manage comms, collect feedback, and keep candidates engaged through the funnel.
  • Maintain clean recruiting ops: ATS/CRM updates, status tracking, notes, and weekly reporting.

5) Reporting & SLA Delivery

  • Weekly (or more frequent) reporting on: pipeline volume, outreach activity, response rates, shortlist progress, bottlenecks, and next actions.
  • Work to defined SLAs, including time-to-shortlist and pass-through quality.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in technical recruiting or sourcing (agency or in-house), with proven outbound sourcing strength.
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit for enterprise software / cloud / systems integration roles (Salesforce ecosystem experience is strongly preferred).
  • Strong research skills: can independently find the right talent pools and build lists without being told where to look.
  • Excellent written English and professional communication (candidate-facing).
  • Highly organised: consistent tracking, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working directly with a founder and operating with high autonomy.

Strongly Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

  • Experience recruiting in Salesforce (especially Salesforce Industries / Vlocity / Communications Cloud).
  • Familiarity with telco delivery contexts (BSS/OSS, order-to-activation, TMF concepts).
  • Experience recruiting both contract and permanent roles across multiple regions/time zones.
  • Ability to use recruiting tools efficiently (ATS/CRM, sourcing automation, basic sequencing).

Tools & Workflow

We'll aligned on a simple operating rhythm and toolset (we can provide access where needed). You should be comfortable with:

  • LinkedIn, email outreach, spreadsheets/CRM discipline
  • ATS/CRM
  • Clear weekly reporting and pipeline dashboards

Work Hours / Overlap

  • Remote offshore role
  • Minimum 3-4 hours overlap daily with Sydney (AEDT/AEST) for intake, calibration, and fast feedback loops

What We Value

  • Independence + reliability (we need someone who just gets it done)
  • Proof-driven recruiting (signal over volume; quality shortlists)
  • Candidate experience (professional, responsive, respectful)
  • Process discipline (clean data, clear notes, consistent reporting)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work remotely
  • Solid base compensation boosted by bonus and commission incentives
  • Working directly with an AI-savvy founder at an early stage of the company

Our client is a well-established and rapidly growing FMCG manufacturing company in the Caribbean region. With an ambition to scale operations through smart manufacturing, the company is undergoing a digital transformation and seeks to upgrade its plant through industrial automation and Industry 4.0 integration.

About the Role

The Hive Careers is seeking a highly skilled Industrial Automation Consultant to join our team on a remote contract basis and work with one of our FMCG clients. This role involves leading the assessment, design, and deployment of automation technologies to optimize manufacturing efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance product quality.

This is a remote-first role, but occasional on-site travel may be required during critical phases of implementation (travel expenses covered).

  • Conduct a remote audit of existing manufacturing systems and identify automation opportunities.

Job Title: Data Engineering Manager - (GCP, AI/ML & GenAI)

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager with strong hands-on expertise in AWS and GCP Data Engineering to lead a large-scale AWS-to-GCP data platform migration.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing enterprise data platforms on AWS and migrating them to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role requires a combination of technical architecture, hands-on engineering, migration leadership, team management and stakeholder management.

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Step Functions and AWS DMS, along with strong GCP expertise across BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage and Cloud Composer.

The Engineering Manager will work closely with US-based stakeholders, architects, engineers, DevOps teams, Data Science and BI teams to define the migration strategy and ensure successful execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI/ML, Generative AI & MLOps

  • Design and implement AI/ML and Generative AI solutions on GCP using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, and related GCP-native services.
  • Build production-grade machine learning pipelines for data preparation, model training, validation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including enterprise search, document intelligence, AI assistants, summarization, semantic search, embeddings, vector search, and knowledge-management applications.
  • Design scalable ingestion, transformation, chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured enterprise data.
  • Implement MLOps practices using Vertex AI Pipelines, Model Registry, model endpoints, Terraform, GitHub, Cloud Build, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Establish standards for model versioning, experiment tracking, data and feature validation, automated testing, deployment approvals, rollback, and environment promotion.
  • Implement monitoring for model performance, data drift, latency, reliability, inference cost, response quality, retrieval accuracy, and GenAI risks such as hallucination and prompt injection.
  • Ensure responsible AI, data privacy, security, governance, access control, auditability, and human-review processes are incorporated into AI/ML and GenAI solutions.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Product, BI, Security, and US-based stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI/ML and GenAI use cases.

Architect and implement scalable enterprise data platforms on GCP.

Design Data Lake and Lakehouse architectures using GCS and BigQuery.

Define Bronze, Silver and Gold/Atomic data layers.

Design scalable data ingestion, transformation and consumption frameworks.

Establish standards for data modeling, partitioning, clustering and storage.

Google Pub/Sub

Dataflow / Apache Beam

BigQuery

Cloud Storage

Design high-volume event ingestion, enrichment and transformation pipelines.

Implement event-driven architectures and appropriate delivery guarantees.

Optimize streaming pipelines for latency, throughput and scalability.

Design BigQuery streaming ingestion patterns.

Implement monitoring, logging and alerting for real-time workloads.

5. ETL / ELT & Data Processing

Design and implement scalable batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines.

Migrate AWS Glue-based pipelines to appropriate GCP services.

Develop transformation frameworks using:

Python

PySpark

SQL

Dataflow / Apache Beam

BigQuery

dbt

6. AWS to GCP Migration Leadership

Lead the end-to-end migration of enterprise data platforms from AWS to GCP.

Assess existing AWS architecture, data pipelines, workloads, dependencies and operational processes.

Define the target-state GCP architecture and migration roadmap.

Develop migration strategies for:

Amazon S3 → Google Cloud Storage

Amazon Redshift → BigQuery

AWS Glue → Dataflow / Dataproc / BigQuery

AWS Step Functions → Cloud Composer / Workflows

AWS DMS → GCP-native CDC solutions

Amazon Athena → BigQuery

Identify opportunities to modernize AWS workloads rather than performing a simple lift-and-shift migration.

Define migration phases, technical dependencies, risks and rollback strategies.

Lead architecture reviews and technical design discussions.

Design enterprise data models for analytics and reporting.

Define dimensional, normalized and denormalized data models.

Develop multi-tenant data structures.

Design BigQuery partitioning and clustering strategies.

Optimize BigQuery SQL and query execution.

Design data models supporting both real-time and batch workloads.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a hands-on Head of People Operations who loves making things work well, every single day.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a hands-on Head of People Operations who loves making things work well, every single day. The foundations are already here: our HR systems, policies, and core processes are in place. What they need now is someone who'll sharpen them, make them consistent across every country we operate in, and keep them running smoothly as we grow.

This isn't a pure strategy role. You'll spend most of your time close to the work: advising managers on tricky employee relations cases, checking that a contract in Kenya meets local law, fixing the onboarding step that keeps tripping people up, and finding ways AI can take the admin off everyone's plate. You'll also own our yearly company offsite, from the agenda to the moment you open it on day one.

Equally vital, you will champion and embody our company culture. You will safeguard our core values, model them in daily interactions, and comfortably lead challenging discussions when expectations aren't met. Acting as a trusted advocate for employees with leadership, you will champion their interests while thoughtfully balancing staff needs, corporate values, and business priorities.

Job Details

  • Job Title: Head of People Operations
  • Reporting To: Chief Operating Officer
  • Grade: M7 (Head of)
  • Location: Remote in United Kingdom (but open to GMT +/- 3 hours time zone if you have UK HR Experience)
  • Compensation: 60,000-70,000 GBP but this will be adjusted to a local benchmark if you are based outside of the UK
  • Contract Structure: Permanent

Key Responsibilities

  • Culture carrier. You'll protect and live our culture and values every day, and hold others to them too. You'll run engagement surveys, turn the results into specific actions, and follow through, keeping our culture strong across a remote-first, multi-country team.
  • Employee relations. You'll be the go-to person for managers and staff regarding grievances, disciplinary matters, performance concerns, absences, and exits. You handle cases fairly, document them properly, and close them out, and you know when to bring in local counsel.
  • Multi-country compliance. You'll make sure our contracts, handbooks, and policies comply with employment law in each country where we hire, whether through our own entities or an Employer of Record. That means tracking legal changes, keeping country-specific terms up to date, and flagging risk early. As a project-based business, you'll also make sure people are classified correctly (permanent, fixed-term, project-funded, consultant or contractor) as projects start and end, with the right contracts, notice terms and exit processes for each.
  • Refining systems and processes. Most of what we need already exists. Your job is to audit it, spot the gaps, and tighten it up: onboarding, offboarding, probation, performance reviews, leave, contract changes, etc.
  • Using AI to work smarter. You'll look for practical ways AI can save time and improve quality across the people function, such as drafting initial versions of letters and policies, answering routine employee questions, cleaning up HR data, or summarising survey results. You'll roll these out safely, with clear guidance on data privacy.
  • People operations and HR data. You'll own the accuracy of our HRIS and people data, support payroll and benefits administration across countries, and produce clean, reliable reporting for the leadership team. Every process should be documented, owned, and easy to follow.
  • Annual company offsite. You'll lead the yearly offsite end-to-end: shaping the agenda with the leadership team, managing the venue, travel, visas, budget, and logistics, and hosting the sessions on the day. People should leave feeling more connected and clearer on where we're going.
  • Supporting managers. You'll coach managers through the people side of their jobs and give them simple tools, templates, and training so they can handle more on their own.
  • Clear, warm communication. You write clearly, explain policy in plain language, and can handle difficult conversations with empathy and directness.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 3 months: you've reviewed every core people process and policy, met each manager, most of the company, and shared a prioritised list of fixes with the leadership team.
  • By 6 months: the top-priority processes are refined, documented, and owned. Open employee relations cases are handled consistently, and managers and employees feel supported
  • By 9 months: at least two AI-supported workflows are live and saving the team measurable time, with guidance in place on how to use them safely.
  • By 12 months: you've delivered a well-run annual offsite that people rate highly, and managers say HR is fast, clear, and easy to work with.

Requirements

  • Solid HR generalist experience. You've got 7+ years in HR, with at least 2 years leading the people function or a significant part of it, including managing a small team. You'll lead 3 direct reports here.
  • Employee relations know-how. You've handled a wide range of ER cases yourself, from the first conversation to the final outcome, and you're confident, calm, and fair under pressure.
  • Labour law across multiple countries. You've worked with employment law in the UK but also in more than one jurisdiction and understand how contracts, notice periods, leave and termination rules differ between them. You know your way around Employer of Record models and when to call local counsel.
  • Project-based business experience. You understand how people work in organisations funded by projects or grants. You know the difference between permanent, fixed-term, project-funded and contractor roles, how to classify people correctly in each country, and how to manage contract renewals and endings when funding changes.
  • A process builder with an eye for detail. You can take a messy or inconsistent process and turn it into something simple and reliable. You notice the typo in the offer letter and the missing step in the leaver checklist, and you fix them.
  • Comfort with HR systems and AI tools. You're confident using an HRIS and comfortable experimenting with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot to make work faster and better. You can show us examples of where you've done it.
  • Event planning experience. You've planned and run in-person events, ideally a company offsite or retreat for 50+ people, including agenda design, logistics, budget and facilitation.
  • Clear, warm communication. You write clearly, explain policy in plain language and can handle difficult conversations with empathy and directness.
  • Happy to travel. You're comfortable travelling occasionally to our sites in Africa

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Africa. You've supported teams or employed people in African countries such as Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Ethiopia, and you understand local labour law, payroll and cultural context there.
  • Global health or NGO background. You've worked in a mission-driven organisation
  • CIPD Level 5 or above, or an equivalent HR qualification. Not required, but a plus.
  • UK-based. The role is fully remote, but a UK base would be ideal.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognised as a Great Place to Work, and a 2025 Best Workplace for Women amonst many other accolades.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance. As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network. We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you. We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, World Bank, Gavi, Save the Children, and other top players.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional Lead Generation Specialist to fuel our growth by connecting us with the companies that need great offshore teams the most.

If you're passionate about finding opportunities others miss, starting meaningful conversations, and helping businesses grow through great people, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you'll own the top of our sales funnel, from identifying the right companies through booking qualified meetings for our sales team. You'll build a predictable pipeline from scratch, targeting companies that could realistically hire offshore staff, and find the buying signals that show when a business is ready to build a remote team.

This is a highly autonomous role where you'll work closely with our sales team and internal leadership to test new channels, refine our ideal customer profile, and hand over opportunities that are warm, qualified, and ready to close.

Your success will be measured not only by the number of qualified meetings you generate, but also by the quality of those opportunities, your creativity in finding new ways to reach prospects, and the long-term clients they turn into.

What We're Looking For

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this role will be responsible for both creating and capturing demand through performance marketing, the website, account-based and signal-based programs, and the ops and analytics underneath all of it.

This isn't a traditional channel-manager role. We want someone who is part growth marketer and part "Gen" marketer: someone who builds AI agents and workflows to get the output of a much larger team, runs integrated campaigns instead of optimizing channels in isolation, and is comfortable producing and distributing their own campaign assets. You'll pull in contractors, agencies, and AI tools as needed, and you'll have real ownership of strategy, budget, and results.

Strategy and ownership

  • Growth Marketing Strategy: Set channel strategy and plan campaigns to meet pipeline and revenue goals.

  • Own the pipeline number: Set demand gen strategy, channel mix, and quarterly plans to hit pipeline and revenue targets.

  • Cross-functional partnership: Work with sales on target accounts, handoffs, and follow-ups; with product marketing on messaging and launches; and with events to convert leads into pipeline.

  • Own the martech stack: Build a modern tech stack and lead the way on experimenting and implementing new tactics and tools like automated outbound, signal-based campaigns, ABX tactics, etc.

Performance marketing

  • Paid search and paid social: Own strategy, execution, and budget across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and other paid channels, with clear efficiency targets.

  • Test and scale: Run a steady cadence of creative, audience, and offer experiments, cut what doesn't work, and scale what does.

Website, CRO, and search

  • Conversion: Own website conversion. Build landing pages, run A/B tests, and improve the paths from visit to demo.

  • SEO, AEO, and GEO: Grow organic discovery in both traditional search and LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) through technical optimization, structured content, and measurement.

ABX, signal-based, and outbound

  • Signal-based campaigns: Use intent, engagement, and first-party data to trigger timely, automated plays across ads, email, and outbound.

  • Outbound with SDRs: Design automated and signal-driven outbound sequences, build target lists, and work with SDRs/BDRs to turn engagement into meetings.

AI-first execution and campaign orchestration

  • Build with AI: Create AI agents and workflows for account research, outbound, campaign production, and reporting, and help the rest of the team adopt them.

  • Create and distribute: Produce campaign assets yourself (content, ads, emails, landing pages, social) with help from AI, and get the most out of existing content by repurposing and distributing it across channels.

About You

  • 7-10+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, primarily in demand generation or growth, at startups from Seed to Series C. Experience with a sales-led, ENT-focused motion is a plus.

  • Pipeline ownership: You've owned a marketing-sourced pipeline target and can talk through how you planned for it, what levers you’ve pulled to hit it, and what you'd do differently.

  • Performance marketing depth: Hands-on experience running and scaling paid search and paid social, including managing budget and improving CAC.

  • Web, CRO, and search: Experience improving website conversion, and driving meaningful growth through SEO, AEO, and GEO.

  • Maker instincts: You can write and produce solid campaign assets with AI's help, and you care about quality.

  • ABX and signal-based experience: You've built account-based programs and used intent or engagement signals to trigger campaigns and outbound.

  • Ops and analytics: You can run HubSpot and a modern martech stack without help, from attribution and routing to dashboards leadership trusts.

  • AI builder: You've built AI agents or workflows (in tools like Clay, n8n, Zapier, or with LLM APIs) that made you or your team measurably faster. Bring examples.

  • Strategic and scrappy: You're as comfortable setting strategy as you are building in the tools yourself. You like ambiguity, test constantly, and hold a high bar.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Workplace Management team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

This role provides senior HSEQ leadership across Ramboll’s EPC/EPCM project portfolio in Ramboll Americas, supporting the safe delivery of complex engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and turnover activities. The role is responsible for establishing consistent HSEQ governance, aligning contractors and project teams, supporting high-risk work planning, and enabling effective execution across multiple concurrent projects. The successful candidate will bring significant hands-on experience from large-scale EPC/EPCM construction environments and will be able to operate confidently at both strategic and field execution levels.

The ideal candidate will be a credible HSEQ leader with significant field experience on large-scale construction or EPC/EPCM projects, strong contractor management capability, and the confidence to influence senior project, client, and contractor stakeholders. They will be comfortable working across multiple projects, balancing strategic governance with practical field-based support, and helping project teams create consistent, risk-based HSEQ execution.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Strategic HSEQ Leadership

  • Lead the development of a portfolio-wide HSEQ approach that enables consistent standards, scalable processes, and project-specific execution across all EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Serve as primary HSEQ advisor to Project Directors and EPC/EPCM leadership teams.
  • Drive adoption of Ramboll’s HSEQ program and translate its expectations into practical project-level behaviours, controls, and leadership routines.
  • Provide strategic HSEQ guidance during proposals and contract negotiations to align client expectations and establish the conditions needed for effective safety management.
  • Provide HSEQ leadership within an EPC/EPCM delivery model, ensuring clear boundaries, responsibilities, and interfaces between Ramboll, clients, construction contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Safety Program Organization & Implementation
  • Define HSEQ organization structures that are scalable with the ability to support multi-project EPC/EPCM delivery on a nationwide basis.
  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, and governance models required for integrated EPC/EPCM/ safety programs.
  • Establish standardized HSEQ execution plans across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
  • Establish construction readiness expectations, including contractor mobilisation, competency assurance, risk review, and field execution controls.

  • Contractor & Multi-Party Coordination

  • Align HSEQ expectations, execution standards, and performance requirements across contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and third-party stakeholders.
  • Lead contractor onboarding, alignment sessions, audits, and recurring performance reviews.
  • Ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded into contracting strategies, procurement packages, bid documents, mobilisation plans, and contractor management processes.
  • Support project teams in translating Ramboll and client HSEQ requirements into practical field execution requirements for contractors and subcontractors.

  • Risk Management, Governance and Assurance

  • Provide governance and assurance over EPC/EPCM risk management processes, including hazard identification, construction risk assessments, high-risk work reviews, and site controls.
  • Support project HSEQ resources and project leadership in establishing consistent risk management expectations, while ensuring accountability remains clear within the project delivery structure.
  • Review and challenge the effectiveness of controls for high-risk activities, including lifting, electrical work, confined space entry, work at height, ground disturbance, energisation, commissioning, and simultaneous operations.
  • Provide oversight, escalation support, and subject matter input for high-potential or higher-severity incidents, ensuring investigations are completed and lessons learned are embedded across relevant projects.
  • Conduct site visits, leadership engagements, and assurance reviews to verify that project HSEQ controls are effective, understood, and consistently applied by the relevant project teams and contractors.

  • Safety Culture & Engagement

  • Demonstrate visible HSEQ leadership that builds trust, accountability, and proactive safety behaviours across project teams and contractors.
  • Coach project and contractor leadership teams to strengthen leading indicators, reinforce expectations, and promote consistent safety leadership.
  • Promote open communication, psychological safety, learning, and continuous improvement across the EPC/EPCM project portfolio.

  • Regulatory & Compliance Oversight

  • Provide oversight of compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, client requirements, and Ramboll HSEQ standards across EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Support project teams in translating regulatory and contractual HSEQ requirements into practical controls and assurance activities.
  • Represent Ramboll in client audits, regulatory inspections, and EPC/EPCM governance meetings, ensuring actions are effectively tracked, communicated, and closed.

  • Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish consistent HSEQ performance reporting across EPC/EPCM projects, using leading and lagging indicators to identify trends, drive accountability, and improve performance.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for project leadership, clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive on-site HSEQ leadership experience with substantial large-scale EPC/EPCM project exposure.
  • Strong background supporting multi-contractor, high-risk industrial construction environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Proven experience supporting construction management delivery models where HSEQ performance is delivered through contractor execution and strong client/contractor interface management.
  • Working knowledge of construction-phase HSEQ controls, contractor management, incident investigation, assurance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to travel regularly to project locations and engage effectively with field teams, project leadership, clients, and contractors.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

  • Professional certifications (CSP, CMIOSH, NEBOSH, CRSP, or equivalent).
  • Experience with energy transition, power, renewables, industrial de-carbonisation, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, or major infrastructure projects.
  • Experience supporting owner’s EPC/EPCM models across multiple concurrent projects.
  • International or remote project experience.

What we can offer you

  • Investment in your development
  • Being valued for the unique person you are
  • Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $136,497 - $197,515 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
