jobs.description:
Sr. Manager / Director, Balance & Emerging Products

MoneyGram — Digital (MGO) — Remote-Friendly

About MoneyGram

MoneyGram is one of the most trusted names in global payments, serving over 50 million customers a year across 200+ countries through nearly 500,000 retail locations and a rapidly expanding digital platform. We process billions annually and are in the middle of one of the most compelling transformations in global fintech.

We are moving beyond send and receive. On our new app infrastructure, MoneyGram is becoming a multi-product financial super-app – bringing together money transfer, balance, bill pay, mobile top-up, and marketplace offers into a single, seamless digital experience. Balance is the newest of those products, the least proven, and the one we most need to get right.

The Opportunity

Millions of customers use MoneyGram Online to send money. Now they can use MoneyGram for so much more – including Balance, our stored-value account, which is live, early and not yet adopted at the rate it should be.

The Director of Balance & Emerging Products owns the business side of everything MoneyGram Online does that is not money transfer: Balance, Domestic and International Bill Pay, and Mobile Top-Up. Balance is the priority. Your first job is to work out who it is for, why they are not using it, and what has to change — then prove it with a cohort that repeats and build the go-to-market motion that scales it.

This is not a product role. Product leads own the roadmaps. This is the commercial seat: market selection, pricing, adoption and the cohort economics that tell us whether growth compounds. If you think in LTV and stacked cohorts, and you have taken a consumer financial product from early to working, this is an opportunity to launch something zero to one on top of a customer base most fintechs spend years trying to build.

What You Will Do

Cross-Product Growth

  • Own the business strategy for Balance, Domestic Bill Pay, International Bill Pay and Mobile Top-Up, partnering with each product lead.
  • Identify where customers are dropping off or not adopting additional products, and work with product and CRM to address friction.
  • Represent the customer perspective in product prioritization discussions — connecting roadmap decisions to retention and ARPU outcomes.
  • Partner with the Global CRM and Marketing leads to design lifecycle journeys, cross-sell campaigns, and re-engagement programs.
  • Primary early focus will be launching our new flagship product Balance – defining the business model, diagnosing current adoption challenges, and building the first cohorts of customers.

Market Selection & Go-to-Market

  • Choose and sequence launch markets for each emerging product, and defend the choice on customer behavior, competitive set, regulatory requirements and cost to serve.
  • Design the launch playbook – positioning, funding methods, partnerships, lifecycle messaging — and make it repeatable market to market.
  • Work with local market leads and Retail to use what MoneyGram already knows about these customers.

Pricing

  • Own pricing strategy for Balance and the broader emerging product suite, setting and testing it with the Pricing team.
  • Build the model that connects pricing to adoption, retention and contribution, including where we give up fee revenue to win the relationship and drive higher money transfer engagement.
  • Track competitive positioning in each priority market.

Cohorts, LTV & Measurement

  • Own the analytical frameworks – cohort retention, multi-product adoption curves, LTV and ARPU by segment and market.
  • Build the models yourself and use them to decide where to invest and where to stop.
  • Partner with Global CRM to turn strategy into lifecycle journeys, cross-sell campaigns and in-app placement, and own the loop from results back to strategy.
  • Present performance and recommendations to senior leadership.

Who You Are

Experience

  • 5-8 years in consumer fintech, remittance, digital financial services or an adjacent consumer business.
  • Has taken a consumer financial product or remittance market from early adoption to repeatable growth, with specific cohort results you can speak to.
  • Track record of improving customer retention, increasing ARPU, or driving multi-product adoption – with specific, measurable results.
  • Experience with stored value, wallets, cards or accounts – you understand how these products earn and what makes customers fund them, preferred.

Capabilities

  • Analytical – comfortable with cohort analysis, LTV modeling, and engagement metrics; can build the framework, not just read the dashboard.
  • Strategic – can identify which customer segments and product combinations represent the largest opportunity, and build a credible plan to capture it.
  • Collaborative – works effectively with product, CRM, and marketing teams without needing to own them; earns influence through quality of thinking.
  • Clear communicator – can present a retention strategy to a CFO and write a CRM campaign brief in the same week.

Why MoneyGram, Why Now

MoneyGram has a customer base most fintech companies spend years trying to build – financially underserved consumers with real, recurring financial needs and an existing reason to trust us. We have the platform, the product suite and the intent to serve them far more deeply than we do today. Balance is the clearest expression of that and the least figured out. This role is a rare opportunity to be at the center of that transformation: building the playbook for how MoneyGram grows from a transaction company into a financial relationship company. If that challenge excites you, we’d like to talk.

WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

The Brand Experiences team at Hallmark is dedicated to creating large-scale, emotionally resonant experiences that bring the brand to life for fans and consumers. From the Hallmark Christmas Cruise to the Hallmark Stars Live, we design and deliver immersive, joy-filled moments that deepen brand love and build lasting connections with audiences. We are experience architects and strategic storytellers who translate Hallmark’s iconic brand into real-world events that celebrate connection, inspire joy, and bring the brand’s emotional essence to life. Our work is high-profile, high-impact, and deeply rooted in creating meaningful moments that resonate with fans and leave lasting impressions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO & HOW IT SHAPES OUR SUCCESS

The Brand Experiences Manager plays a key role in executing strategic, consumer-facing events that bring the Hallmark brand to life in immersive and emotionally resonant ways. This role manages two event team members and is responsible for delivering high-profile experiences such as the Hallmark Christmas Cruise, the Hallmark Stars Live, and future brand activations that deepen consumer engagement and drive business results. They will collaborate closely with brand experience leadership, senior stakeholders, and internal and external partners to ensure every experience reflects Hallmark’s iconic identity and delivers measurable results.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Strategic Planning & Leadership: Partner with brand experience leadership to develop strategic plans for revenue-generating consumer events that align with brand and business goals.
  • Event Execution & Oversight: Lead the planning and execution of large-scale, immersive brand experiences. Make informed decisions on logistics, vendor coordination, programming, and on-site operations to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Team Leadership: Manage and mentor two event team members, providing clear direction, support, and accountability throughout the execution process.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to ensure alignment and seamless execution across all touchpoints.
  • Budget & Performance Management: Support budget oversight; track KPIs, evaluate event performance, and apply insights to improve future execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for senior leaders, business partners, and vendors- communicating progress, resolving issues, and ensuring transparency.
  • Operational Excellence: Apply best practices and internal learnings to drive efficiency, consistency, and continuous improvement in event delivery.

This role is essential to Hallmark’s future as it ensures that strategic brand experiences are executed with excellence- strengthening consumer relationships, expanding brand reach, and reinforcing Hallmark’s leadership in meaningful connection.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree or 4 years professional work experience
  • At least 7 years of experience in event development, brand experiences, and or management 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume will stand out if you have the following:

  • Experience leading, managing and developing a team (e.g., direct reports).
  • Experience with online registration and event application development.
  • Strong strategic thinking and visionary planning capabilities, with the ability to execute complex projects that involve multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills, including the ability to translate complex business strategies into clear and impactful messaging.
  • Solid understanding of various, complex audiences and the nuanced, authentic ways the Hallmark brand comes to life for each audience.
  • Proven record of leading complex projects with multiple business partners and external stakeholders.
  • Business acumen and the ability to present plans (including a financial business case) and opportunities with individuals at higher levels in the organization
  • Exhibit corporate and interpersonal savvy and confidence leading projects and partners under tight timelines and high-pressure situations.
  • Event or project management certification.
  • Prior experience organizing branded consumer experiences and programs
  • Prior experience with cruises, theater and/or entertainment tours
  • Exemplary communication (verbal, written, consulting) and organization skills
  • Commands a fast paced, high volume of change environment requiring real-time adjustment and problem solving.
  • Effectively works with diverse audiences.
  • Personal leadership skills: self-motivated, high degree of personal accountability, leads beyond their role, resilient and positive attitude.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States. If based in Kansas City, this position offers a hybrid work arrangement, giving you the best of both worlds: collaborating in person at Hallmark Headquarters in Kansas City, MO and enjoying the flexibility of working remotely. Some meetings required in-person, many can be remote.
  • The salary range for this role is $105k - $120k. Final compensation varies based on several factors
  • This role is eligible for Hallmark’s Annual Incentive Plan. More information will be shared during the interview process.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

COME JOIN US! Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark- just follow the instructions below to apply.

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF. 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment.

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please.

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

jobs.description:
The Utilization Management Registered Nurseis responsible for performing utilization review activities in compliance with federal and state regulations, URAC standards, and Guidehealth policies. This role applies established medical necessity criteria to obtain, analyze, and accurately document clinical information from medical records in support of utilization determinations.

The UMRN works collaboratively with providers, medical directors, and internal teams to ensure timely, compliant, and high-quality review processes.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Utilization Review & Clinical Determinations

  • Performing timely reviews of healthcare services, including precertification and concurrent reviews, using approved medical necessity criteria.
  • Accurately documenting clinical findings, criteria application, and determinations in accordance with regulatory and accreditation standards.
  • Communicating review determinations (written and/or verbal) to providers, members, and other required parties within established timeframes.

Clinical Collaboration

  • Collaborating with the Medical Director and Peer Reviewer(s) on cases requiring further review of:
    • Medical necessity
    • Appropriate treatment plans
    • Intensity and duration of inpatient or outpatient services
    • Quality of care concerns
  • Interfacing routinely with ordering providers and provider organizations; communicate with members or their representatives when appropriate.
  • Integrating of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into daily workflow. Offer feedback and assist in ‘teaching’ AI to make AI tools more reliable and user-friendly.

Care Coordination & Quality Support

  • Initiating referrals of identified patients to disease management or population health programs to support continuity and quality of care.
  • Participating in quality management activities and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Assisting in the development of UM/PHM Committee materials and packets, including review of cases impacting performance metrics and identification of trends within assigned IPA(s).

Compliance & Professional Standards

  • Maintaining strict confidentiality of member information and case documentation.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with federal and state regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions and medical groups.
  • Integrating current knowledge of medical group guidelines and URAC standards into daily review activities.
  • Maintaining continued professional growth and education consistent with current nursing practice standards and the Illinois Nurse Practice Act.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED FOR SUCCESS

  • Registered Nurse with an active and unrestricted Illinois State License.
  • Three years of experience in a variety of health care settings.
  • Knowledge of utilization review, managed care, and community health.
  • The State of Illinois requires Nursing Professional Staff to complete 20 hours of CE per 2-year license renewal cycle.
  • Computer skills including Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc).
  • Strong organizational, writing, and speaking skills are necessary.
  • Ability to prioritize and react based on rapidly changing business needs.
  • Excellent clinical judgment, compassion, and a positive attitude.

WHAT WE'D LOVE FOR YOU TO HAVE

  • Interest in Informatics
  • Knowledge in Population Health and Disparities
  • Previous Health insurance experience

Sales Process & Operational Excellence

jobs.excerpt: We are recruiting outstanding Research Interns to work on autonomous vehicles, robotics, and physical AI!
jobs.description:
We are recruiting outstanding Research Interns to work on autonomous vehicles, robotics, and physical AI! Intelligent machines that can perceive, reason, and safely interact with people and the physical world are rapidly becoming a reality. Self-driving cars, autonomous delivery and construction vehicles, mobile manipulators, and other robotic systems are moving closer to widespread deployment. However, fundamental research challenges remain before these systems can operate safely, reliably, and autonomously in complex, unfamiliar environments.

For example, how can we:

  • Develop new training paradigms that use perception and interaction to train autonomous vehicle and robot policies in closed loop?
  • Equip autonomous systems with online and offline assurances that meet the requirements of safety-critical applications?
  • Enable vehicles and robots to navigate across new environments, tasks, and embodiments?
  • Build systems that reason under uncertainty and interact safely and naturally with people and other agents?

These are some of the exciting questions being explored by NVIDIA’s Autonomous Systems and Physical AI Research (ASPIRE) group. Our diverse, interdisciplinary team conducts foundational research spanning foundation model design, embodied reasoning, safety, closed-loop training and evaluation, and agentic workflows for Physical AI development. We also investigate related areas including decision-making under uncertainty, deep learning, reinforcement learning, simulation, and the verification and validation of safety-critical AI systems. Our focus is on fundamental research, and lab members are encouraged to publish their work and open-source their code. NVIDIA is known for its collaborative culture, and our researchers work closely with experts across the company in autonomous vehicles, robotics, perception, simulation, and machine learning. This creates opportunities to influence real-world products while retaining the freedom and bandwidth to conduct groundbreaking, publishable research.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Designing and implementing cutting-edge techniques for autonomous vehicles, robotics, and physical AI.
  • Conducting original research and publishing your results.
  • Collaborating with research colleagues, internal product teams, and external researchers.
  • Transferring technology you’ve developed to relevant product groups.

What we need to see:

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Relevant research experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, embodied AI, or autonomous systems.
  • Strong knowledge of the theory and practice of vehicle or robot autonomy—or expertise in a related area, with a strong interest in applying your work to autonomous systems.
  • A track record of research excellence, demonstrated through publications at leading conferences and journals—such as RSS, ICRA, CoRL, IJRR, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, TAC, etc.—and through other research artifacts such as open-source software.
  • Exceptional Python programming skills; experience with C++ and parallel programming, such as CUDA, is a plus.
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills are required, along with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, research-focused team.

Are you intellectually curious, collaborative, and motivated to solve complex problems at the intersection of AI and the physical world? If so, you may be a great fit for NVIDIA.

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We are looking for Outbound Sales Representatives to support a variety of projects while representing some of the most recognizable brands in the world. In this role, you will make outbound calls to prospective customers and upsell existing products and services while providing excellent customer service. If you believe you have a positive and persuasive personality and have the drive to succeed, this is the career for you! With our industry-leading training program, you are sure to thrive and grow.

To be considered for this position, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

WHAT DOES SOMEONE IN THIS ROLE ACTUALLY DO?

This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure a best-in-class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer satisfaction, you will need to be a confident, fully engaged team player who is dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle inbound and outbound contacts in a courteous, timely, and professional manner.
  • Utilize knowledge base and training to accurately answer customer questions and sell appropriate products and services.
  • Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues.
  • Research systems to find missing information; coordinate with other departments to resolve issues as applicable
  • Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks.
  • Accurately document and process customer orders in appropriate systems.
  • Follow all required scripts, policies, and procedures.
  • Comply with requirements surrounding confidential information and personal information.
  • Escalate customer issues to the appropriate staff and managers for resolution as needed.
  • Attend meetings and training and review all new training material to stay up to date on program knowledge, systems, and process changes.
  • Adhere to all attendance and work schedule requirements.

STANDARD QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

We provide all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. This position relies on building relationships and turning the knowledge, you gain in training into customer wins. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
  • The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Basic understanding of Windows operating system
  • Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues
  • An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem-solving, and negotiation
  • Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)
  • Ability to multi-task, stay focused, and self-manage
  • Strong team orientation and customer focus
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

Preferred (Not Required)

  • One (1) year of experience in customer service, technical support, inside sales, back-office, chat, or administrative support in a contact center environment
  • State or Federal work experience

CONDITIONS

All MCI Locations

  • Must be authorized to work in the country where the job is based.

Subject to the program and location of the position

  • Must be willing to submit up to a LEVEL II background and/or security investigation with a fingerprint. Job offers are contingent on background/security investigation results.
  • Must be willing to submit to drug screening. Job offers are contingent on drug screening results.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

COMPENSATION, BENEFITS, INCENTIVES, AND REWARDS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Incentives & Rewards: Participate in daily, weekly, and monthly contests that include cash bonuses and prizes ranging from electronics to dream vacations and sometimes even cars!
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage after 60 days of employment, and all employees have access to MEC medical plans after just 30 days. Benefit options vary by location.
  • Retirement Savings: Secure your future with retirement savings programs, where available.
  • Disability Insurance: Short-term disability coverage is available to help protect you during unexpected challenges.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
  • Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
  • Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

DIVERSITY AND EQUALITY

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity benefits our employees, company, customers, and community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees are responsible for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal-opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, MCI's policy is to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees with protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment. If reasonable accommodations are needed, please contact Human Resources.

ABOUT MCI (PARENT COMPANY)

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines. Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. jobs.description:
About Bamboo Works

Bamboo Works helps growing companies and ambitious entrepreneurs build global teams without handling recruitment themselves. We place vetted, English-fluent professionals, from service and support staff to accountants, engineers, and marketers, who work as part of our clients' onshore teams. Our services range from single specialist placements to fully managed offshore departments and recruitment-as-a-service. We've served 200+ clients so far and invest in our people through our own AI Academy. We were built remotely on purpose, and we care about the quality of each hire more than the number of hires.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional Lead Generation Specialist to fuel our growth by connecting us with the companies that need great offshore teams the most.

If you're passionate about finding opportunities others miss, starting meaningful conversations, and helping businesses grow through great people, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you'll own the top of our sales funnel, from identifying the right companies through booking qualified meetings for our sales team. You'll build a predictable pipeline from scratch, targeting companies that could realistically hire offshore staff, and find the buying signals that show when a business is ready to build a remote team.

This is a highly autonomous role where you'll work closely with our sales team and internal leadership to test new channels, refine our ideal customer profile, and hand over opportunities that are warm, qualified, and ready to close.

Your success will be measured not only by the number of qualified meetings you generate, but also by the quality of those opportunities, your creativity in finding new ways to reach prospects, and the long-term clients they turn into.

Role Details

Commitment: Part-Time/Full-Time
Working Hours: Flexible with overlap across international clients
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Start Date: ASAP
Monthly Rate: Competitive rate based on experience, consisting of base pay + high incentives

What You'll Do

  • Build a steady flow of qualified meetings with companies looking to hire offshore staff.
  • Define and refine the ideal customer profile. Spot buying signals (hiring activity, growth triggers, operational strain) that show when a company is ready to offshore.
  • Run outreach across email, LinkedIn, phone, and less conventional channels. Test, measure, and double down on what converts.
  • Qualify and warm up prospects so our sales team receives opportunities that are ready to close.
  • Keep our CRM clean and accurate. Report full-funnel metrics from first touch through closed client, and use them to improve results month over month.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • At least 3 years in B2B lead generation, with a proven record of generating clients for a staffing, recruitment, outsourcing, or BPO firm itself (not for one of its clients).
  • You can share real funnel numbers, including outreach volume, reply rates, meetings booked, show-up rates, and closed clients, as well as the KPIs you were held to.
  • You can build targeted lead lists and find buying signals on your own. You're creative with outreach and don't depend on an expensive stack of paid tools.
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one CRM (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zoho) and keep detailed, up-to-date prospect and opportunity records.
  • You write and speak English excellently, and you're comfortable owning targets independently in a fully remote setup.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience running qualification or discovery calls before handing prospects over to sales
  • Familiarity with the Western SMB market (US, UK, EU, AU) and its offshore hiring needs
  • Experience with cold calling or appointment-setting software
  • Experience with corporate markets, such as accounting
  • Uses AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Clay, etc.) to speed up research and personalization
  • Experience with outreach beyond cold email and LinkedIn, such as partnerships, referrals, events, communities, or content-led prospecting

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Is driven by targets and motivated by seeing the pipeline grow.
  • Takes ownership of results rather than waiting for leads to come to them.
  • Spots opportunities and buying signals that others miss.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where you're building from scratch.
  • Handles rejection with resilience and keeps outreach consistent day after day.
  • Gets creative with outreach instead of relying on expensive tools or one-size-fits-all templates.
  • Balances high activity with high-quality, well-qualified opportunities.
  • Is data-driven, tracking every number in the funnel and using it to improve.
  • Enjoys starting conversations with business owners and understands how great offshore talent helps companies grow.

Why Join Bamboo Works?

  • Join a growing international company with ambitious expansion plans.
  • Work directly with businesses across multiple industries and countries.
  • Build meaningful, long-term client relationships where your work has visible impact.
  • Collaborate with a supportive, high-performing remote team.
  • Enjoy a high degree of autonomy, trust, and ownership in your role.
  • Benefit from a competitive base salary plus high incentives.
  • Work directly with company founders

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview
  2. Interview with the Founders
  3. Offer & Onboarding

We're looking for a LinkedIn executive content writer to run our executive content program for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Our buyers, founders and operators, spend their professional attention on LinkedIn, and our executives reach more of them than any company page.

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen deines Pflichtpraktikums steigst du ins Marketing eines wachsenden B2B-SaaS-Unternehmens ein und lernst, wie Kampagnen, Events und Kundenkommunikation geplant, umgesetzt und datenbasiert gesteuert werden.

Konkret übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

  • HandwerkNext-Veranstaltungen: Du unterstützt bei Planung, Bewerbung und Nachbereitung unserer HandwerkNext-Events, von der Einladungskampagne über die Teilnehmerkommunikation bis zur Auswertung. Zwei Reisen zu den Veranstaltungen sind fest eingeplant, und du bist vor Ort dabei.
  • E-Mail- und Kampagnenmarketing: Du erstellst Newsletter, Mailings und In-App-Nachrichten, schreibst Texte, die unsere Zielgruppe im Handwerk ansprechen, und setzt A/B-Tests auf.

  • Marketing im CRM: Du pflegst Kontakte, Listen und Segmente in HubSpot, damit die richtige Botschaft bei den richtigen Leuten ankommt.
  • Marketing-Automatisierung: Du baust und testest automatisierte E-Mail-Strecken und Nurturing-Abläufe, ganz ohne Programmierung und direkt in HubSpot.
  • Eigenes Projekt: In der zweiten Hälfte deines Praktikums übernimmst du ein abgrenzbares Marketingthema mit sichtbarem Ergebnis, zum Beispiel eine Event-Kampagne für HandwerkNext oder eine Onboarding-Mailstrecke für Neukunden.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Du stehst kurz vor dem Studienabschluss – idealerweise in BWL, Marketing, Vertrieb oder Kommunikations- & Medienwissenschaften.
  • Du brauchst ein Pflichtpraktikum – und willst in der Zeit wirklich etwas bewegen, nicht nur Meetings protokollieren.
  • Strukturiert und systematisch zu arbeiten ist für dich kein Zwang, sondern dein natürlicher Modus.
  • Deutsch beherrschst du sicher in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern packst Dinge eigenständig an.
  • Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern aktiv an unseren Marketingkampagnen und Events mitwirken – in einem Team, das Tempo mag.

Praktikumsdauer: Die Dauer des Praktikums richtet sich nach den Vorgaben deiner Universität.

Benefits

Unser Angebot:

  • Remote-First: Arbeite, von wo du willst – zuhause, unterwegs oder in unserem Coworking Space in Bochum.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Feste Kernzeiten fürs Team, den Rest gestaltest du so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt.
  • Start-up-Feeling: Du bist von Tag eins an mittendrin statt nur dabei – deine Meinung zählt wirklich.
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding: Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser – wir bringen dir das nötige Know-how gezielt bei, damit du schnell loslegst.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Marketing Manager und bekommst Einblicke, die du im Studium so nicht bekommst.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin und die geplante Dauer deines Praktikums – am einfachsten über das Formular.

Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schreib uns stattdessen zwei, drei Sätze: Was interessiert dich am Marketing, und welches Tool hast du dir schon mal selbst beigebracht?

Weil es sich um ein Pflichtpraktikum handelt, brauchen wir außerdem den Auszug aus deiner Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung, in dem das Praktikum und seine Dauer vorgeschrieben sind. Den kannst du nachreichen.

Du hörst innerhalb von fünf Werktagen von uns.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator who can clarify requirements, shape solution approaches, guide distributed teams and keep delivery moving from discovery through launch.

This is not a pure software-development role. Strong technical fluency and hands-on delivery experience are required, but success depends more on systems thinking, stakeholder alignment, clear written and verbal communication, and sound product judgment than on writing large volumes of code.

What you will do

  • Lead discovery with business, product, data, security, and engineering stakeholders; convert ambiguous needs into clear use cases, requirements, acceptance criteria, risks, and delivery plans.

  • Act as the connective layer among teams in India, Europe, and North American Central and Pacific time zones, creating crisp decisions, handoffs, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Shape solution designs for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Guide prototypes and production implementations, making pragmatic tradeoffs across user value, model quality, latency, cost, security, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Partner with engineers and architects on interfaces, data flows, integrations, deployment patterns, and operational readiness; contribute code or technical artifacts when it accelerates delivery.

  • Own stakeholder-facing demos and the supporting demo sites and environments, including setup, access, content and data readiness, reliability, presentation quality, and ongoing maintenance; lead stakeholder updates and technical workshops.

  • Define meaningful success measures and evaluation approaches for AI quality, safety, adoption, and business impact.

  • Stay current on rapidly changing AI capabilities and translate new developments into practical recommendations rather than technology for its own sake.

Required qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in software, data, ML/AI, solutions engineering, technical product delivery, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated senior-level ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives, including driving decisions and delivery across multiple phases rather than contributing only to isolated technical tasks.

  • Demonstrated delivery experience with at least one generative AI system, such as RAG, AI agents, copilots, semantic search, or LLM-enabled workflow automation. Candidates need not have built every component alone, but must clearly explain their contribution and the system’s end-to-end behavior.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication, including the ability to explain technical choices to nontechnical stakeholders and business context to engineers.

  • Experience eliciting requirements, resolving ambiguity, prioritizing scope, defining acceptance criteria, and driving cross-functional execution.

  • Working knowledge of modern generative AI patterns: prompt and context design, embeddings and retrieval, agent/tool orchestration, model selection, evaluation, safety controls, observability, and production operations.

  • Ability to review architecture and code, troubleshoot across system boundaries, and produce lightweight prototypes or examples. Deep specialization in application coding is not required.

  • Experience collaborating across countries and time zones, with disciplined asynchronous documentation and handoffs.

  • Practical understanding of enterprise concerns including data privacy, security, access control, responsible AI, compliance, cost, and reliability.

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with AWS generative AI services, especially Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

  • Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions architecture, technical program leadership, consulting, sales engineering, or product ownership role.

  • Experience establishing AI evaluation sets, quality metrics, red-team practices, guardrails, monitoring, or production feedback loops.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, vector databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD.

  • Experience facilitating executive or customer-facing workshops and turning outcomes into an executable product or engineering backlog.

Working model

Preferred location: Eastern (or) Central U.S. time zones, or a location with meaningful overlap across those hours. The role requires planned overlap with colleagues in India and Europe. Flexibility for occasional early or late meetings is expected; sustainable schedules and strong asynchronous practices are equally important.

What success looks like

  • Stakeholders understand what is being built, why it matters, and how success will be measured.

  • Distributed teams receive timely decisions, complete context, and low-friction handoffs.

  • AI concepts move from discovery to production with clear quality, safety, cost, and operational criteria.

  • The role earns trust across product, engineering, and business groups by communicating candidly and delivering predictably.

A Little Bit About Our Team:

The Record to Report (RTR) Accounting Team serves as the central operational backbone for financial integrity, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial reporting across Warner Music Group.

Operating within our Shared Services / Global Business Services framework, the Recorded Music RTR team provides specialized accounting expertise, revenue assurance, and critical month-end closing support across WMG’s renowned domestic and international record labels. We work with the GBS Revenue Team translating complex data into accurate financial reporting under US GAAP.

Your Role:

As the leadRevenue Accountant for Recorded Music, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for our recorded music revenue accounting life cycle. This role bridges technical accounting, data analytics, and financial systems design. You will take ownership of the end-to-end accounting for high-volume, multi-source revenue streams, drive compliance with ASC 606, spearhead systems automation, and unlock actionable financial insights through advanced data mining. In addition to technical execution, you will provide training and education to other members of the Recorded Music RTR team.


Here you'll get to:

  • Lead the technical accounting, accrual modeling, and reconciliation for all Recorded Music revenue streams, including Digital Streaming Partners (Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon), Digital Downloads, DMCA statutory royalties, Physical manufacturing and distribution (vinyl, CD, merch), Synchronization (film, TV, gaming, advertising), Master Licensing, and foreign affiliate distributions.
  • Architect and maintain robust ASC 606 recognition schedules, monthly flash revenue accruals, deferred revenue tracking, and automated reversals based on consumption ingestion files vs. actual cash settlements.
  • Query, clean, and analyze Revenue Operational Reporting datasets across disparate DSPs using Analysis for Office and Gemini AI Tools. Reconcile Multi-System Reporting from Source to Financial Ledger.
  • Bridge consumption metadata (streams, downloads, play counts, tier rates) with transactional general ledger activity to detect anomalies, underreported royalties, missing catalog codes, and system mismatches.
  • Conduct granular month-over-month (MoM) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) variance analyses; present variance drivers to label finance leaders.
  • Serve as the RTR business lead for financial systems optimization across SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), BlackLine, and proprietary music revenue sub-ledgers.
  • Design, test, and implement automated reporting simplify manual journal entries and compress the monthly close cycle.
  • Direct the monthly and quarterly close deliverables for recorded music revenue, reviewing high-volume journal entries, complex accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Review work products prepared by staff accountants and offshore shared service partners (e.g., Shopify D2C sales tie-outs, DSP settlement matching, clearing account reconciliations), providing structured guidance and establishing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Actively investigate and resolve persistent balances in revenue clearing, suspense, and partner withholding accounts.
  • Maintain and enhance internal control matrices under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404), ensuring proper segregation of duties, automated validation checks, and data lineage documentation.
  • Serve as primary revenue audit liaison for internal and external auditors (e.g., Big 4), providing PBC audit schedules, roll-forwards, sample testing support, and technical accounting memos.
  • Partner proactively with Label Finance VPs/Directors, Commercial Revenue Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, IT/Data Engineering, and Corporate Royalty teams to align accounting treatments with evolving contract structures and deal terms.

About you:

  • Active CPA license (or international equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Master’s Degree (MAcc, MBA) or coursework in Financial Data Analytics / Information Systems is a significant plus.

  • Extensive specialization (7+ years) in high-volume revenue accounting, billing assurance, or royalty accounting within the music, digital entertainment, streaming media, or intellectual property/licensing sectors.
  • Proven track record leading technical ASC 606 revenue recognition implementations or oversight for complex multi-element arrangements.
  • Demonstrable experience directing and reviewing work performed by distributed, hybrid, or offshore delivery centers.
  • Deep experience working with enterprise ERPs (specifically SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA) and automated balance sheet reconciliation tools (such as BlackLine or Cadency).
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel proficiency (SAP Analysis for Office, Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, advanced nested logic).
  • Experience with eCommerce and digital billing platforms (e.g., Shopify, DSP vendor reporting portals) is highly desirable.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Ability to untangle intricate data anomalies and synthesize findings into clear executive summaries.
  • Proactive drive to evaluate status-quo manual workflows and design scalable, automated alternatives.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate across label executives, data engineers, and external auditors.
  • Proven capacity to manage high-pressure close deadlines and competing stakeholder requests with composure and precision.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. In this role, you will serve as a critical point of contact for healthcare professionals, providing application support for clinical systems used in hospitals and healthcare organizations.

You will work in a 24x7x365 service desk environment, assisting clinicians and healthcare customers with application issues, access requests, workflow questions, and technical incidents. The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with excellent communication, customer service, and problem-solving abilities.

This is an excellent opportunity for a service desk professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to apply their technical expertise within the healthcare technology industry.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide Level 1/Level 2 service desk support to healthcare customers and clinical users.
  • Handle inbound calls and support requests in a high-volume, customer-focused call center environment.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving clinical applications and systems, including Epic, Cerner, McKesson, Meditech, and other healthcare applications.
  • Assist users with:
    • Application errors and functionality issues
    • Clinical workflow questions
    • User access and authentication issues
    • Technical troubleshooting and incident resolution
  • Accurately document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions in the service management system.
  • Resolve incidents within established service levels or appropriately escalate issues to specialized support teams.
  • Take ownership of incidents through resolution while maintaining a strong customer-service focus.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with clinicians, healthcare staff, technical teams, and internal stakeholders.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where priorities may change quickly.
  • Follow established processes, procedures, security requirements, and service-level expectations.
  • Participate in training and ongoing learning to maintain knowledge of supported applications and technologies.

Schedule & Work Environment

Because our healthcare customers rely on these systems around the clock, 24x7x365 support coverage is required.

Candidates must be comfortable working a flexible schedule that may include:

  • Day, evening, or overnight shifts
  • Weekends
  • Holidays
  • Overtime, when required by business needs
  • Schedule changes based on client requirements, business needs, or training

Important: Account-specific training may be scheduled during daytime hours regardless of your eventual assigned shift.

Additional requirements include:

  • Ability to remain at a designated workstation and actively participate in the phone queue for 8–10 hour shifts, with scheduled breaks.
  • Ability to read and work from computer screens throughout the shift.
  • For remote work, a quiet, private workspace and high-speed wired internet connection are required.
  • A working mobile phone is required for manager communication and two-factor authentication (2FA).
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, when required.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. when equipment setup or support activities require it.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of service desk, help desk, technical support, or remote support experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on technical troubleshooting experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Excellent listening and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and the ability to work effectively with clinicians and healthcare professionals.
  • Comfortable working in a 24x7x365 support environment with rotating or non-traditional shifts.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a call center or high-volume service desk environment.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, hospital, clinical, or medical applications.
  • Exposure to clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, McKesson, or Meditech.
  • IT service management or ITIL experience/certification.
  • Experience working with incident management and ticketing systems.
  • Strong typing and computer navigation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain calm, patient, and solution-oriented during challenging customer interactions.
  • Previous experience supporting mission-critical applications in a 24x7 environment.

Why Join NTT DATA Services?

NTT DATA Services is a recognized leader in healthcare technology, helping healthcare organizations improve patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and the delivery of care through technology.

Our healthcare solutions span patient engagement, predictive analytics, cloud hosting, integration and interoperability, clinical and claims applications, revenue cycle management, policy administration, managed infrastructure, and business process services.

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to support technology that is essential to healthcare organizations and the clinicians who depend on it every day.

Employment & Benefits

This position is available only as a direct employment opportunity with NTT DATA, Inc. or one of its subsidiaries.

Temporary, contract, Corp-to-Corp (C2C), or equivalent contractor arrangements will not be considered.

NTT DATA offers a comprehensive benefits package beginning on your first day of employment, along with the opportunity to build your career with a global technology and healthcare services organization.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $38,000 - $56,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

  • Atuação prévia em ambiente multicultural;

jobs.description:
Be essential at Cars Commerce


At Cars Commerce, we’re fanatical about simplifying everything about car buying and selling. We do right by our customers and consumers to better connect the industry with simplified and tierless technology to enhance, measure and drive local automotive retail. Whether through our No.1 most recognized marketplace, Cars.com, our industry-leading digital experience, Dealer Inspire, our trade and appraisal technology, AccuTrade, our reputation-based digital wholesale auction marketplace, Dealerclub, or our new Cars Commerce Media Network, Cars Commerce is essential for success in the automotive industry.


No one ever travels alone here: at its core, Cars Commerce is collaboration. In fact, it’s built into the very fabric of our shared values. We like to say we Rise Together – putting people at the center of what we do, from consumer to customer to community. Life at Cars Commerce makes it easy when we share the ethos to be Open to All, encouraging open-minded communication because we know diverse thinking yields better outcomes. But critical to our success is Caring to Challenge and Taking Ownership, fueling a competitive spirit in a respectful environment where we think about tomorrow but act today. At our foundation, we have integrity, Doing the Right Thing, even when it’s hard. It’s our shared commitment to these values that makes Cars Commerce a place where growth becomes not only possible, but downright unavoidable.


But don't take our word for it. We are proud to be named one of Built In's 2026 Best Places to Work in Chicago and across the U.S. Ready to make your mark? Join a team that's driving real change in the automotive industry.

Product Leader of Media Initiatives for Cars.com

CARS COMMERCE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Director of Product Management, Cars.com Media

Turn here.

About Us

Cars.com (NYSE: CARS) is an audience-driven technology company empowering the automotive industry. We enable confident car buying and selling decisions for consumers via powerful products, solutions, machine learning, and model-driven artificial intelligence technologies that span pre-tail, retail, and post-sale activities.

Our mission is to build the most trusted and intelligent marketplace for buying and selling cars, while accelerating efficient and profitable retail operations for dealer customers.

The Cars Commerce platform is organized around key assets:

  • Cars.com (Marketplace): The number one automotive marketplace brand with more than 30% traffic growth over the past five years
  • Dealer Inspire (Websites & Digital Experience): Digital marketing technology & services that are endorsed by nearly every OEM

Cars.com also has additional products that further enrich the Dealer experience and strengthen their experience on the marketplace

  • AccuTrade (Trade & Appraisal): Powering profitability with the right price on any vehicle, every time
  • Cars.com Media Network: Pure in-market audience across social, video, search, display, and custom content
  • DealerClub: Reputation based Dealer to Dealer wholesale auction platform which provides a valuable additional inventory control to Dealers, enabling them to increase their efficiency, keeping only the vehicles on their lot that they want to focus on with their retail consumers.

Scope

As a Director of Product at CARS, you will deliver growth by solving consumer and customer challenges unique to the automotive retail industry. As a product org leader, you will oversee the full lifecycle of product development for a suite of strategically important products. You will deliver industry leading innovation and value delivery through your team of product managers. You will define the strategy and lead innovation for your product suite; hire, develop, and coach your team of PMs; and define effective strategies for product development. You will work with cross-functional leadership (UX design, engineering, research, marketing, and analysts) to deliver a best-in-class product roadmap (including well defined, validated, and prioritized epics/initiatives). You will define product goals that deliver business growth and consumer/customer impact, and ensure that those goals are met.

As a Director of Product, you are a creative problem solver, people leader, and executor driven by positive outcomes for our users. You demonstrate trust in and dedication to our vision, mission and values. You have strong customer empathy and make product decisions based on both qualitative and quantitative customer, industry knowledge, and business data. You make decisions by optimizing for ROI and driving bottom-line/top-line performance. You have a passion for solving complex, multi-sided marketplace problems, developing strategies and roadmaps, and executing plans that create new value for our users and our business. You are a natural collaborator and communicator who has a track record of building positive relationships across a broad, diverse organization. You can establish, communicate, and gain buy-in for a vision that extends across our full ecosystem of products.

As Director of Product for Media, you will own the company's advertising business end to end: the on-site advertising experience served directly to visitors on our marketplace platform, and an audience-based media network that packages our first-party audience data and activates it across external channels such as programmatic buying platforms, social, connected TV and streaming video, online video, display, and audio, all in service of both OEM and dealer customers. You will also play a critical role in defining the media and data technology stack that underpins how media is operated across both Cars.com and Dealer Inspire, with a unique focus on building the media operating system layer of Dealer Inspire Media Services, a dealer-specific media agency model.

Essential Functions

  • Define and deliver the roadmap for the Cars.com and Dealer Inspire media platforms.
  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for on-site advertising across the Cars.com marketplace platform, including ad placement design, new ad formats, and the underlying ad-serving technology, balancing revenue growth with a strong visitor experience, for both OEM and dealer customers.

The U.S. Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer. We have an exciting opportunity to join our dynamic commercial team as we prepare for the potential U.S. launch of an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy for early-stage melanoma, being developed through an alliance partnership. This novel product has the potential to redefine personalized cancer treatment and requires a highly coordinated operating model to support seamless therapy delivery across a complex treatment ecosystem.

Reporting to the Director, Patient Support Strategy Lead, the Associate Director, Patient Support Program Strategy will be responsible for establishing the vision, strategy, and governance framework for the Patient Support Program (PSP) supporting an individualized therapy. This role will oversee the development and continuous evolution of hub services, enrollment and consent processes, affordability solutions, and case management capabilities designed to help patients successfully navigate a complex treatment journey. The Associate Director will translate patient support priorities into scalable program requirements, service models, business rules, and performance standards while ensuring seamless integration across reimbursement, affordability, patient navigation, and support services. Through close partnership with internal stakeholders and external vendors, this individual will drive the development of innovative, compliant, and patient-centered solutions that support patient access and overall patient experience.

  • Hub strategy & Governance: Define brand-specific hub business rules, workflows, service requirements, and escalation pathways to ensure patient support capabilities are aligned to the unique needs of the therapy and patient journey.

  • Program Analytics & Optimization: Establish performance measures and reporting requirements, leveraging patient and operational insights to identify barriers, optimize program effectiveness, and improve patient outcomes over time.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Launch Readiness: Partner with Market Access, Patient Access Support Operations, Finance, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Data & Technology teams to ensure compliant implementation, operational readiness, and successful execution of patient support and affordability programs.

A growing share is not: LLM-based extraction, enrichment, and validation running inside the pipeline at scale.

The hard part isn't calling a model. It's making a probabilistic component behave like a reliable one: labelled eval sets, precision and recall you can measure, versioned prompts, cost ceilings, and the harnesses that catch regressions when a vendor silently changes the model under you.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. You'll own reliability, cost, and whether downstream consumers can trust the data, whether it came from a SQL join or a language model.

What You'll Own

  • LLM-in-the-pipeline systems — extraction, enrichment, entity resolution, and semantic validation steps that run over millions of records a day with structured outputs, retries, and human-review fallbacks

  • Eval harnesses — labelled sets, scorers, and regression suites that gate every prompt or model change; precision/recall tracked per check, not vibes

  • Rules vs. LLMs — deterministic checks (dbt tests, data contracts, SQL) wherever structure allows; LLMs where semantic judgement is needed; the discipline to know which is which

  • Cost and drift — token budgets per pipeline, model routing (cheap models for classification, stronger ones for hard cases), drift detection on vendor updates

  • Observability — every LLM call logged with prompt version, model, cost, latency, and decision, alongside standard pipeline alerting that surfaces problems before they cascade

  • Core pipelines and warehouse — Airflow orchestration, dbt models across staging to mart, Snowflake performance and cost over billions of rows, AWS infrastructure as code

  • Matching and deduplication — embeddings and retrieval patterns for company and people entity resolution across 13 markets

What We're Looking For

Must Haves

  • 3+ years in data engineering or data infrastructure, with production pipelines you've owned end to end and 2+ years experience with Snowflake

  • Strong Python and SQL — production-grade, performance-aware, comfortable at very large scale

  • Shipped LLMs inside data pipelines — extraction, enrichment, or validation in production, with structured outputs and a labelled eval set that tells you where the model gets it wrong

  • Harness engineering experience — you've built or maintained eval or test harnesses for LLM outputs, and you can talk through what they caught

  • Sharp judgement on rules vs. LLMs — you reach for a regex or a dbt test first and can defend the call either way

  • Production dbt and Airflow — modular, tested models; DAGs that recover gracefully

  • Cloud warehouse experience — Snowflake preferred; schema design, query optimisation, cost management

  • AI coding tools are how you work — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent, daily, with real shipped work to show for it

  • Ownership and systems thinking — you weigh upstream dependencies and downstream impact before changing anything

Highly Valued

  • Eval frameworks and LLM tracing (Logfire, OpenTelemetry)

  • Embeddings, vector search, or fuzzy matching for entity resolution at scale

  • Fine-tuning or distilling small models to replace expensive LLM calls

  • AWS at scale (S3, Lambda, Glue, ECS, RDS) and PostgreSQL

  • Spark or PySpark; streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Snowpipe Streaming)

  • Data privacy and compliance (GDPR, SOC2, CCPA)

How We Build

Firmable is an AI-native organisation. AI coding tools, automated testing, and AI-assisted review are how we work by default. Every LLM check ships with a labelled eval set, measured precision/recall, and a prompt version you can roll back. Every LLM call in production is logged from day one; retrofitting later is not the plan.

We run lean and ship fast — small senior teams, no layers, minimal process, weekly releases moving toward daily. Teams own their stack end to end. There are no fixed hours and no handholding. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

Why This Role

  • LLMs as production infrastructure — not a demo, not a notebook; models making millions of decisions a day on data customers pay for

  • Greenfield harnesses — eval coverage, drift detection, and cost controls for in-pipeline LLMs are largely unbuilt; you'll ship them

  • Scale that matters — billions of rows, 13 markets, and a dataset nobody else has

  • Small team, massive leverage — your pipelines reach every Firmable customer, every day

  • Competitive base + meaningful equity — a share in the upside we're building toward

Firmable is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products.

Ready to build the AI-native data platform behind the world's smartest B2B sales intelligence platform? Apply now — let's talk!

You will work closely with the Head of Analysis, the engagement lead, and the store development lead to build financial models, analyse retail performance, research potential store locations, and track property deals and development projects.

A key part of the role will involve helping maintain a property platform that brings together store network plans, financial models, deal trackers, and project schedules. When retail consulting work is quieter, you will also support property acquisition, development, and renovation projects.

This role suits an analytical and organised professional who is confident working with Excel, comfortable handling large datasets, and able to manage multiple workstreams independently.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain financial models for retail store networks, including sales forecasts, market profit and loss (P&L), capital expenditure (CAPEX), and return on investment (ROI).
  • Gather, clean, reconcile, and validate sales, cost, labour, freight, property, and other client data.
  • Analyse store performance and financial assumptions to support decisions about store locations and expansion plans.
  • Maintain financial models, deal trackers, store audit templates, work schedules, and other inputs for the company's property platform.
  • Upload and validate data, test model calculations and reports, identify issues, and coordinate fixes with the platform developer.
  • Update forecasts with actual store performance once locations begin trading.
  • Research shopping centres, landlords, rental terms, vacancies, potential franchise partners, and competing brands across Southeast Asia.
  • Compare landlord offers and lease terms, including rent, service charges, incentives, fit-out periods, and other commercial conditions.
  • Prepare meeting briefs, reports, presentations, meeting minutes, and action trackers for client and internal meetings.
  • Support store development by collating drawings, specifications, contractor quotes, fit-out costs, and construction schedules.
  • Track project milestones, budgets, procurement timelines, and long-lead items to help identify potential delays.
  • Support property acquisition, development, and renovation feasibility models, budgets, cash flow forecasts, and project reporting when retail consulting work is quieter.
  • Maintain consistent templates, documentation, and trackers across projects.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders, follow up on outstanding inputs, and flag risks or delays early.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), property analysis, retail analytics, or a Big 4 or consulting analyst role.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including financial modelling, scenario and sensitivity analysis, formula auditing, and error checking.
  • Experience building, maintaining, and reviewing financial models, with the ability to explain assumptions and calculations clearly.
  • Strong data analysis skills, including cleaning, reconciling, and combining information from multiple sources.
  • Understanding of retail or property economics, including sales per square metre, gross profit, rent, occupancy costs, lease terms, and fit-out costs.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare clear, concise, client-ready reports.
  • Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently, follow up on missing information, and communicate issues proactively.
  • Comfortable collaborating remotely with stakeholders across different time zones.

Highly Desirable:

  • Experience with multi-site retailers, franchise businesses, shopping centre operators, property companies, or retail consulting.
  • Familiarity with Southeast Asian markets, particularly the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, or Singapore.
  • Experience with project scheduling, Gantt charts, procurement tracking, or store development programmes.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, or SQL.
  • Experience supporting SaaS platform implementation, data migration, or system testing.
  • Experience with store fit-outs, construction costs, property development feasibility, or an accounting qualification would also be advantageous.

  • Speed & Efficiency: Demonstrate exceptional speed in delivering qualified candidates and closing positions within a set timeframe, ensuring swift turnaround on critical roles.

  • Reporting & Metrics: Track and report key recruitment metrics (time-to-fill, candidate quality, etc.) and continuously refine recruitment strategies to improve efficiency.
