jobs.description:
Senior State Investigative Reporter/Editor


The state investigative reporter/editor is a seasoned journalist who helps lead high‑impact accountability and investigative reporting serving NEWSWELL’s local newsrooms from within our networked investigative team.


This job is housed within a new standalone investigative team that serves the Western newsrooms in NEWSWELL’s nonprofit collective.


This player/coach role will focus on investigative reporting and will assist with editing and guiding a small team, sometimes serving as first or second editor on projects.


The team’s work may focus on a core topic area including:

  • housing and income disparity
  • urban policy and disruption
  • health care and health disparity
  • agriculture and immigration
  • education and child development
  • technology influence and malfeasance
  • criminal justice and rule of law

This reporter/editor will collaborate with other team members and staffers from NEWSWELL’s local newsrooms also focus on serving a key NEWSWELL newsroom or coverage region including San Diego and the border, the Inland Empire, coastal California and the Central Valley and agricultural regions.


This reporter/editor has the skills to originate, scope and execute sophisticated accountability projects that examine how power, money, decisions and public systems shape life across California and the West.


This reporter/editor will use advanced reporting techniques — complex public records work, deep sourcing, data analysis and document‑driven research — and help elevate investigative standards across the team and our local newsrooms. This reporter/editor demonstrates skill at mentoring colleagues and collaborating on digital presentation, packaging and impact tracking.


This reporter/editor should bring a leadership and mentorship sensibility to the role, and take responsibility for managing the team’s legal and safety risks.


Every piece of our team’s work will focus on two equal priorities: impact and audience connection:


IMPACT: All our efforts should pursue righting a wrong and demonstrating the power of journalism to improve public life.


AUDIENCE CONNECTION: Everything we publish should also be in pursuit of strengthening audience ties to our newsroom, through two-way dialogue, public events, uses of new platforms or other methods to demonstrate public outreach.


NEWSWELL helps newsrooms become nonprofit and for-community, providing strategic guidance, innovative solutions and operational support so journalists can focus on what matters most: serving their communities. Through partnerships with Arizona State University — named the nation’s most innovative university for 11 years in a row — NEWSWELL brings cutting-edge ideas, research and tools to reinvent local news and strengthen democracy.


Our innovative model has earned us support from journalistic and philanthropic organizations nationwide. This new team’s work is designed to leverage and grow that support, so that we can grow and transform local journalism



Submission Requirements

A cover letter explaining the key contributions you would bring to the role, and explaining how your clips shed light on the path to that role.


A resume explaining your professional skills and background.


At least three clips demonstrating aptitude for investigative impact and audience connection.



The salary range for this role is $105,000-135,000 annually.

What you’ll do

  • Primary role: Conceive, develop and produce original investigative and accountability stories that deliver exclusive findings, reveal systemic issues or influence and have measurable civic impact.
  • Secondary role: Serve as first or second editor on projects from within the team.
  • Mentor and coach local newsrooms and collaborate on local reporting.
  • Integrate solutions journalism, audience interaction and other innovative techniques into the investigative workflow.
  • Lead complex public records reporting.
  • Analyze data at an advanced level or collaborate with others to do so.
  • Develop and protect sensitive sources across government, institutions and communities.
  • Travel as needed to NEWSWELL locations and other reporting locations.
  • Collaborate with editors and the impact producer to present stories to a broad range of audiences.
  • Use multiple digital publishing formats when appropriate.
  • Represent the newsroom at community forums and partner events; engage transparently with readers and stakeholders.
  • Pilot new tools, including responsible AI, to enhance research, document analysis and workflow efficiency.
  • Partner with ASU’s Walter Cronkite School and other academic institutions to create strong student engagement opportunities, including reporting, learning experiences and newsroom collaboration.
  • Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative newsroom culture that values transparency, fairness, equity and community impact.

What you'll need

  • Investigative mastery: FOIA/OMA strategy, document analysis, source development, meticulous verification.
  • Financial literacy: ability to read and explain budgets, balance sheets, audits/ACFRs, pension disclosures, bond offerings and contracts; comfort interviewing fiscal experts and translating jargon for readers.
  • Solutions journalism practice: familiarity with evidence standards, comparative case vetting and transparent limitations; ability to integrate solutions frames without advocacy.
  • Data reporting: spreadsheet manipulation, dataset cleaning, identifying trends; collaborate on charts/maps/visuals.
  • Storytelling excellence: ability to distill complex information; strong organization and project management across multi‑month investigations and faster accountability hits.
  • Digital fluency: SEO‑aware writing, smart packaging, social and audience collaboration to maximize reach and comprehension.
  • Risk awareness: strong judgment around legal, safety and trauma‑informed practices.
  • Leadership and mentorship: capacity to guide reporters on methods, ethics and craft; clear, collaborative communication.
  • Proficiency in Associated Press style; commitment to fairness, accuracy, inclusion and community‑centered journalism.

Relevant qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in journalism or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five to seven years of reporting experience with a record of accountability or investigative work.
  • Demonstrable experience producing exclusive findings, document‑driven reporting, public records work and data‑enhanced stories.

Preferred education and experience

  • Editing and leadership experience, with a track record of guiding accountability reporting and project publication in a larger team or newsroom.
  • Experience reporting in California and the West.
  • Experience with cross‑newsroom or regional accountability collaborations.


Preferred skills and abilities

  • Advanced data tools (SQL, R or Python) or mapping software (ArcGIS, QGIS).
  • Fluency in languages other than English

Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with matching employer contribution
  • 22 days of vacation time
  • 11 holidays, including your birthday
  • Parental leave
  • Significant tuition reductions
  • Professional development is highly valued at ASU Enterprise Partners, where employees are encouraged to look across the organization and nurture new areas of interest
  • $30 bi-weekly cell phone reimbursement

jobs.description:
Customer Solution Architect — Arango AI Product Suite

About Arango:

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens,, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at,LinkedIn, andG2.




About the role

Arango is hiring a Customer Solution Architect to be the primary professional services interface between Arango and the customers deploying our AI product suite. You own the technical relationship end to end, from first discovery through production and expansion. Your job is to turn a customer's problem into a working architecture on Arango's multi-model platform and its GraphRAG and knowledge-graph capabilities, prove value early, and guide the customer's team through deployment and adoption. The role sits where solution architecture, graph data modeling, and applied AI meet. It suits someone who can hold a design conversation with a customer's chief architect in the morning and review a GraphRAG retrieval design with their engineers in the afternoon. Deep graph expertise is not optional here. It is the core of how Arango's AI suite delivers value, and the CSA is expected to be the customer's most trusted source of graph and GraphRAG design judgment.

Key responsibilities
  • Own the technical customer relationship as the primary professional services contact across the full lifecycle: discovery, design, pilot, production, and expansion.
  • Run discovery with customer sponsors, domain experts, and operators to identify high-value use cases for Arango's AI product suite, and qualify them against real business outcomes.
  • Design target architectures on Arango's multi-model platform, including graph data models, AQL query and traversal patterns, and GraphRAG retrieval design tailored to the customer's domain.
  • Define success criteria, SLAs/SLOs, data access and governance requirements, and a phased delivery plan from proof of value to production.
  • Build reference implementations and prototypes that prove value early: graph schema, data connectors, GraphRAG pipelines, tool and agent orchestration, APIs.
  • Guide production deployment into secure, observable services alongside the customer's engineers, with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and proper testing.
  • Architect retrieval across graph traversal, vector search, and hybrid approaches (chunking, embeddings, ranking, caching), and orchestrate tool and agent calls.
  • Establish evaluation practices and iterate on prompts, models, retrieval strategy, and graph structure using offline and online metrics and A/B tests.
  • Design data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector indices, graph ingestion, and metadata governance.
  • Define monitoring for quality, drift, hallucination and guardrail events, latency, and cost, and stand up alerting and dashboards with the customer.
  • Architect role-based access, secrets management, audit logging, PII redaction, and content safety controls.
  • Meet customer compliance requirements (SOC 2/ISO 27001, GDPR/CCPA, HIPAA as applicable).
  • Produce architecture documentation, runbooks, and reusable patterns, and train customer engineers and end users.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Arango's product and engineering teams, shaping the roadmap with what we learn in the field.
Required qualifications
  • Deep graph knowledge (central to this role). Hands-on expertise in graph data modeling, graph query and traversal (AQL, or equivalents such as Cypher or Gremlin), graph algorithms, and knowledge-graph design for AI. Direct experience building GraphRAG or knowledge-graph-backed retrieval for LLM applications.
  • 3+ years in software engineering, solution architecture, or technical professional services, including building and operating production systems.
  • Strong applied AI and Python skills, with a solid grasp of data structures, systems design, concurrency, and networking.
  • Strong database skills across graph, NoSQL, key-value, and document models. Multi-model experience is valued given Arango's platform.
  • Hands-on experience with modern LLMs and tooling (OpenAI/Anthropic/Llama, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex, function and tool calling).
  • Retrieval and vector databases (FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar), and hybrid retrieval that combines graph and vector.
  • Cloud and containers (AWS/GCP/Azure), Docker/Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and CI/CD.
  • Observability (metrics, logs, traces) and performance tuning for latency-sensitive services.
  • Excellent customer-facing communication, with the ability to lead technical conversations from the executive level down to the engineering team.
Nice to have
  • Direct ArangoDB experience, or prior work deploying a graph database in production.
  • Search and IR fundamentals (BM25, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, ColBERT, cross-encoders).
  • Front-end or full-stack experience (TypeScript/React, Next.js) for light UI prototyping.
  • MLOps platforms and evaluation frameworks (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Ragas, promptfoo, DeepEval).
  • Model adaptation and inference optimization awareness (LoRA/PEFT, DPO, distillation, quantization, vLLM/TGI/TensorRT-LLM), enough to advise on tradeoffs rather than to hand-build.
  • Domain experience in finance, healthcare, public sector, manufacturing, or retail.
  • Security and compliance familiarity: data residency, KMS/HSM, private networking.
  • French government or industry experience.
What success looks like (6–12 months)
  • 2 to 4 customer deployments of Arango's AI suite live in production against agreed uptime, latency, and cost targets.
  • Measurable quality and business outcomes (task accuracy, deflection rate, cycle time) backed by evaluation and telemetry.
  • Reusable graph and GraphRAG reference architectures and connectors adopted by the broader delivery team and by customers.
  • Customer teams enabled and self-sufficient, with runbooks, documentation, and training in place, and strong satisfaction and NPS.
  • A credible field feedback loop feeding Arango's product and engineering roadmap.
Our toolset
  • Platform & Graph: ArangoDB multi-model (graph, document, key-value), AQL, graph algorithms, GraphRAG

jobs.description:
About SimScale

SimScale is the world's first cloud-based, AI-native engineering simulation platform. CFD, FEA, thermal and electromagnetics run together in a single browser-based environment, supported by Engineering AI that guides simulation setup, Physics AI that returns validated predictions in seconds, and agentic workflows that execute multi-step simulation pipelines at any scale.

The conviction behind the platform is straightforward: every engineer should be free to explore thousands of design options, test them instantly and decide with confidence, not only the specialists who have traditionally held the CAE tools. Founded in Munich in 2012 by five engineers, SimScale is trusted today by more than 800,000 engineers worldwide, at companies including Johnson & Johnson, Mitsubishi, Magna, Toshiba, Bühler, AECOM and Zaha Hadid Architects.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager you own the lifetime value of a book of SimScale accounts: Commercial and High Potential customers, including some enterprise-sized names, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You carry a renewal and expansion number, and you own it through to signature.

Why this role matters

The contribution of this role is crucial to SimScale's success. Every renewal protected and every expansion landed shows up directly in the company's growth, and the relationships you build determine how deeply simulation takes hold inside each customer's engineering organisation.

This is also a role with room to shape things. Alongside owning your book, you will have the opportunity to help shape and continuously optimise how Customer Success works at SimScale: the customer journey, the playbooks, the segmentation and the tooling, in an international environment with a great deal of opportunity in it.

What you will own

  • Your book, end-to-end. A portfolio of Commercial and High Potential accounts through the full journey: onboarding, adoption, mid-term engagement, Business Reviews, renewal and expansion.
  • A commercial number you own through to signature. Build and manage your renewal and expansion pipeline, run opportunity management through the pipeline, negotiate contract adjustments and pricing, and close.
  • Account growth plan strategy. For every account that matters, define where the value sits today, where the next team, site or use case is, and what needs to happen to get there.
  • Expansion campaigns on your key accounts, targeted, multi-touch plays into specific engineering teams and use cases, designed together with Marketing and run to a plan.
  • Programme management of the work that unlocks growth: benchmarks, pilots and technical evaluations, coordinated across the customer's engineers and ours, to a clear timeline.
  • Organic and referral-led growth. Champion networks, internal referrals, and the word-of-mouth that travels between engineering teams inside a large company.
  • Business Reviews customers value attending, anchored on ROI and realised value.
  • Customer health. Identify retention risk early, define the mitigation plan and execute it, and decide which pivotal accounts to concentrate on for retention or expansion.
  • A segmented delivery model. Tech-touch and agentic CS motions so every account in the long tail gets a genuinely good experience at scale; high-touch attention where ARR level and growth potential justify it.
  • Adoption of Engineering AI / Physics AI across your book, the newest and most strategic part of our platform.

Who you will work with

SimScale is a collaborative environment, and this role sits right in the middle of it. You will have colleagues around you whose work is closely tied to your success:

  • Marketing partners with you on expansion campaigns, lifecycle and nurture programmes and content, extending your reach across every user in your book. You bring the account insight; they bring the campaign machinery.
  • Support shares a live view of account health with you, so signals from the customer reach you early and you can act on them together.
  • Application Engineering and Solution Engineering bring the technical depth behind benchmarks, pilots and evaluations, so customers see results quickly.
  • Product and Engineering take your Voice of Customer input into the roadmap, and give you the context to speak credibly about what is coming.
  • Sales hands over new customers with full context, and partners with you on the largest opportunities.

What we expect from you

  • 4+ years customer-facing in high-growth SaaS, carrying a number. We are deliberately open on job title: Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, Account Executive, Sales Representative, Client Partner, Technical Account Manager. What matters is that you have personally owned renewals and/or expansion and closed them.
  • Pipeline and opportunity management. You can build, forecast and work a pipeline in a CRM, and your forecast is one people rely on.
  • Negotiation and closing experience. You have handled commercial terms, contract adjustments, pricing conversations and procurement, and you are comfortable asking for the order.
  • Customer cohort management. You have run a substantial book of accounts, and you can tier it, prioritise it and cover it well.
  • Project and programme management. You can drive a pilot, benchmark or rollout to a timeline across teams that do not report to you.
  • A proven track record of sales and of growing customer accounts: expansion you can point to and explain how you created.
  • Credible engineering / CAE domain footing, enough to hold a real conversation with a simulation engineer and with their VP.
  • AI-native ways of working. You already use AI daily for productivity (call preparation, summarisation, research, CRM insight) and you are keen to push further. It is how the team works.
  • CRM discipline (Salesforce or HubSpot).

Nice to have

  • Experience running a tiered / segmented touch model, including automation and AI-assisted or agentic CS workflows.
  • A hands-on CFD / FEA / thermal background.
  • Experience cross-selling an AI layer onto a core subscription, or running retention and expansion campaigns together with a marketing team.

Location: US (EST / CST).

With our team consisting of people from various backgrounds, we truly embrace diversity and encourage everyone to be themselves. We are unified by curiosity, dedication and our team spirit! As an equal opportunity employer, we acknowledge that our employees have different aspirations and career goals, and therefore are committed to create a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.   • Drive production MLOps for agents: deployment, versioning, traffic shaping, cost/latency budgets, observability (traces, token spend, tool call success), and on-call playbooks for agent incidents.

  • Translate ambiguous product bets (“what if the underwriter had an AI co-pilot for this?”) into concrete agent designs, prototypes, and shipped features.

jobs.excerpt: The Role: RevOps Automation SpecialistIf you love building in HubSpot, solving messy GTM problems, and turning them into clean, automated systems people actually use, you're in the right place.
jobs.description:
The Role: RevOps Automation Specialist

If you love building in HubSpot, solving messy GTM problems, and turning them into clean, automated systems people actually use, you're in the right place.

As a RevOps Automation Specialist at Kalungi, you'll be the hands-on builder behind the GTM systems of a portfolio of B2B SaaS clients. This is a client-facing role - you'll build the systems, join client calls, explain your decisions, train users, troubleshoot problems, and help clients get real value from what you've created.

You'll work across both structured HubSpot onboarding engagements and deeper RevOps projects. At times, you'll manage multiple concurrent client implementations; at others, you'll partner closely with a fractional CMO on more complex projects such as CRM migrations, integrations, AI implementations, and GTM infrastructure improvements. This isn't a role where you simply complete technical tickets. You'll translate GTM strategy into systems that marketing and sales teams can understand, trust, and use.

You'll report to the RevOps Lead and work closely with Kalungi's fractional CMOs and client delivery teams. All hires take part in a probationary period to determine if the role is a good fit.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the RevOps/automation point of contact for a portfolio of B2B SaaS clients, joining regular client calls and owning day-to-day execution
  • Design and configure HubSpot architectures for new clients, including lifecycle stages, MQL/SQL definitions, lead routing, pipelines, properties, segmentation, and automation
  • Build, configure, and optimize HubSpot portals across Marketing, Sales, Service, and Ops Hubs
  • Build sophisticated workflows and automations that improve how marketing, sales, and customer success teams operate
  • Audit new client GTM systems and identify quick wins, structural improvements, and longer-term priorities
  • Implement and maintain integrations across the GTM stack, including tools such as Salesforce, Clay, Zapier, Make, n8n, LinkedIn, Outreach, Google Ads, enrichment platforms, and others
  • Support HubSpot ↔ Salesforce integrations, including field mapping, sync rules, deduplication, object ownership, troubleshooting, and ongoing monitoring
  • Design and maintain SLA frameworks in HubSpot, including time-to-first-touch, follow-up cadence, lead recycling, and escalation workflows
  • Own data hygiene, enrichment workflows, naming conventions, database structure, validation, and automated cleanup routines
  • Build dashboards that help clients understand pipeline velocity, conversion rates, campaign performance, and other metrics they can actually use to make decisions
  • Identify opportunities to use AI to improve GTM workflows
  • Translate client goals and CMO-level strategy into working automation and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Troubleshoot issues such as sync errors, duplicate data, broken workflows, routing problems, and CRM inconsistencies using a structured approach
  • Train clients and teammates on the systems you build
  • Document your work and contribute reusable workflows, templates, playbooks, and build standards to Kalungi's internal RevOps toolkit
  • Share new tools, AI workflows, and RevOps best practices with the broader Kalungi team
  • Partner with fractional CMOs, PMMs, content, paid, ABM, and other specialists to ensure automation supports the broader GTM strategy
  • Deliver reliable, high-quality work and communicate early when timelines, scope, or technical constraints change

What We're Looking For

Working on the Kalungi team means embracing self-improvement. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect attention to detail, curiosity, humility, reliability, and a desire to level up quickly. We own our work by seeking responsibility and accountability for the ideas and systems we create.

We ask "Why?" a lot.

Great RevOps isn't about building workflows for the sake of automation. It's about understanding what marketing, sales, and customer success teams are trying to accomplish and building systems that help them get there.

Must Have

  • 4+ years of experience in RevOps, marketing operations, CRM administration, GTM systems, or a similar role, ideally supporting B2B SaaS companies
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience across Marketing Hub and Sales Hub, with experience in Ops Hub strongly preferred
  • Experience designing or significantly restructuring HubSpot portals — not simply maintaining systems someone else designed
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle stages, lead routing, lead scoring, pipelines, workflows, properties, segmentation, and CRM data hygiene
  • Experience building sophisticated automations using HubSpot and tools such as Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar platforms
  • Strong understanding of CRM database structure and how to keep data clean, organized, and scalable
  • Experience integrating HubSpot with other GTM systems and troubleshooting sync and data issues
  • Strong analytical mindset and the ability to build reporting that helps teams make decisions
  • Client-facing confidence — comfortable joining calls, presenting work, explaining technical choices in plain language, and thoughtfully pushing back when needed
  • Commercial awareness — understands how RevOps supports marketing, sales, customer success, pipeline, and revenue rather than viewing CRM work purely as a technical exercise
  • Ability to train non-technical users and create clear documentation for the systems you build
  • AI fluency — actively uses AI to research, build, troubleshoot, document, and improve RevOps workflows and is excited to experiment with new tools
  • Reliability and ownership — keeps commitments, communicates proactively, and takes responsibility for the quality of the finished system
  • Builder mindset — enjoys creating structure from ambiguity and finding solutions that can scale across clients

Great to Have

These are skills that would make you especially valuable to the team:

  • HubSpot Marketing, Sales, or Ops Hub certifications
  • Experience architecting or maintaining HubSpot ↔ Salesforce integrations
  • Salesforce administration experience
  • Experience with Clay for enrichment, list building, and GTM data workflows
  • Experience with newer or smaller CRMs such as Attio, Folk, Copper, or Close
  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, HubSpot custom code actions, or HubSpot CLI
  • Ability to work with light JavaScript or SQL
  • Experience deploying AI-powered GTM automations
  • Working knowledge of GDPR/CCPA and CRM consent/data-retention practices
  • Experience with attribution and advanced GTM reporting
  • Experience working at an agency, consultancy, or other environment where you manage multiple clients and priorities simultaneously

You do not need to be a full-stack developer. Kalungi has development resources available for projects requiring deeper custom engineering. We do expect you to be technically curious, comfortable working with developers, and capable of understanding and troubleshooting the systems you're responsible for.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients trust you to own their HubSpot and RevOps work
  • The systems you build are clean, reliable, and easy for marketing and sales teams to use
  • Deadlines and commitments are consistently met
  • You identify opportunities to improve processes rather than waiting for someone to hand you a task
  • Your documentation, templates, and learnings make the rest of the Kalungi team better and faster

What to Expect During the Interview Process

  • Complete an introductory video
  • Have an initial short interview with a hiring manager
  • Complete a short technical exercise (a HubSpot Portal Audit)
  • Review your technical exercise during a second interview

A Note on Video Introductions & Cover Letters

Your cover letter and video introduction are your first opportunity to do the same. The video doesn't need to be elaborate. Get out your phone and record a spontaneous selfie video or Loom. Don't overthink it. Tell us why this role interests you, why you think you're a good fit, and give us a sense of how you approach RevOps problems.

Applicants who fail to provide a video introduction will not move forward in the process.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary & fully remote work environment
  • The opportunity to work directly with B2B SaaS marketing and GTM leaders

Location: Austin, TX

Company:

If you’ve spent your career in environments where everything is already figured out - established civil standards, tidy workflows, and predictable processes - you won’t find that here.

We’re early, messy, and building as we go.

And that’s why this role matters.

If chaos excites you more than it scares you,

if land speaks to you,

and if you want to shape both the work and the way the work gets done…

Then keep reading….

Who we are

Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135 acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:

🌱 Non-toxic materials

💧 Clean water and filtration systems

⚡ EMF-conscious design

🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning

We are a global team of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.

We’re a team spread across 8 countries, building our 1st community in Austin, Texas. This is only the beginning. Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.

And now, we’re searching for the civil engineer who can make this vision buildable in a way that honors the land.

🗺️ What this role really means

For too long, we’ve relied on outside consultants for grading, drainage, and site layout - and frankly, it slowed us down and diluted the beauty of what we’re building.

We’re bringing this role in-house because we need someone who sees land as a canvas, not a constraint.

You will literally shape how the community feels underfoot:

  • Roads that follow the land instead of fighting it

  • Homes tucked gracefully into natural contours

  • Stormwater systems that follow the logic of nature

This is a rare chance to blend engineering, architecture, sustainability, and design into one high-impact role.

Your impact will show up everywhere ✨

Your work determines:

  • Pace: How fast we can build.

  • Aesthetics:How beautifully each home sits within the land.

  • Sustainability: How thoughtfully we work with nature (designing roads that follow terrain, and stormwater paths that work with natural systems).

You will be the bridge between vision and reality - the person who turns world-class architecture into something constructible, intelligent, and deeply respectful of the Hill Country terrain.

What you’ll own (end-to-end)

You will lead civil engineering for our entire community - full stop.

This includes:

Site & Land Development

  • Full-site grading, drainage, roadway layout, and retaining design

  • Creating grading that makes every home feel naturally placed

  • Topography-driven design that minimizes cuts, scars, and cost

Permitting & Approvals

Prepare and submit permit-ready civil drawing sets for:

  • TCEQ (Texas Commission on Environmental Quality)

  • Hays County

  • City of Dripping Springs

  • And own the entire permitting process end-to-end.

Cross-functional Design Leadership

  • Work closely with global architects, designers, and MEP teams

  • Collaborate daily with construction in Austin to ensure buildability

  • Guide design decisions using deep knowledge of Texas codes/standards

Technical Execution

  • Translate geotechnical & survey data into actionable plans

  • Develop drainage models, stormwater paths, and cut-fill strategies

  • Coordinate civil work packages: roads, driveways, water/sewer, utilities

  • Review consultant work and integrate it into Sanctuary standards

Systems & Standards

  • Build the foundation of Sanctuary’s civil engineering processes

  • Create templates, workflows, and documentation that scale to future communities

This is a role for someone who loves rolling up their sleeves, running models, walking the land, and making decisions that will shape a community for decades.

What You Bring

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (Master’s preferred but not required)

Experience

  • 6–10 years in site/civil design, grading, or land development

  • Residential, mixed-use, or master-planned community experience is a plus

Technical Strength

  • Grading design, stormwater management, drainage modeling

  • Road layouts, utility corridors, cut-fill optimization

  • Revit + AutoCAD Civil 3D (or equivalent tools)

Mindset

This matters more than anything else. You are someone who:

  • Thinks with both logic and imagination

  • Designs for beauty and practicality

  • Loves land, water, slope, and the challenge of making them work together

  • Thrives in ambiguity and early-stage building

  • Wants your engineering to actually mean something

Why This Role Is Special

Civil engineers rarely get to work this close to:

  • Architectural vision

  • Environmental conservation

  • Holistic community design

  • A founding team shaping an entirely new way of living

At Sanctuary, your work won’t disappear into a giant firm’s folder structure.

Your decisions will shape the roads people walk, the views they wake up to, the water that runs through the land, and the experience of a community designed to make life feel better.

This is engineering with meaning.

Engineering with heart.

Engineering that cares about people and the planet.

If you’re the kind of engineer who wants to build more than infrastructure…

If you want to build a new way of living, we’d love to meet you !

Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) maakt gebruik van intelligente camera's die nummerplaten registreren en vergelijken met beschikbare gegevens, zoals gestolen of gesignaleerde voertuigen of toegangsbeperkingen in bepaalde zones.

Binnen het ANPR-ecosysteem zijn verschillende thema's gedefinieerd om de operationele werking te versterken. De pijler Verkeer speelt daarin een belangrijke rol voor de verkeersveiligheid.

Je draagt ook bij aan procedures en documentatie die een goede samenwerking met de run-organisatie mogelijk maken. Daarbij leg je waar nodig de link met andere initiatieven binnen Verkeer en schakel je vlot tussen onderwerpen en prioriteiten.

  • Ondersteunen van change management en opleidingstrajecten voor gebruikers waar nodig.

  • Ervaring met systemen voor projectopvolging en kennisbeheer, zoals JIRA en Confluence.

Soft skills

jobs.excerpt: Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.

Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.
But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions.

Our Solutions:

→ Actirise: the display tech designed for performance
→ FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes
→ Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks
→ Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution
→ Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

  • FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.

  • We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins.

  • We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.

  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

Your Job

Your mission is to own and grow Sparteo's partnerships with its demand partners: you are the single business point of entry for all SSPs and small DSPs, such as Magnite, Index Exchange, Google, Amazon (TAM/A9) and the wider SSP portfolio, plus small and emerging DSPs, across Display, Video, CTV and Audio.

You hold the full lead on the global management of this partner portfolio (its health, performance, revenue growth and ongoing validity), acting as a business strategist for your book: you own the commercial relationship, set the revenue target, track and grow revenue partner by partner, build the growth plan and defend the roadmap, manage conflicts and escalations, activate the right internal resources (Legal, Tech, Finance) on the issues you surface, and structure the tools that make the portfolio measurable. You also qualify the new inbound demand partner opportunities that reach Sparteo and feed a clean integration pipeline.

Partner & Revenue Management

  • Lead the global management of the partner: for every SSP and DSP, you own the relationship, the revenue growth and the partner's ongoing validity end-to-end.

  • Run the operating cadence: regular business reviews (QBRs), roadmap alignment, and structuring the key touchpoints between the partner and our internal Product / Tech / Demand Operations teams.

  • Manage conflicts and escalations: own the resolution of commercial, technical and financial disputes with partners, keeping the relationship healthy while protecting Sparteo's interests.

  • Act as the internal voice of the partner: relay partner needs, specs and issues to the internal teams, and close the loop back.

  • Qualify new inbound partners: assess the technical fit, expected uplift and strategic value of the SSPs / DSPs that reach out to Sparteo, and drive the contractual negotiation with Legal where needed.

  • Feed the integration pipeline: hand off qualified, contracted partners to the Demand Operations – Integration team as a clean, prioritized brief, staying the relationship owner through onboarding, and keep a light watch on the SSP / DSP landscape to flag relevant opportunities.

Revenue tracking & growth

  • Track revenue at partner level (monthly consolidation, evolution vs M-1 / M-2, revenue share, YoY) and turn the numbers into concrete actions, leaning on the internal Partner Revenue Tracker and analytics.

  • Grow the revenue of each partner: optimization levers (bid dynamics, supply management, QPS alignment with the Tech / TAM team, format expansion, deal / PMP setup) and building the business case for scaling volume.

  • Own the yield conversation with each partner: challenge conditions, fees and performance; benchmark partners against each other; and reallocate where it maximizes net revenue.

  • Monitor and resolve financial discrepancies in coordination with Legal, Finance and Tech / TAM teams.

Structuring & internal coordination

  • Structure the tracking tools: build and maintain the dashboards and reporting (revenue, discrepancies, partner health) that give the whole Demand org visibility on the portfolio. Don't just consume the data: own the way it is monitored.

  • Activate the right internal resources on demand: according to the topics you identify, mobilize Legal (contracts, amendments), Tech / TAM (integration, throttling, specs) and Finance (billing, reconciliation). You drive and follow the process, each function owns its arbitration.

  • Trigger and follow the compliance review for any partner that involves personal-data sharing (user IDs, consent strings, seller data): loop in the DPO / Programmatic Privacy team to validate the lawful basis, DPA and data minimization before go-live. Data protection is a hard requirement, not a formality.

Your profile for this job

  • 6–10 years of experience in adtech / programmatic, on the demand or monetization side (SSP, ad exchange, publisher/SSP partnerships, yield or partner management).

  • Deep knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem: Prebid / header bidding, OpenRTB, dynamic allocation, sellers.json / ads.txt / schain, and the roles of the major SSPs (Magnite, Index, Google/AdX, Amazon TAM/A9…).

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills: you can own a relationship with a Tier-1 SSP, challenge conditions and performance, negotiate a contract, and grow revenue autonomously.

  • Conflict & stakeholder management: at ease resolving disputes with partners and mobilizing internal functions (Legal, Tech, Finance) to get them closed.

  • Analytical & tooling mindset: comfortable reading revenue and performance data (RPM, fill, win rate, discrepancies) and structuring it into dashboards and an action plan.

  • Contract literacy: at ease coordinating and negotiating contracts, IOs and DPAs with Legal, and aware of GDPR obligations when partners exchange personal data.

  • Sound judgment on inbound BD: able to rigorously qualify an inbound partner opportunity and build a revenue-backed business case, without losing rigor on the existing portfolio.

  • Language: fluent French and English (internal + partner communication).

  • AI-native reflex: you structure your processes and documentation so intelligent systems can help you scale partner ops.

  • A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints. You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision.

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.

  • 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

  • 🌴 RTT Days: We support work-life balance with additional rest days (RTT), provided based on position and tenure, empowering you to recharge and enjoy life outside of work.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process!

Here are the stages in our recruitment process

  • Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  • Analytical and business logic tests

  • Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager

  • Taking up references

Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

jobs.description:
The Security Operations Engineer builds and operates security controls, tooling, and automation across DeepHealth's cloud and corporate environments. This role is responsible for configuring, integrating, and maintaining the enterprise security tooling stack, developing detection content, and automating security operations tasks so that controls are repeatable, version-controlled, and auditable.

Working within DeepHealth's established security frameworks and under the direction of the Director, Security Operations, this position operates and tunes security controls, detection content, and guardrails. Independent validation of those controls sits with the security operations watch function — a deliberate separation that keeps the control environment defensible under audit. Remediation follows system ownership across Cloud Operations, Platform, and Application Development; this role supplies technical guidance and implements fixes directly where the control is security-owned.

This position operates within a regulated healthcare environment across a global operating footprint, with obligations under HIPAA, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2. The role reports to the Director, Security Operations, with future reporting to the Manager, Security Operations as that position is established.

Requirements

  • Build, configure, integrate, and tune the enterprise security tooling stack across cloud and corporate environments.
  • Develop and maintain detection content, correlation rules, and response automation within the SIEM and SOAR platform.
  • Onboard new log sources and telemetry feeds, validating ingestion completeness, parsing accuracy, and field normalization.
  • Administer and tune endpoint detection and response tooling, including policy configuration, exclusion governance, and coverage validation.
  • Integrate security tooling with adjacent platforms through APIs to reduce manual handling and improve data quality.
  • Implement and maintain security configurations, guardrails, and baselines across Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, and Microsoft Azure.
  • Build and maintain security automation and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or an equivalent framework, so that controls are version-controlled, repeatable, and auditable.
  • Implement policy-as-code and preventive guardrails using native cloud policy engines or an equivalent open policy framework.
  • Support cloud security posture management across all cloud environments, including finding deduplication, theme mapping, and routing to owning teams.
  • Harden cloud resources including compute, storage, database, container, and serverless services against established benchmarks.
  • Configure and maintain Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security controls, including conditional access, identity protection, and Defender workloads in a hybrid directory environment.
  • Implement and maintain least-privilege access models, roles, and policies across multiple cloud identity systems.
  • Implement container and Kubernetes security controls, including role-based access control, workload security standards, image scanning, and runtime protection.
  • Implement and maintain secrets management practices and tooling, and support the elimination of hard-coded credentials across environments.
  • Operate vulnerability management tooling, validate scan coverage, and translate raw scanner output into prioritized, owner-routed findings.
  • Provide technical remediation guidance to cloud, platform, identity, application, and endpoint owners, who retain accountability for closure of findings in their systems.
  • Implement engineering fixes for findings that fall to security-owned tooling and configuration.
  • Support remediation tracking for penetration test and vulnerability assessment findings by supplying technical detail and validating that fixes are technically sound.
  • Support incident detection and response through hands-on technical investigation, including log analysis, endpoint examination, identity and authentication tracing, and cloud audit log review.
  • Support escalations raised by the external managed security partner by supplying technical analysis and environment context.
  • Provide feedback into detection quality and alert tuning to reduce noise and improve signal for the monitoring function.
  • Contribute technical findings to post-incident review, and implement the resulting control and detection improvements.
  • Participate in tabletop exercises and resilience testing, and act on the technical gaps those exercises surface.
  • Document all engineering changes to security controls through the change management process, including validation criteria and rollback plans.
  • Produce and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and technical operating procedures for repeatable security operations tasks.
  • Write clear, documented, and reviewable code and configuration so that work can be inspected, maintained, and handed over without dependence on any one individual.
  • Support audit, certification, and customer assurance activities by producing technical evidence on request.
  • Maintain accurate inventory of security tooling, control coverage, licensing position, and control operating status.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of security testing results, control configuration detail, and investigative material, and follow established standards for external disclosure.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, security engineering, or a comparable technical security role. (Required)
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. (Required)
  • 2+ years of hands-on cloud security experience across at least one major cloud provider; Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services preferred. (Required)
  • 2+ years operating and tuning a SIEM platform, including working with detection content and log sources. (Required)
  • 1+ year administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security controls in a hybrid directory environment. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of security automation; experience with scripting and infrastructure-as-code is required, with Terraform experience preferred. (Required)

  • Working knowledge of secrets management tooling and practices. (Required)

  • Scripting capability in at least one of: Python, PowerShell, or Bash. (Required)
  • Familiarity with recognized security frameworks including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2. (Required)
  • Able to communicate technical findings clearly in writing and verbally to both technical and non-technical audiences. (Required)
  • Able to manage assigned work independently and escalate appropriately. (Required)
  • Available to support incident response activity outside standard business hours as required. (Required)
  • Microsoft Office experience. (Required)

Quality Standards

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP Integration Technical Architect to define and govern the integration architecture across a complex SAP and enterprise application landscape for our pharmaceutical client. You will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and reliable integrations between SAP S/4HANA, SAP cloud solutions, legacy SAP systems, and non-SAP applications, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and technical standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the SAP integration architecture, strategy, and technical standards.
  • Design end-to-end integrations across SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP cloud solutions, and third-party systems.
  • Lead architecture and technical design using SAP Integration Suite / CPI, SAP PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, OData, SOAP, REST, and RFC/BAPI.
  • Define appropriate integration patterns and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Review technical designs and provide guidance to integration developers, consultants, and vendors.
  • Support integration between SAP and enterprise platforms such as MES, LIMS, WMS, CRM, and cloud applications.
  • Work closely with SAP functional teams, Solution Architects, Security, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
  • Support modernization initiatives, including migration from SAP PI/PO to SAP Integration Suite / SAP BTP.
  • Ensure appropriate integration monitoring, error handling, security, and performance standards.
  • Support SAP transformation, migration, and global rollout programs.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as SAP Integration Architect, Technical Architect, or SAP Integration Consultant.
  • Extensive experience with SAP Integration Suite / SAP CPI.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC integrations.
  • Experience with SAP PI/PO and SAP BTP integration capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, OData, IDocs, RFC/BAPI, SFTP, XML, and JSON.
  • Strong understanding of API management, integration patterns, and integration security.
  • Experience integrating SAP with both SAP and non-SAP enterprise systems.
  • Experience within regulated pharmaceutical environments (GxP).
  • Experience working on large SAP transformation, implementation, or rollout programs.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Fluent English is required.

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

Joining Fusion means becoming part of a company that:

  • Drives delivery excellence, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
  • Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
  • Operates with a truly global mindset, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

WHAT WE OFFER - FUSION BENEFITS

We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well-being, and global mobility.

Growth & Development

  • Invest in Your Learning: Access annual budget for professional development.
  • Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
  • Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.
  • Shape an Inclusive Culture: Thrive in a workplace where your individuality is valued, and your voice drives meaningful change.

Recognition & Reward

Global Mobility & Local Support

Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S/4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

jobs.title: Video Editor / Creative Producer - Marketing & Direct Response
jobs.excerpt: About Scaling. comScaling. com is a high-end research and advisory firm helping established entrepreneurs scale their businesses 10x and build companies that no longer depend on the founder.
jobs.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com is a high-end research and advisory firm helping established entrepreneurs scale their businesses 10x and build companies that no longer depend on the founder. We combine original research, books, strategic advising, and a modern media engine to reach leaders who are ready to make consequential changes.

Our books are central to that mission. The Science of Scaling is a primary path into our work, and Power Law Strategy is the next major expression of it. Our creative library includes bestselling books, major podcast appearances, founder interviews, case studies, live events, trainings, and hundreds of verified customer stories.

We are building a creative team with the intellectual depth of a research firm, the taste of a premium editorial studio, and the accountability of a serious performance business. If you want to make work that has substance, measurable impact, and room for original judgment, this could be the defining work of your career.

The Mission

Create performance video that earns the attention and trust of serious entrepreneurs and moves the right people toward Scaling.com. We are building toward at least 40 qualified, attended enrollment calls and 10 or more enrollments per day. Your work helps create the qualified demand behind that goal.

The path is straightforward: a strong idea and credible source material become a persuasive video ad; paid distribution gives us real feedback; that feedback makes the next piece better. The work must be both beautiful and effective. Attention without trust is not enough, and polish without response is not enough.

What This Role Is

This is a hands-on performance-video role. You will receive a developed angle, key lines, source material, brand context, and performance learning. With editorial judgment and room to experiment, you will turn a strong idea into a finished paid-social ad that earns attention, builds trust, and moves the right founder to act. Think like a creative partner: understand the business idea behind the ad, spot when an angle or edit weakens the argument, and propose a better way through. The right piece can bring a founder to ideas that change how they build and lead.

You own the creative translation: approved footage, testimonials, B-roll, voiceover, motion graphics, typography, pacing, sound, color, and captions. Build and edit in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. In Premiere, you’ll build the narrative, design the sound with music and sound effects, and add appropriate visuals. In After Effects, you’ll design and animate typography, callouts, and explanatory visuals. Protect the accuracy and context of source material, research, and customer stories. Deliver organized, editable projects with traceable sources, then create purposeful variations informed by performance.

Our production workflow uses Adobe Premiere Pro for editing and Adobe After Effects for motion graphics. Editors currently using DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro are welcome to apply, but must use Premiere Pro for team editing and project handoffs once they join. Hands-on After Effects proficiency is required. You will work within Kevin Anson’s established process for source review, creative development, feedback, versioning, and delivery. Use AI to improve speed and execution while retaining responsibility for the finished work.

Who You'll Work With

  • Raleigh Norton, Head of Brand: Sets company-level creative direction, messaging, and the final standard.
  • Cody Wood, Media Buyer: Shares performance feedback, economics, and what is winning at scale.
  • Ben Lee Milner and the creative strategy/ad-writing team: Develop angles, hooks, scripts, and proof.
  • Kevin Anson, Head of Performance Post-Production: Leads the editors, directs post-production, sets the quality bar, and helps the team improve.

Requirements

Three Requirements

  • Proven performance at scale. You have personally produced and edited direct-response paid-social video for high-consideration business, founder-led, or thought-leadership offers, not just organic content or impulse-buy consumer products. Show the work, your ownership, and credible conversion or business results.
  • High character. You take responsibility, tell the truth early, receive feedback without ego, and make the people around you better. Teammates trust you when the work is hard.
  • Taste that converts. You can turn nuanced research, founder-led thought leadership, or high-consideration business offers into premium video assets for a top 1%, deep-thinker audience.

This is an artisan-level creative role with real stakes and a chance to do the best work of your career.

Game knows game. If that's you, we want to meet you!

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

jobs.description:
ACCOUNT MANAGER

This posting is for an existing vacancy. While applications are being accepted from candidates across multiple geographic regions across Canada, there is currently one (1) position available.

SUMMARY

Netagen is seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Account Manager to join our team. At Netagen, Account Managers play a visible role in helping clients get lasting value from technology and telecommunications solutions. This position is ideal for a relationship-driven sales professional who wants to own a portfolio, grow trusted client partnerships, and contribute directly to retention, expansion, and long-term customer success.

The Account Manager owns, nurtures, and expands relationships within an assigned portfolio of existing clients. This role focuses on understanding each client’s business priorities, building trusted partnerships, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring clients receive responsive, reliable service. This role also includes a targeted new-customer development component, requiring the Account Manager to build relationships with prospective clients, uncover business needs, and introduce Netagen solutions that create long-term value. Working closely with internal teams, the Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for client inquiries and helps strengthen Netagen’s reputation for long-term partnership, customer satisfaction, and growth.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned clients by understanding their business objectives, operational priorities, and evolving needs.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and client touchpoints to assess satisfaction, strengthen relationships, identify risks, and uncover renewal, retention, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Grow account revenue by identifying and pursuing opportunities that align clients’ needs with Netagen's products and services.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, proactively addressing concerns, resolving issues, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Partner with internal teams, including Operations, Shared Organizational Services, Sales Design, and Sales Support, to coordinate service delivery and develop solutions that meet client requirements.
  • Manage account renewals, contract amendments, and service changes while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and maintaining accurate account documentation.
  • Maintain current and accurate client, opportunity, pipeline, and activity records within CRM systems; prepare reports and forecasts as required.
  • Monitor client account health, identify potential risks to retention, and implement strategies to strengthen engagement and minimize churn.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, market conditions, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to provide relevant recommendations and insights to clients.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development, training, and industry events to maintain product knowledge and strengthen consultative selling capabilities.
  • Contribute to sales forecasting and business planning activities by maintaining accurate pipeline and account information
  • Achieve or exceed assigned revenue, renewal, and account growth objectives
  • Develop and execute account plans for key clients to support long-term growth, retention, and client success.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • University or College degree in business, marketing, sales or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 3+ years experience in account management, customer success, or inside sales, ideally within the technology or telecommunications industry
  • Bilingualism (English and French) considered an asset
  • Proven track record of maintaining client relationships and achieving sales or retention targets
  • Strong consultative and value-based selling capability, with experience uncovering business challenges, quantifying client impact, and positioning solutions around measurable outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, SPIN Selling, Sandler, or similar qualification and opportunity-management frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new customer opportunities while also expanding existing accounts through renewal, upsell, and cross-sell strategies.
  • Ability to build account plans, map stakeholders and decision processes, identify economic buyers, manage compelling events, and advance opportunities through a disciplined sales cycle.
  • Experience building and managing a qualified pipeline, maintaining accurate CRM data, tracking opportunity stages, and applying consistent next-step discipline.
  • Ability to forecast account growth, renewal risk, and new business opportunities using customer insights, activity metrics, and opportunity qualification criteria.
  • Confident communicator able to engage stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical contacts, business leaders, procurement teams, and executive decision-makers.
  • Skilled at discovery, active listening, objection handling, commercial negotiation, and presenting business cases that connect client needs to clear solution value.
  • Comfortable learning and selling technology, telecommunications, managed services, connectivity, collaboration, or related business solutions to commercial clients.
  • Ability to translate product, service, and market knowledge into client-specific recommendations that support retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.
  • Customer-focused, resilient, and commercially curious, with a proactive approach to solving problems, creating trust, and identifying new ways to help clients succeed.

We are looking for candidates that are serious about their careers and hold a high level of enthusiasm for building a strong successful company, as we do.

ABOUT NETAGEN

Since 2001, evolving from Combat Networks, Netagen has been leading the industry with a unique personalized approach to communication solutions, empowering Businesses and Governments to meet their goals and stay connected to things that matter the most.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base Salary Range: $70,000 - $100,000 annually

The final offer will be based on factors including experience, skills, knowledge, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a performance-based incentive plan.

Netagen also offers:

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance.
  • Long-term disability (LTD) insurance.
  • Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance.
  • Paid vacation and personal time

WHY JOIN NETAGEN?

At Netagen, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, client-focused environment where employees are empowered to make an impact, build meaningful relationships, and grow their careers.

As an Account Manager, you will have the opportunity to develop trusted client partnerships, contribute directly to business growth and work alongside experienced technology and telecommunications professionals. You’ll be supported with ongoing learning opportunities, flexible work arrangements, and a performance-driven compensation program that recognizes results.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your sales expertise, expand your industry knowledge, or take the next step in your career, Netagen offers a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions are valued and your success is recognized.

DIVERSITY EQUITY & INCLUSION

Netagen is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and lived experiences.

Accommodation is available upon request throughout the recruitment, selection, and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Overview

At Augusta Health, your work matters — and so do you. Whether you're delivering direct patient care, supporting operations, or innovating behind the scenes, every role contributes to our mission of promoting wellness and healing through compassionate service. We offer more than just a job — we offer a purpose-driven career in a nationally recognized, independent health system located in Virginia’s scenic Shenandoah Valley.

Learn more about career opportunities on our Careers Page.

Our team members thrive in a supportive culture that values collaboration, integrity, and excellence. With opportunities across clinical and non-clinical areas, Augusta Health is a place where your skills make a difference, and your growth is a priority.

That’s why Augusta Health offers a comprehensive and thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your well-being, career development, and work-life balance. Whether you're launching your career or bringing in years of experience, we provide the tools, resources, and encouragement to help empower you to reach your full potential — personally, professionally, and financially.

  • Retirement savings plans and financial wellness support programs
  • Generous paid time off and flexible scheduling to promote work-life balance
  • Career development programs including clinical ladders, shared governance, and advancement opportunities

  • Competitive pay with shift/weekend differentials
  • Employee discounts at the cafeteria, gift shop, pharmacy, and local entertainment venues (i.e., movie tickets)

Full details are available on our Benefits Page.

Job Summary

This position plays a critical role in supporting Augusta Health’s mission and advancing departmental goals through measurable performance indicators and service excellence. This position contributes to a collaborative, patient-centered environment and helps drive outcomes aligned with organizational priorities.

Under the direction of the Health Information Management Director and the Coding Manager, the Coder III follows all regulatory guidelines in the reporting and sequencing of ICD-10-CM and PCS codes for all patient accounts, generates coding queries to physicians to clarify patient condition(s) when conflicting or ambiguous information is reflected in the patient record, understands their role in quality performance measures, and serves as a resource to the Business Office in the reconciliation and resolution of problematic accounts.

This is a fully remote opportunity.

Essential Job Duties

Accurately enter ABS data (e.g. Surgeon name, procedure date, discharge disposition, admit diagnosis, POA status, etc.)

  • 95% + Accuracy

Meets or exceeds bill drop dates/AR expectations

  • Consistently monitors and manages AR to facilitate dropping of pending, old, or problematic accounts of assigned locations in accordance with 30-Day Bill Drop policy.
  • Consistently meets established bill drop dates.
  • Percentage of weeks in which bill drop dates are met:
  • 90% of the time

Accurately reports principal diagnosis in keeping with the most current AHA Coding Clinic and ICD-10-CM/ICD-10PCS guidelines.

  • 95% + Accuracy

Works with Coding Manager and Denial Management Coordinator to ensure all coding denials are addressed timely.

Manages Queries Appropriately

  • Generates appropriate query selection based on clinical evidence established in the patient medical record.
  • Formats non-standardized queries in keeping with AHA Coding Clinic, CMS, and QIO guidelines.
  • Utilizes standardized query templates when available.

Maintains established Productivity Standards

  • Inpatient encounters: an average of 2 accounts per hour.

Meets or exceeds the expected DRG/APC accuracy rate of 95%

  • Diagnosis and procedural codes applied to accounts result in the appropriate DRG or APC assignment(s)

Accurately reports procedure codes

  • All ICD-10-CM and CPT procedure codes are accurately coded and reported in keeping with AHA Coding Clinic, CPT Assistant, ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, and/or unique payer coding and reporting guidelines.
  • 95% + Accuracy

Accurately reports secondary diagnoses in keeping with the most current AHA Coding Clinic and ICD10-CM/ICD-10-PCS guidelines.

Inpatient:

  • 95% + Accuracy

Required Qualifications

  • Education: High School Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Licensure/Certification: CCS or CPC
  • Experience: Inpatient Coder - minimum of three years hospital inpatient coding experience.
  • Driver's License: N/A
  • Eligibility to work in the United States and meet Virginia state employment requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: Associate's Degree in Health Information Mgmt (HIM)
  • Licensure/Certification:
    • CCS, RHIT, RHIA
    • CCA, COC, CIC, CPA-A
  • Experience:
    • Three years inpatient coding experience.
  • Prior experience in a hospital, healthcare system, or related service-oriented environment
  • Familiarity with Augusta Health’s systems, workflows, or organizational culture is a plus

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Requires good written, oral communication and interpersonal skills. ability to effectively communicate with all hospital practitioners is essential.
  • Demonstrates competency in the use of computer applications and grouper software, Medicare edits, and all coding and abstracting software and hardware currently in use by HIM.
  • Requires comprehensive knowledge of anatomy and physiology, medical terminology and disease processes.
  • Requires analytical ability to allow for interpretation of clinical data in all clinical specialties to determine appropriate code assignment.
  • Requires proficiency in abstracting chart data into computer module.
  • Requires ability to work independently, an eagerness to learn, attention to detail and good critical thinking skills.
  • Must possess high ethical standards due to confidential nature of patient information.

About Augusta Health

Augusta Health is an independent, nonprofit, mission-driven health system located in Fishersville, Virginia, in the heart of the Shenandoah Valley. We offer a full continuum of inpatient and outpatient services, including Augusta Medical Center—a 255-bed facility—and Augusta Medical Group, which operates 40 practice locations and four urgent care centers. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and compassionate care makes Augusta Health a leading employer and healthcare provider in the region.
