ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSE

Everyday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee. We're a fast-growing, nine-figure omni-channel brand with a loyal, high-retention subscriber base, and we're scaling our retention function to match our ambitions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Marketing Specialist, Brand Operations to own the operational details that keep our products, packaging, and retail launches moving smoothly.

This role sits at the intersection of Brand, Sales, Supply Chain, and Project Management. You’ll own the item data, GTINs, retailer setup, packaging changes, spec sheets, and documentation that turn a new product or pack change into something that’s actually ready to sell.

You’ll work closely with Sales and eCommerce to support retailer item setup across major accounts, while partnering with Creative, Supply Chain, and our Senior Project Manager to make sure packaging and product information is accurate, organized, and delivered on time.

This is a detail-heavy role for someone who enjoys keeping complex information organized, catching issues before they become problems, and making sure the operational side of the brand stays buttoned up as we scale.

This role is fully remote and open to candidates based in the U.S. You’ll work closely with teams and partners operating primarily in Pacific and Central time zones.

Requirements

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You’ll take primary ownership of several core areas of our brand operations:

  • Item Data & GTINs: Own GS1 UPC/GTIN creation across unit, inner, and case configurations, along with SKU master data and product specification sheets.
  • Retailer Item Setup: Manage new-item forms and retailer data portals in partnership with Sales and eCommerce across accounts including Target, Walmart, Kroger, Sam’s Club, Costco, and Amazon.
  • Launch Execution: Manage GTINs, item setup, label copy, and artwork routing for innovation launches in partnership with the Senior Project Manager.
  • Retail Support: Maintain the spec sheets, samples, forms, and product information Sales and broker partners need to support our retail business.
  • Brand Operations: Maintain artwork, dieline, and claims libraries, version control, and our pack-change tracker in Asana.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own product data: Create and maintain GS1 UPCs and GTINs for units, inners, and cases while keeping SKU master data and product specifications accurate and up to date.
  • Manage retailer setup: Complete new-item forms and maintain product information across retailer portals and systems such as Syndigo, 1WorldSync, and RIVIR.
  • Support major retail accounts: Partner with Sales and eCommerce on item setup and product data requirements for Target, Walmart, Kroger, Sam’s Club, Costco, Amazon, and other retail partners.
  • Coordinate pack changes: Manage the operational details behind shippers, displays, club packs, retailer-specific packs, promotional packs, and other packaging changes.
  • Support product launches: Own GTIN creation, item setup, label copy coordination, and artwork routing for new product launches, working within the broader project timeline.
  • Maintain retail materials: Keep spec sheets, samples, retailer forms, and other supporting materials organized and accessible for Sales and broker partners.
  • Track changes: Maintain the pack-change tracker in Asana and provide clear visibility into open items, owners, and status.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, eCommerce, Creative, Supply Chain, and Project Management to keep product and packaging information accurate and launches moving forward.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3-4+ years of experience in brand operations, marketing operations, retail operations, product data, CPG, or a related role.
  • Experience working with product or item data, including SKU information, product specifications, UPCs, or GTINs.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage high volumes of product information without losing accuracy.
  • Experience supporting packaging, artwork, label, or product change workflows.
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders at once.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Sales, Creative, Supply Chain, eCommerce, or Operations.
  • Strong written communication and follow-up skills—you keep open items moving and make sure details don’t fall through the cracks.
  • Comfortable working in project management and tracking tools such as Asana.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where new products, retailer requests, and packaging changes may be happening simultaneously.
  • You’re highly detail-oriented and enjoy being the person who makes sure the operational pieces behind a launch are accurate, organized, and ready to go.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working within a CPG, food and beverage, wellness, or consumer products brand.
  • Experience with GS1 and creating or managing UPCs and GTINs.
  • Experience with retailer item setup and data portals such as Syndigo, 1WorldSync, or RIVIR.
  • Familiarity with major retailer requirements across Target, Walmart, Kroger, Sam’s Club, Costco, or Amazon.
  • Experience coordinating artwork routing, dielines, proofs, packaging changes, or print production.
  • Experience supporting both DTC and retail channels.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first two quarters, you’ve taken ownership of our item data, GTINs, retailer setup, and brand operations workflows. Product and retailer information is accurate and organized, packaging changes are clearly tracked, and Sales and broker partners have the materials they need without chasing them down.

You’re successfully supporting new product and retail launches alongside the Senior Project Manager, with GTINs, item setup, label copy, artwork routing, and retailer requirements completed on time. Our artwork, dieline, claims, and product information libraries are organized and version-controlled, and the team has clear visibility into active pack changes through Asana.

Benefits

COMPENSATION RANGE

The typical salary range for this position is: $75,000 - $85,000

The actual salary offer will take into account multiple factors including skills, experience, education and location. Please note that the salary details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, not total compensation, which includes benefits.

BENEFITS

Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

Everyday Dose offers comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and prescription plan coverage for all team members working 32+ hours per week. Eligibility begins on the first of the month following your start date, and we cover 75% of employee premiums.

401K Match

Starting on the first day of your fourth month with the company, you are eligible to participate in our company-sponsored 401(k) plan. The company offers a match of up to 80% of your contributions, capped at 5% of your salary.

Flexible Wellness Credits

At Everyday Dose, we prioritize your health and well-being. To support you, we provide salaried employees a $500 monthly wellness credit through JOON, which can be used for a variety of health and wellness-related services.

Helpr Support for Families

At Everyday Dose, we know that supporting our team means supporting their families too. That’s why we partner with Helpr — a modern backup childcare and family support platform that gives employees access to vetted, reliable caregivers. Helpr is here to make sure our team has trusted childcare support when they need it most — at home and at work.

Position Title:

Northern Kentucky University’s School of Allied Health is seeking applications for a full-time tenure-track faculty member to join the online accelerated Master of Science in Health Administration Program. The School of Allied Health, housed within the College of Health and Human Services, is a multidisciplinary unit offering both graduate and undergraduate clinical and non-clinical degree programs. This position is a 9-month appointment reporting to the Director of the School of Allied Health. Additional summer teaching opportunities may be available.

‌

Position Responsibilities:

  • Teaching: Courses taught may include healthcare systems and environment, healthcare leadership, applied research methods, healthcare quality and project management, and others as needed. Capstone and internship field project management and coordination may be additional responsibilities associated with this faculty position. All program courses are taught online in accelerated 7-week sessions.

  • Scholarship: The successful candidate will develop and maintain a record of research and scholarship, as required for tenure.

  • Service: Active participation in service and committee work across a variety of levels at the department, college, and university levels is expected. Collaboration with the program director to contribute to ongoing program and course review and development is a key aspect of this role.

Required Education & Qualifications:

Earned doctoral degree in health administration/management, health policy, public health or related discipline. Through education and experience is able to teach the courses identified in the position responsibilities. Evidence of at least 2 years effective teaching in accelerated and online courses. Evidence of individual, collaborative and/or multi-disciplinary research and scholarship that contributes to the advancement their profession. At least 3 years of experience as a leader/administrator in the healthcare industry.

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated experience in online course review, online course development, leading internship field projects and capstone courses. Member of the American College of Healthcare Executives (ACHE) Involvement with the Association of University Programs in Health Administration (AUPHA) At least 5 years’ experience as an administrator/executive leader in a healthcare organization Research and scholarship focus in the field of healthcare administration or area of study specific to those in the NKU MSHA curriculum. Documented graduate level education and/or professional experience in the fields of health policy and health care management.

Please include:

  • Cover letter that addresses the applicant's qualifications based on the position announcement

  • CV

  • Statement of Teaching Philosophy

  • Contact information for three professional references

Master of Science in Health Administration Mission Statement:

The mission of the Master of Health Administration program at Northern Kentucky University is to develop competent, compassionate, and career‑ready healthcare leaders through rigorous, student‑centered, competency‑based graduate education and applied scholarship. Grounded in ethical practice and evidence‑based management, the program prepares early- to mid‑career professionals to lead healthcare organizations, improve system performance, and positively impact the health and well‑being of the communities they serve.

College of Health and Human Services Mission Statement:

The College of Health & Human Services is a globally inclusive leader for student-centered learning that improves the quality of life of the populations we serve.

NKU Mission Statement:

Northern Kentucky University delivers innovative, student-centered education and engages in impactful scholarly and creative endeavors, all of which empower our graduates to have fulfilling careers and meaningful lives, while contributing to the economic, civic, and social vitality of the region.

  • Able to juggle multiple workstreams under tight deadlines.

  • History of working well with business professionals, and with cross-functional teams (internal and external).

jobs.excerpt: Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.
jobs.description:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote role that must be based in EST.

At Tines, our Customer Experience organization is recognized by customers for the quality of our work, responsiveness to their needs, and commitment to helping them realize meaningful value from our platform.

Within Customer Experience, the Renewals team plays a critical role in protecting and growing our customer relationships by creating a predictable, consistent, and customer-centered renewal experience. Renewal Managers partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to manage the commercial renewal process, navigate complex negotiations, identify risk early, and ensure customers can continue their partnership with Tines with clarity and confidence.

As Manager, Renewals, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of Renewal Managers responsible for executing renewals across our customer base. You will be accountable for renewal performance, forecasting accuracy, commercial execution, team development, and the processes that allow the function to scale.

You will also play a key role in strengthening the broader customer lifecycle at Tines, helping establish clear ownership and operating rhythms between Customer Success, Renewals, and Sales while ensuring that customer value, risk, and commercial strategy come together effectively at renewal.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead and develop a team of Renewal Managers, providing coaching, commercial guidance, and clear direction to drive strong customer and business outcomes.
  • Own renewal performance across the portfolio, with accountability for Gross Revenue Retention, renewal rate, churn and contraction outcomes, and on-time renewal execution.
  • Establish and maintain a consistent renewal forecast, providing leadership with clear visibility into renewal timing, risk, expected outcomes, and areas requiring intervention.
  • Guide Renewal Managers through complex customer negotiations involving pricing, contract terms, multi-year agreements, competitive pressure, procurement, and other commercial challenges.
  • Ensure renewal engagement begins early and that Renewal Managers have the customer context, risk signals, value realization, and relationship insights required to execute effectively.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure clear ownership between customer outcomes and commercial renewal execution, with CSMs focused on value, adoption, relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewals leads the commercial renewal process.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to identify and coordinate expansion opportunities associated with renewal cycles while maintaining clear ownership across teams.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to improve renewal forecasting, CRM workflows, dashboards, automation, reporting, and operational discipline.
  • Develop scalable renewal motions across customer segments, including high-touch, mid-touch, and digital or automated approaches where appropriate.
  • Establish clear renewal playbooks, timelines, escalation paths, handoffs, and operating cadences that create consistency for customers and internal teams.
  • Establish and manage metrics and KPIs that measure renewal effectiveness, including GRR, logo retention, forecast accuracy, renewal timing, cycle time, multi-year adoption, team productivity, and portfolio health.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain strong commercial talent as the Renewals function and company continue to scale.

What will you bring with you?

  • 7+ years of experience in SaaS, enterprise software, Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, Sales, or a similar commercial customer-facing environment.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated track record of coaching and developing high-performing customer-facing or commercial teams.
  • Experience owning or managing a meaningful recurring revenue portfolio and delivering against retention or renewal targets.
  • A strong understanding of SaaS business metrics including ARR, Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, churn, contraction, renewal rate, and expansion.
  • Experience building and managing renewal forecasts with a high degree of operational rigor and predictability.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience navigating pricing, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and customer objections.
  • The ability to coach teams through complex commercial situations while balancing customer relationships, revenue protection, and long-term business value.
  • Experience working closely with Customer Success and Sales teams to coordinate customer strategy and commercial outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify trends, diagnose performance, and determine where intervention is required.
  • A track record of improving workflows, standardization, automation, or systems to increase organizational efficiency and capacity.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and demonstrated ability to influence Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to navigate both detailed commercial discussions and senior executive conversations.

What success looks like

In this role, you will build a Renewals organization that creates greater predictability for the business and a simpler, more consistent experience for customers.

Your team will engage customers earlier, identify and address risk before renewals become reactive, execute commercial conversations with confidence, and provide accurate visibility into renewal outcomes. Customer Success teams will be able to remain focused on driving value, adoption, strategic relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewal Managers bring dedicated commercial expertise to the renewal process.

At the same time, you will help Tines develop a renewal motion that can scale with the business combining strong talent, clear ownership, operational discipline, automation, and data to improve retention and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

Target Annual Compensation: $150-170K OTE (70/30 split)

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

The Senior Data Engineer will design, build, and maintain data infrastructure and data ingestion frameworks that support data-driven reporting across the organization and for external vendors. This role will collaborate with cross-functional value stream teams, business teams, architects, and testers to design and implement scalable data solutions on AWS while providing technical guidance and contributing to architectural decisions.

What you will do:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and optimize scalable data and file ingestion frameworks for performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional value stream teams, analysts, business stakeholders, architects, testers, and colleagues to understand and refine data requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and develop best practices.
  • Implement data governance and security best practices.
  • Troubleshoot data integrity, data application, and performance issues.
  • Participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards.
  • Mentor more junior engineers and provide technical guidance on complex projects.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and design discussions.
  • Advise on and support strategic initiatives to mitigate or alleviate core data application issues, including opportunities for process automation.
  • Stay current with trends and technologies in data engineering and apply them to improve the data framework.
  • Complete other duties as assigned.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, including Information Systems, Mathematics, or Software Engineering, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
  • 4 to 6 years of data engineering experience with a proven track record of designing and implementing scalable ingestion frameworks.
  • Proficiency in ETL development and design using Python, PySpark, and Big Data technologies, including Hadoop and Spark.
  • Strong SQL knowledge and RDBMS experience with a recognized database such as Postgres, Redshift, or MySQL.
  • Hands-on experience with the AWS platform using DynamoDB, EMR Serverless, Lambdas, and related technologies.
  • Deep understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with Agile methodology and Scrum processes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as lead more junior engineers.

What will set you apart:

  • Ability to communicate in a friendly and professional manner with customers and colleagues, remain calm in stressful situations, independently troubleshoot program errors regardless of technology, and write user-friendly explanations of highly technical functionality.
  • Customer focus demonstrated through internal and external service excellence, listening skills, patience, empathy, authenticity, proactivity, and perseverance. Ability to deliver timely, optimal solutions while balancing customer needs with the best interests of the organization and maintaining a positive approach despite challenges or constraints.
  • Ability to build collaborative and cooperative partnerships, effectively manage conflict, find common ground, and build trust with coworkers, managers, partners, and customers. Demonstrates inclusiveness and appreciation for diverse backgrounds, cultures, thoughts, and experiences; operates with integrity; communicates respectfully; and supports the success of others.

Base Salary Range

$105,700.00 - $149,275.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. jobs.excerpt: Be Part of Something EternalNearly 2 billion Muslims have never heard the saving message of Jesus Christ.
jobs.description:
Be Part of Something Eternal

Nearly 2 billion Muslims have never heard the saving message of Jesus Christ. At Frontiers, we believe God is calling His Church to change that. We partner with local churches to send workers to the Muslim world—workers who make disciples and plant churches where the Gospel has never been heard.

If you’re passionate about mobilizing the Church for global mission and equipping leaders to fulfill the Great Commission, this role is for you.

Coaching. Support. Shepherd.

As a Pastoral Coach, you’ll come alongside field workers serving around the world, providing spiritual encouragement, prayer, coaching, and relational support so they can thrive in their walk with Jesus and remain effective in their ministry. If you have a heart for missions, a passion for caring for others, and a desire to invest in the wellbeing of cross-cultural workers, this is an opportunity to make a lasting Kingdom impact.

At Frontiers, we believe God is calling His Church to bring the Gospel to the least-reached Muslim peoples. Our field workers serve in some of the most challenging and spiritually significant places on earth. Through intentional relationships, pastoral care, and Christ-centered coaching, the Barnabas Team helps sustain and strengthen those on the front lines of ministry. As a Pastoral Coach, you will play a vital role in encouraging, equipping, and caring for workers as they faithfully pursue God's calling among the nations.

About the Role

As a Pastoral Coach, you will:

  • Seek to develop and maintain active relationships with field workers and their teams.
  • Read newsletters and email updates from selected Frontiers field workers to keep track of their status and general wellbeing.
  • Seek to debrief field workers upon their home assignment and follow up as necessary.
  • When workers return from the field in transition or in another type of extended field leave, provide pastoral leadership and accountability as needed.
  • Establish a rhythm of prayer and spiritual support encouraging field workers to thrive in their relationship with Jesus.
  • Initiate relationships with workers at every opportunity. Seek to be available for encouragement, coaching, counseling and prayer.
  • Raise 100% of your financial support (salary, benefits, ministry expenses)

What We’re Looking For

  • A personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a heart for missions
  • Previous missions experience either 2-3 years living overseas or extensive interaction with field workers.
  • Heart for missions, cross cultural workers, Muslims and pastoring others.
  • Ability to travel 2-3 times per year and willing to raise funds as needed for coaching trips and IC.
  • Pastoral or Life Coaching experience preferred.
  • A track record of being sought by people for pastoring, especially by field workers.
  • Ability to travel occasionally and raise personal support
  • Spiritual gifts in leadership, encouragement, and teaching
  • Ability to raise and maintain personal support

Why Join Frontiers?

When you join Frontiers, you become part of a grace-filled, mission-driven community that:

  • Prioritizes the least-reached– We focus on Muslim peoples with no sustainable Gospel witness.
  • Catalyzes movements– Everything we do contributes to planting healthy, reproducing churches.
  • Empowers teams– Our teams serve with a common vision and freedom to pursue locally appropriate strategies.
  • Values lifelong learning– We are dedicated to coaching, mentoring, and continuous growth.
  • Operates with integrity– Decisions are made by those closest to the action, ensuring effectiveness and accountability.
  • Work-Life culture– We encourage healthy rhythms, flexibility, and margin so team members can sustainably pursue their calling, invest deeply in relationships, and serve with excellence—both in the work and in the mission beyond it.

About Ancestry:

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

Ancestry seeks an exceptional, passionate, and highly motivated Machine Learning Engineer Co-Op to join our MLE team this summer. The MLE team is responsible for developing, deploying, fine-tuning and optimizing machine learning models and LLMs to enhance customer experiences, improve internal workflows, and drive business impact. We collaborate closely with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to build scalable and efficient ML solutions that power critical features across our platform. As a Machine Learning Engineer Co-Op on the MLE team, you will work on integrating ML models and Generative AI (GenAI) models, enabling ML/LLM-powered applications, and developing AI agents using agentic frameworks. You will contribute to optimizing model inference, automating ML workflows, and building intelligent AI-driven solutions to improve decision-making and user engagement. This is a part-time, work-study-based opportunity for active students in master's and PhD programs.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop and deploy machine learning and large language models.

  • Build and optimize AI agents to enhance automation and decision-making.

  • Optimize model inference speed, storage efficiency, and scalability for real-world applications.

  • Develop pipelines and MLOps workflows to streamline model training, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Contribute to ML, LLMs, agent evaluation and monitoring platform.

  • Experiment with new ML, LLM, and Agent technologies.

Who You Are:

  • Currently pursuing an advanced degree (Master's or PhD preferred) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Linguistics, Engineering or related quantitative field with a strong data focus.

  • Proficient in Python and familiar with ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn.

  • Experience with GenAI, LLMs, and agentic frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen).

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to write clean, efficient, and scalable code.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Curiosity and go-getter attitude

  • Experience with cloud platforms, ML development tools, and ML deployment tools.

  • Nice to have: Familiarity NodeJS or Java

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, OpenSearch), LLM optimization, VLLM library, HuggingFace library or reinforcement learning techniques.

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

About this position

The Finance Transformation Analyst plays a key role in driving the modernization and continuous improvement of finance processes, systems, data, and reporting capabilities. This position partners with Finance, IT, Shared Services (Carrier Business Solutions), and business stakeholders to support transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, standardization, automation, data quality, and decision-making.

The analyst will support strategic finance programs such as ERP implementations, Central Finance (CFIN), Group Reporting, financial close optimization, automation initiatives, reporting enhancements, and process harmonization efforts. The role requires strong analytical, financial, and project management skills, along with the ability to translate business requirements into practical solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong finance knowledge with technology and process improvement expertise. They are comfortable working across business and technical teams, can analyze complex financial processes, and are passionate about helping organizations modernize their finance function through data, automation, standardization, and digital transformation.

This position follows a remote work model within the USA.

Key Responsibilities:

1) Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

  • Support finance transformation initiatives designed to improve business processes, controls, and operating efficiencies.
  • Analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, and automation.
  • Document business requirements, process flows, operating procedures, and functional specifications.
  • Support implementation of best practices across Record-to-Report (R2R), Financial Close, Group Reporting, Intercompany, and other finance processes.

2) Systems & Technology Enablement

  • Partner with Finance and IT teams on ERP and finance technology deployments.
  • Support implementation and enhancement of solutions such as SAP S/4HANA, Central Finance (CFIN), Group Reporting or similar platforms.
  • Participate in system testing activities, including SIT, UAT, defect management, and deployment readiness assessments.
  • Assist with data validation, reconciliation, and cutover activities during system implementations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting / finance / business administration / economics / commerce / data analytics.
  • 5+ years of experience in one of the following: Financial Systems (for example: ERP, Consolidations tools, Supplementary financial systems, etc.), FP&A, Accounting, or Business Analysis.
  • 5+ years experience with executing finance processes, including financial close, consolidation, reporting, planning, or intercompany accounting.
  • 2+ years experience performing reconciliation activities.
  • 2+ years experience supporting business process improvement or system implementation projects.
  • 5+ years experience with Microsoft Excel (Vlookup, Macros, Pivot Tables, writing formulas, etc.) supporting data analytics.

  • Experience supporting business process improvement or system implementation projects such as SAP S/4HANA, Central Finance (CFIN), SAP Group Reporting, BW, SAC, or other finance technology platforms.
  • Intermediate accounting knowledge and familiarity with GAAP reporting.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and solutions to support analytical tasks.
  • Knowledge of Power BI, Power Automate, Alteryx, or similar reporting and automation tools.
  • CPA, CMA, PMP, CBAP, or other relevant certifications preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience working in a matrixed global organization.

Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos:

Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoaAI Tech Lead, com paixão e experiência em arquitetura de soluções de Inteligência Artificial, escalabilidade e inovação tecnológica. Se você se considera um profissional talentoso em liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de IA e tem interesse em atuar de forma hands-on na construção de soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e automações em produção, essa é a sua chance! Você fará parte do time responsável por impulsionar nossas iniciativas de Inteligência Artificial, atuando de forma colaborativa e remota. Sua atuação será focada na definição de arquitetura, boas práticas, padrões de desenvolvimento e operação de soluções de IA em produção, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade, observabilidade e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Buscamos uma pessoa com forte perfil de liderança técnica, capaz de orientar decisões arquiteturais, apoiar a evolução técnica do time, mentorar pessoas desenvolvedoras, avaliar tecnologias emergentes e contribuir ativamente para a construção de pipelines, integrações, automações e práticas de engenharia necessárias para levar soluções de IA à produção com qualidade, atuando de forma colaborativa e remota. Essa é uma posição de liderança técnica, sem necessidade de gestão direta de pessoas, mas com grande protagonismo na evolução tecnológica e estratégica da área.

  • Atuar como referência técnica nas iniciativas de IA, orientando decisões de arquitetura, implementação e evolução das soluções.
  • Mentorar pessoas desenvolvedoras, apoiando boas práticas, revisão de soluções e evolução técnica do time.
  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas para soluções baseadas em IA, LLMs, agentes, RAG, integrações, processamento assíncrono e caching.
  • IA em produção: liderar tecnicamente a entrega, operação, monitoramento, troubleshooting e melhoria contínua de soluções de IA em ambiente produtivo.
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines, automações e práticas de engenharia para desenvolvimento, avaliação, deployment e monitoramento de aplicações de IA.
  • Definir padrões técnicos relacionados a qualidade de código, segurança, observabilidade, documentação e manutenção das soluções.
  • Avaliar ferramentas, frameworks e abordagens de IA para recomendar os melhores caminhos técnicos para o contexto da empresa.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de Produto, Dados, Segurança e outras áreas para garantir viabilidade técnica e impacto das soluções.
  • Contribuir hands-on no desenvolvimento de soluções, definição de padrões e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software, preferencialmente com 5 anos ou mais de atuação em engenharia.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento, entrega e operação de soluções de IA em produção.
  • Experiência atuando como referência técnica, Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer ou papel equivalente de liderança técnica.

  • Experiência com automação de processos, pipelines, CI/CD, data pipelines ou práticas de DevOps aplicadas a soluções de IA..
  • Conhecimento em embeddings, busca semântica e avaliação de qualidade de respostas.
  • Capacidade de orientar tecnicamente outras pessoas, revisar soluções, propor padrões e tomar decisões técnicas bem fundamentadas.
  • Proficiência em Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento colaborativo.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura, redes, protocolos de comunicação e ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, debugging e troubleshooting de sistemas em produção.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência mais profunda com MLOps, LLMOps, avaliação, versionamento, monitoramento e melhoria contínua de soluções de IA.
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning, Analytics e Big Data, incluindo ferramentas como Spark, Hadoop, Pandas e Python.

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Datadog, Langfuse ou similares.
  • Experiência liderando tecnicamente iniciativas de IA do discovery à produção.

Function: PEO DHMS

Location: Remote

Reports to: Program Leadership

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Microsoft Power Platform Developer supports both the Enterprise Intelligence and Data Solutions (EIDS) and Defense Healthcare Management System Modernization (DHMSM) programs by building and maintaining applications, reporting, and automation that help teams manage products, portfolios, workflows, and program performance.

This role is hands-on and execution focused, with a primary emphasis on advanced Microsoft Power Apps development. The individual will design, enhance, and maintain business applications while also using Power Automate, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft 365 to create integrated solutions that support day-to-day program operations and leadership decision-making.

The developer will support requirements across both EIDS and DHMSM and should be comfortable working across multiple teams, stakeholders, and priorities. The role requires someone who can understand a business need, determine the right technical approach, and independently deliver a practical and maintainable solution.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Power Apps developer who also understands how reporting, automation, data, and program processes fit together in a complex enterprise environment.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Power Apps Development

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain advanced Microsoft Power Apps solutions
  • Serve as a strong hands-on Power Apps developer capable of independently translating business requirements into working applications
  • Support applications used to manage products, projects, documentation, portfolio activities, and operational workflows
  • Manage and prioritize Power Apps development backlogs and deliver enhancements iteratively
  • Integrate Power Apps with Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and other approved data sources
  • Troubleshoot application performance, usability, data, and integration issues
  • Design solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and easy for program teams to use
  • Apply sound practices for application security, permissions, data access, and lifecycle management

Power Automate and Workflow Automation

  • Develop Power Automate workflows to connect applications, data, and business processes
  • Automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual effort across program workflows
  • Build reliable and maintainable automation that supports Power Apps and other Microsoft-based solutions
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and improve existing automations as business needs evolve

Power BI Development and Reporting

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards using data from multiple sources
  • Connect Power BI to Microsoft Azure DevOps and other systems to support portfolio and execution reporting
  • Perform data transformation, modeling, and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability
  • Create clear visualizations that translate program data into useful information for leadership and delivery teams
  • Support reporting requirements that complement Power Apps and broader Power Platform solutions

Azure DevOps Integration

  • Use Microsoft Azure DevOps as a data source and integration point for Power Platform solutions
  • Develop applications and reporting that support portfolio management, delivery tracking, backlog management, and performance measurement
  • Apply a strong technical understanding of Azure DevOps data structures, work items, and reporting capabilities
  • Help connect Azure DevOps information with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI where appropriate

Cross-Program Support

  • Support Power Platform needs across both EIDS and DHMSM
  • Work with stakeholders across multiple teams to understand, prioritize, and deliver requirements
  • Balance competing priorities and adjust work as program needs change
  • Build solutions that can be used across teams when common requirements or opportunities exist
  • Maintain clear visibility into work in progress, dependencies, risks, and expected delivery timelines

SAFe and Portfolio Context

  • Design applications and reporting aligned with SAFe concepts, particularly portfolio management and execution tracking
  • Support leadership visibility into priorities, capacity, schedules, dependencies, and delivery
  • Apply SAFe and portfolio context when designing solutions so that applications and reporting are relevant to actual program operations

Collaboration and Enablement

  • Work closely with program teams, analysts, product owners, and leadership to gather and refine requirements
  • Translate business needs into clear technical solutions without requiring stakeholders to define the technical approach
  • Demonstrate solutions, incorporate feedback, and refine applications as requirements evolve
  • Provide documentation and guidance to support adoption and long-term maintenance
  • Help teams transition to new applications, reporting, and automated workflows

BASIC JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 6–8 years of hands-on experience delivering Microsoft Power Platform solutions in complex enterprise environments
  • Strong demonstrated experience designing and developing Microsoft Power Apps, including complex applications used by business or program teams
  • Experience integrating Power Apps with Power Automate, Microsoft 365, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and other data sources
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and improve Power Apps performance, usability, and maintainability
  • Experience building Power BI dashboards using multiple data sources
  • Experience integrating Microsoft Azure DevOps with Power Platform solutions for reporting, workflow, or metrics
  • Working knowledge of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), particularly portfolio and execution concepts
  • Ability to manage multiple development priorities and work across different teams or programs
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear and effective technical solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • U.S. Citizen

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Advanced Power Apps development capability
  • Strong technical and functional judgment
  • Ability to independently translate requirements into practical solutions
  • Ability to design solutions that answer real business and operational needs
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across teams and programs
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in an environment where requirements and priorities may evolve

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Microsoft Power Platform Developer Associate
  • Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate
  • Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certification
Salary: $90hr C2C Available

Order Operations Specialist (Remote) Location: 100% Remote / Virtual Must Reside In: Austin, TX or any of the following states – AL, AZ, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, NC, NV, OH, OR, SC, TN, TX, VA, WI. Job Type: Full-Time, Exempt (Salaried) Compensation: $45,000–$55,000 base salary + quarterly bonus opportunities Position Overview The Order Operations Specialist is responsible for executing the full order lifecycle with a high degree of accuracy, ensuring all client purchases are correctly structured, processed, and aligned for downstream billing, tax handling, and financial reporting. This role serves as a critical control point within the revenue process. While transactional in nature, the position requires strong attention to detail and accountability, as errors directly impact invoicing accuracy, revenue recognition, and client experience.

Core Responsibilities Order Lifecycle Execution Execute the end-to-end processing of all customer orders across internal systems. Ensure that all required fields, product selections, pricing structures, and service configurations are complete and accurate prior to finalization. Pricing & Product Validation Validate pricing, discounts, promotions, and bundled services against approved company standards. Confirm that all order components align with current product offerings and pricing structures. Billing Readiness & Financial Alignment Ensure all orders are properly structured for invoicing, including subscription setup, billing cadence, payment terms, and tax applicability. Identify and resolve discrepancies before orders are handed off to Finance. Data Integrity & System Accuracy Maintain consistent and accurate data across CRM, ordering platforms, and billing systems. Ensure alignment between systems to prevent downstream reconciliation issues. Cross-Functional Coordination Act as an operational liaison between Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Communicate order status, clarify discrepancies, and ensure alignment across teams. Issue Identification & Resolution Support Proactively identify order-related issues and discrepancies. Resolve straightforward issues independently and escalate complex cases with clear documentation and context.

Ownership & Accountability

  • Accuracy and completeness of all processed orders
  • Timeliness of order execution
  • Integrity of order data across all systems
  • Reduction of billing errors and rework

Success Metrics

  • Order accuracy rate
  • Order processing turnaround time
  • Billing discrepancy rate
  • Internal response time / SLA adherence

Required Skills

  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Clear and professional communication skills
  • Accountability and ownership mindset

Systems Environment

  • Salesforce CRM (or comparable CRM)
  • WooCommerce or equivalent ordering system
  • Subscription billing platforms
  • Avalara or comparable tax tools
  • Office 365

Experience 1–3 years in order processing, operations, or administrative support roles This is a fully remote role. However, you must reside in one of the following states:

  • Arizona, Alabama, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin

jobs.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Here at Malwarebytes, we believe that when you’re free from threats, you’re free to thrive.
jobs.description:
Here at Malwarebytes, we believe that when you’re free from threats, you’re free to thrive. It all started in 2008 with one person who needed help with a malware infection, and a community coming together to find solutions. In that moment in time a product was born for all people, with a mission to rid the world of malware. Our product has since grown and evolved, from removing malware, to protecting devices, to ever-changing prevention.

About Malwarebytes Inc.

Malwarebytes began after our founder, Marcin Kleczynski, accidentally infected his parents’ computer while downloading a video game as a teenager. At the time, there was no product that could fully solve the problem, so he set out to build one. That early experience shaped our mission: to create protection that works when people need it most.
Since then, the digital threat landscape has only grown more complex. Attackers are faster, stealthier, and more sophisticated, while traditional solutions often overwhelm people with complicated tools and settings. At Malwarebytes, we believe protection should be both powerful and refreshingly simple because if security feels too hard to use, people will not use it. That is why our aspiration is always to stay one step ahead: cutting through the noise, stopping threats others miss, and delivering peace of mind in an unpredictable digital world.

Malwarebytes is looking for..

We are looking for a sharp, security-minded Principal DevOps Engineer to join our Consumer team. You will architect and manage our AWS infrastructure using Terraform, enforce cloud security best practices at every layer, make cost-conscious infrastructure decisions that balance performance with efficiency, and drive modern CI/CD automation across the organization. You will own site reliability for our production systems and set the engineering standards that the team builds against. In addition to deep technical execution, you will provide leadership and mentorship to the engineering team, interface with executive leadership on platform strategy and investment, and lead cross-functional infrastructure projects. If you hold security and reliability to a high standard, default to automation over manual process, and can operate credibly at every level of the organization, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do:

  • Own and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform, applying security best practices — least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and compliance guardrails — as non-negotiable defaults.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring automated security scanning (SAST, secrets detection, container image scanning), policy enforcement, and quality gates are built into every pipeline.
  • Champion infrastructure security: proactively identify and remediate cloud misconfigurations, leverage GuardDuty, Security Hub, and Config, and partner with the Security team on vulnerability management and incident response.
  • Own and improve SRE practices: define SLOs, build alerting and observability solutions using CloudWatch and related tooling, and drive blameless post-mortems.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and own production incidents end-to-end — from detection through resolution and follow-up.
  • Maintain build and release environments for development teams and develop automation and test tooling for client applications.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps technologies through structured proof-of-concept testing.
  • Keep documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams current and actionable.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic guidance to the engineering team; conduct architecture and code reviews and define team engineering standards.
  • Interface with executive leadership to communicate platform strategy, risk, and investment tradeoffs; lead and drive cross-functional infrastructure projects from scoping through delivery.

    • Skills You'll Need to Have:

    • 10+ years of hands-on DevOps or SRE experience, with at least 5 years operating production workloads in AWS at scale — EC2, ECS, ECR, Lambda, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC, EKS, and CloudFront required.
    • BA/BS in Engineering or Computer Science preferred; equivalent experience demonstrated through a proven track record accepted. An ideal candidate holds one or more AWS Professional-level certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Professional, or equivalent).
    • Deep Terraform expertise: you write modular, reusable, well-tested infrastructure code and treat IaC security as seriously as application security.
    • Strong GitHub Actions experience building pipelines as code, including integrated security scanning (SAST, secrets detection, and container image scanning). Jenkins experience is a plus.
    • Demonstrable cloud security depth: hands-on experience with GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, SCPs, and related tools and practices.
    • Strong scripting and automation — Python, Go, or Bash — with a track record of eliminating manual toil.
    • Solid Linux system administration and container management (Docker). Windows Server and Windows container experience is a plus.
    • Proven SRE practice experience: SLO definition, observability design, and post-mortem-driven reliability improvement.
    • Familiarity with cross-platform code compilation (Windows and macOS), code signing, and software supply chain security.
    • Active, daily use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) is expected as a core part of this role — you treat these tools as a force multiplier and stay current with how AI is reshaping DevOps and SRE workflows.
    • Strong communication and documentation skills: capable of writing architecture proposals, leading design reviews, and producing runbooks that on-call engineers can act on under pressure.
    • Demonstrated ability to operate at a principal or staff engineer level — influencing architecture across teams, driving technical decisions through ambiguity, and raising engineering quality across the organization.
    • Proven experience providing technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams and interfacing with executive leadership on platform strategy, risk, and infrastructure investment decisions.

    Perks & Benefits:

    • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
    • Employee Referral Bonus Program 
    • Wellness programs  
    • An opportunity to do something great for yourself and the world!

    (Benefits and Perks subject to change by country/region)

jobs.description:
LearnTastic is looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Human Resource Executive to support the company in managing recruitment, employee relations, HR operations, compliance, employee engagement, and workplace initiatives. The ideal candidate will help ensure that HR processes run efficiently while maintaining a positive work environment, strong employee relationships, accurate records, and compliance with company policies and applicable employment requirements.

The Human Resource Executive will work closely with employees, managers, leadership, and internal teams to coordinate recruitment and onboarding, address employee concerns, maintain HR records, support performance management, organize training programs, administer payroll and benefits, monitor employee engagement, and contribute to a positive and productive workplace culture.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage day-to-day human resources operations and administrative activities.
  • Manage recruitment activities, including sourcing candidates, reviewing applications, coordinating interviews, communicating with candidates, and supporting the selection process.
  • Coordinate the onboarding process for new employees, ensuring required documentation, orientation, system access, and onboarding activities are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain regular communication with new employees throughout the onboarding process to support a smooth transition into the organization.
  • Handle employee relations matters professionally, confidentially, and in accordance with company policies.
  • Listen to employee concerns, questions, and grievances and work with managers and leadership to identify appropriate solutions.
  • Support conflict resolution and help address workplace issues in a fair, professional, and timely manner.
  • Assist managers and employees with HR-related questions, policies, procedures, and workplace concerns.
  • Ensure employees and managers understand and follow company HR policies, procedures, rules, and standards.
  • Monitor HR practices and processes to support compliance with applicable employment laws, regulations, and company requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, documentation, and HR information in Keka and Google Drive.
  • Ensure employee files, contracts, onboarding documents, attendance information, leave records, and other HR documentation are properly maintained and organized.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling employee, payroll, compensation, performance, and other sensitive HR information.
  • Support the development and implementation of HR strategies, policies, processes, and initiatives aligned with company goals.
  • Assist with performance management processes, including performance reviews, goal setting, feedback, documentation, and follow-up activities.
  • Coordinate performance review schedules and ensure managers and employees complete required performance management activities on time.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, employee experience, communication, and workplace practices.
  • Organize and coordinate employee training and development programs.
  • Work with managers and employees to identify training needs and support the planning of relevant learning and development activities.
  • Coordinate training schedules, attendance, materials, documentation, and follow-up activities.
  • Support employee engagement initiatives and activities designed to improve employee satisfaction, collaboration, motivation, and retention.
  • Monitor employee engagement and gather employee feedback through surveys, meetings, discussions, and other appropriate methods.
  • Assist in identifying employee engagement trends, concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Foster a positive, inclusive, respectful, and professional workplace culture.
  • Support company initiatives that promote employee well-being, teamwork, communication, recognition, and a strong sense of belonging.
  • Assist management in communicating HR policies, announcements, initiatives, and organizational updates to employees.
  • Administer payroll-related HR activities, ensuring employee information, attendance, leave, compensation, and other required data are accurate and submitted within established timelines.
  • Coordinate with relevant internal teams or external payroll providers to support accurate and timely payroll processing.
  • Support the administration of employee benefits, leave, attendance, and other employee programs.
  • Maintain accurate records related to payroll, benefits, attendance, leave, and employee status changes.

jobs.description:
Want to make a positive difference to the future of people and our one shared home, the Earth? Working at WWF could be your opportunity of a lifetime.

All around the world, people are waking up to the devastating impacts of climate change and nature loss. The situation today is worse than the darkest predictions of just ten years ago, pushing billions of people to the edge and threatening lives and livelihoods. At WWF, we are facing our biggest crisis – and our biggest ever opportunity – to create a better future for people and nature. With over 60 years of experience and an active presence in more than 100 countries, we work to achieve both on-the-ground and global policy action, from protecting and restoring species and their habitats, to transforming markets and policies toward sustainability.

Our people come from hugely diverse backgrounds and with a variety of expertise, ranging from conservation science and advocacy to HR and finance. We welcome applications from anyone who believes they can help us tackle this enormous global challenge and drive the urgent conservation impact needed to restore our planet.

What We Do We are an independent conservation organization, striving to sustain the natural world for the benefit of people and the ecosystem. From individuals and communities to businesses and governments, we are part of a growing global movement calling for bolder action on climate and nature, demanding that world leaders set nature on the path to recovery by 2030. WWF works to address the most dominant drivers of nature loss through system-wide changes in how food and energy are produced and consumed, and in how financial systems are structured. By implementing change in every country, we aim to drive visible and positive impacts on the ground, helping to restore nature in the most critical places around the world, from the Amazon to the Coral Triangle.

Engaging everyone means addressing the barriers to participation faced by some groups in society, including local communities. Conservation will only be sustainable if it is owned by, and benefits, local people. That’s why Indigenous Peoples and local communities must be at the centre of action on climate and nature. WWF is committed to using its resources and global network to support these communities in creating together the most effective solutions where they live.

Humanity is still in time, we have a clear pathway to solve this crisis. At WWF, we call on everyone to join the global movement, change how we live, and take action now.

  • Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, high-delivery environment.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Job Description:

GDIT's Federal Health Division is hiring a Provider Relations Specialist to support the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP).


This position is a Provider Relations role with a dedicated CCE and network-support emphasis. The specialist owns the CCE/provider relationship, intake, coordination, communication, and follow-through.

The Provider Relations Specialist – CCE & Network Support serves as a key liaison between the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP), Clinical Centers of Excellence (CCEs), healthcare delivery organizations (HDOs), and participating practitioners within the New York Metropolitan Area network.


This position supports the unique operational needs of the CCEs by helping ensure that providers required to support WTCHP members are appropriately identified, affiliated, onboarded, and supported. The Specialist works closely with CCE contacts to address provider access needs, facilitate provider nominations and network participation, resolve provider-related operational issues, and maintain strong communication between the CCEs and Provider Services.


The role requires a strong provider-service orientation and the ability to translate CCE needs into actionable Provider Services activities while coordinating across Provider Data, Credentialing, Contracting/Recruitment, Claims, and other operational teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Serve as a primary Provider Services point of contact for assigned CCEs, developing strong working relationships and understanding each CCE's provider network and operational needs.
  • Conduct regular outreach and engagement with CCE representatives to identify provider concerns, access issues, emerging needs, and opportunities for service improvement.
  • Support CCE provider nominations and referrals, ensuring requests are appropriately documented, researched, tracked, and routed through the provider affiliation and recruitment process.
  • Coordinate with Provider Network/Contracting staff when CCEs identify practitioners, specialists, facilities, or HDOs needed to support member access or continuity of care.
  • Provide CCEs with appropriate status updates regarding provider nominations, affiliation, onboarding, and other Provider Services activities.
  • Facilitate communication between CCEs and Provider Services when provider participation or operational issues require additional research or cross-functional intervention.
  • ·Support participating providers and HDOs with WTCHP requirements, operational processes, portal utilization, Terms & Conditions, roster submission, EFT, enrollment, and ongoing participation requirements.
  • Educate providers and CCE stakeholders regarding WTCHP provider processes, policies, workflows, and changes affecting network participation.
  • Coordinate provider onboarding and orientation activities to ensure newly affiliated organizations and practitioners understand WTCHP requirements and available resources.
  • Research and facilitate resolution of escalated provider issues that cannot be resolved through standard first-call resolution, including recurring or systemic concerns affecting CCE/provider relationships.
  • Partner with Provider Data, Credentialing, Claims, Contracting/Recruitment, and other operational teams to facilitate resolution while maintaining ownership of communication back to the CCE or provider.
  • Identify trends in CCE inquiries, provider escalations, access concerns, and administrative barriers and elevate findings to Provider Services leadership.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of CCE interactions, provider outreach, nominations, escalations, and follow-up activities within designated workflow and tracking systems, including JIRA where applicable.
  • Participate in CCE meetings, operational workgroups, provider education sessions, and other stakeholder forums as assigned.
  • Support reporting related to CCE engagement, provider nominations, outstanding provider issues, network access concerns, and resolution turnaround times.
  • Promote a high-touch service model designed to reduce administrative abrasion for CCEs and providers while supporting uninterrupted access to care for WTCHP members.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in provider relations, provider services, healthcare operations, health plan operations, network management, or a related healthcare environment.\Experience working directly with provider organizations, hospitals, medical groups, clinical practices, or healthcare program stakeholders strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of provider enrollment, credentialing, provider data, contracting/participation, claims, and provider lifecycle processes.
  • Strong relationship-management, communication, presentation, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate issues across multiple operational departments while maintaining ownership of the stakeholder experience.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, track open items through resolution, and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience with workflow, CRM, ticketing, or provider management systems preferred.

As we continue scaling our business, we're seeking a strategic, data-driven Sr. Director of Marketing to lead our marketing organization, drive profitable growth, and grow a world-class marketing function that can efficiently scale with the business. This role can be remote in Orlando, Miami, or Austin, TX. Strong preference for this role to physically be in Austin, TX, where the Undercover Tourist team is headquartered.

This is a rare opportunity to join an established, high-growth e-commerce company experiencing significant momentum from recently launched new product categories. You'll have the autonomy to lead the entire marketing and content team along with strategic external creator partners, with full ownership of marketing strategy, budget, and P&L impact.

You'll work directly with the GM/Head of Undercover Tourist and cross-functional leadership to lead go-to-market strategy, drive customer acquisition and retention, and maintain and enhance Undercover Tourist as the undisputed leader in family theme park travel.

At Undercover Tourist, you get the 'best of both worlds': we're large enough to have resources and scale, but small enough that you'll have significant autonomy and make a direct, measurable impact on business outcomes. You'll think strategically while also rolling up your sleeves to execute. We're fun, driven, and passionate about helping families create unforgettable vacation experiences. We do this strategically by creating (free!) comprehensive Disney and theme park planning content to engage customers throughout their journey, paired with optimized theme park commerce and exceptional value when they are ready to purchase.

Essential Functions

Strategic Leadership & Business Impact (20%)

  • Own overall marketing strategy and annual planning aligned with company revenue, budgets and growth objectives
  • Manage marketing P&L and budget allocation across paid, owned, and earned channels with clear ROI accountability
  • Drive data-driven decision making across the organization through marketing attribution, customer analytics, and performance modeling
  • Present marketing performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to both internal and external stakeholders as requested
  • Identify and execute strategic growth opportunities including new marketing channels and activations, partnerships, and customer segments

Performance Marketing & Revenue Growth (40%)

  • Own customer acquisition strategy and execution across paid media (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), SEO, email, SMS, and other channels as assigned
  • Create video and written content briefs ensuring cohesive storytelling, platform experimentation, community growth, and performance optimization
  • Drive continual SEO and AI content optimization
  • Manage annual paid media budget with clear CPA targets; optimize spend allocation based on channel performance and attribution modeling
  • Manage end-to-end creator/influencer programs including partner identification, contract negotiation, campaign briefs, and performance tracking with clear ROI measurement
  • Pitch and drive strategic marketing partnerships with key theme park partners (Walt Disney World, Disneyland, Universal Orlando) to unlock co-op marketing budgets and exclusive offers
  • Negotiate marketing collaborations, content partnerships, and joint promotional opportunities with external creator partners
  • Serve as business lead and creator liaison at high value creator activations (6-8 events annually with travel to CA/FL)
  • Explore and implement AI-driven tools to improve content production, campaign performance and customer engagement

Team Leadership & Organizational Development (20%)

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing marketing organization (currently 2 direct reports, 5 indirect reports)
  • Manage direct relationships with agency partners, freelancers, and strategic creator partners
  • Establish clear team goals, KPIs, and accountability frameworks; conduct regular performance reviews and development planning
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, data-driven decision making, continuous improvement, and customer focus

Brand, Content & Customer Experience (15%)

  • Oversee cohesive brand strategy and content roadmap that reinforces Undercover Tourist as the leader in theme park travel and exceptional customer value
  • Craft differentiated messaging and positioning; conduct competitive analysis to identify key differentiators and opportunities
  • Ensure brand consistency and customer experience excellence across all touchpoints (web, email, social, paid, events, partner channels)

Marketing Operations & Technology (5%)

  • Own marketing technology stack including UCT custom content admin, SMS platform, analytics (GA4, attribution tools), automation, and AI-powered tools
  • Evaluate and drive strategic adoption of martech solutions that improve team efficiency and campaign performance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, with demonstrated success owning marketing strategy, budget, and P&L in a direct-to-consumer and e-commerce environment.
  • Proven performance marketing expertise across paid social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), SEO, email, and SMS, with hands-on experience managing large-scale media budgets and optimizing for CPA and ROAS.
  • Deep experience building and managing creator and influencer programs, including partner identification, contract negotiation, campaign management, and ROI measurement.
  • Strong brand and content strategy instincts, with the ability to craft differentiated positioning and ensure brand consistency across all customer touchpoints in a highly competitive marketplace.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and inspire marketing teams, establishing clear accountability structures, coaching talent, and building a culture of data-driven experimentation.
  • Experience managing co-op marketing partnerships and negotiating joint promotional opportunities with major consumer brands or entertainment partners; familiarity with the theme park or travel industry is a strong plus.
  • Advanced analytical capability, comfortable with marketing attribution modeling, GA4, customer analytics, and performance reporting, with a track record of translating data into actionable strategy.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to think strategically and execute tactically; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment where autonomy and measurable impact go hand in hand.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience presenting marketing strategy and performance to senior leadership and external partners.

What Sets You Apart:

  • You have deep personal passion for travel and family experiences, and you understand intuitively why families trust a brand like Undercover Tourist with one of their most anticipated purchases of the year.
  • You enjoy theme parks and bring genuine enthusiasm and credibility to the category.
  • You have successfully managed co-op marketing relationships with large brands and know how to negotiate, collaborate, and maintain brand integrity on both sides of the table.
  • You’ve built something from a lean foundation. You’ve grown a brand or a team without unlimited resources, and you’re proud of what you built with what you had.
  • You know when to be the strategist in the room and when to roll up your sleeves, and your team respects you for both.
  • You are a natural storyteller who understands that the best marketing doesn’t feel like marketing, especially to a family planning a once-in-a-year vacation.
  • You thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture where ownership is real, speed matters, and your fingerprints are on everything.

Domain Consultants also help to create successful and happy customers by building relationships and technical trust with customers. Use your knowledge of various workforce operating systems and security concepts to understand and align with customer needs, matching their problems with Palo Alto Networks solutions.
