  • Earn customer trust by demonstrating expertise in the area of endpoint and user security.
  • Present and evangelize during tradeshows and customer events.

Qualifications

  • Advanced working knowledge (5+ years) of 2 of 3 primary workstation/server operating systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux).
  • Prior experience working primarily with endpoint/workstation products or solutions in a sales capacity.
  • Hands-on experience with endpoint and identity management technologies such as: Active Directory, Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf and endpoint troubleshooting.
  • Strong presentation skills and professional demeanor. Ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • An understanding of security concepts and the development of security roles within organizations that meet functional, technical and regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to anticipate risks and devise solutions in the moment; adaptable.
  • Proven ability to run technical discovery, design solutions, deliver demonstrations, answer RFPs and support complex sales opportunities.

Customer Success & Retention
  • Support a portfolio of customer accounts through onboarding, adoption, and renewal, building day-to-day working relationships with account contacts

  • Coordinate across Sales, Support, and Implementation to keep account information and next steps aligned
Required Qualifications & Education

  • 2–4 years in customer success, account management, customer support, or comparable roles supporting a SaaS product.

  • Experience in EdTech, higher education, or non-profit

Core Competencies
  • Customer focus
  • Customer Advocacy
  • Problem-solving
  • Communication and relationship-building
  • Collaboration
  • Organization and time management
  • Adaptability
  • Accountability
  • Strategic thinker
  • Continuous learning

The Essentials

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Amazon for the Australian market of a well-established clinical skincare brand with a global DTC and retail presence.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Amazon for the Australian market of a well-established clinical skincare brand with a global DTC and retail presence. You will replace an existing agency, take full ownership of paid channel performance, diagnose what is missing strategically, and drive D2C growth back into high gear working directly with the brand's digital and communications team.

This is not an execution-only role. You will own the strategy as well as the management, identifying gaps in funnel mix, retargeting, and upper and lower funnel balance, and directing what needs to change. Creative assets come from an in-house designer based on your briefs. If you have hands-on Meta ads experience, a data-driven growth mindset, and prefer the ownership and visibility of an in-house role over the siloed structure of an agency, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires meaningful overlap with Australian business hours
  • Own the full paid media function for the Australian market of a globally recognized skincare brand
  • High-ownership performance marketing role with direct impact on D2C revenue and brand growth

What You'll Work On

Paid Media Strategy and Platform Ownership

  • Own strategy and hands-on management across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, TikTok, and Amazon ads for the Australian market
  • Diagnose gaps in the current paid media strategy including retargeting coverage, funnel mix, and upper and lower funnel balance
  • Direct what needs to change and implement improvements with speed and clarity
  • Manage a significant annual paid media budget with full accountability for performance and spend efficiency

Creative Briefing and Asset Direction

  • Identify creative needs based on strategic priorities and brief the in-house designer accordingly
  • Ensure creative assets align with platform best practices and campaign objectives
  • Test creative hypotheses and iterate based on performance data

Performance Analysis and Reporting

  • Monitor campaign performance across all platforms and surface actionable insights regularly
  • Track key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, conversion rate, and revenue contribution by channel
  • Communicate performance clearly to the digital and communications team with recommended next steps
  • Stay current on platform updates, algorithm changes, and emerging AI ad tools that could improve performance

What You Bring

  • Proven hands-on Meta and Facebook ads experience; this is the primary hard requirement for this role
  • Experience managing paid media in-house at an e-commerce brand of similar scale and spend level; in-house brand experience is preferred over agency-only backgrounds given the tendency for agency roles to be siloed by platform
  • Comfortable owning paid media strategy end to end including diagnosing gaps, setting direction, and executing changes independently
  • Data-driven and growth-minded with the ability to pick up a new market and brand quickly
  • Experience managing significant ad budgets with clear accountability for performance outcomes
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills for briefing creative, reporting to stakeholders, and collaborating with a distributed team
  • Meaningful overlap with Australian business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience across Google, TikTok, and Amazon ads alongside Meta
  • Familiarity with emerging AI ad platforms and tools
  • Background in beauty, skincare, wellness, or consumer DTC brands
  • Experience transitioning a brand from agency-managed to in-house paid media management

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your paid media experience including platforms managed and budget scale, and explaining how you would approach diagnosing a brand's underperforming paid ads program in a new market

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short homework assignment, a mini audit of an existing paid ads account to assess strategic thinking and platform fluency.

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Data Science Engineer to provide applied data science expertise within our Success Engineering team, helping customers maximize the value of MindBridge’s control points and ensembles. You will configure and tune existing models, assess their application to customer data, investigate model behaviour and results, and translate complex findings into practical solutions. Working primarily post-launch, you will partner closely with Success Engineering, Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to solve complex customer needs within MindBridge’s existing capabilities.

What You Will Do

Applied model & ensemble expertise

Maintain deep working knowledge of MindBridge's core detection methodologies: scoring logic, risk indicators, and how ensembles combine individual control points into a single output. Serve as the go-to technical resource within Success Engineering for questions about how a model or ensemble actually works.

Engineering & AI/ML liaison

Maintain an active, ongoing working relationship with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to stay current on model changes, known limitations, and upcoming capability shifts. Use that relationship to bring well-informed, technically grounded context back to Product/Engineering when a configurability gap is identified, a clear technical brief on what was requested, why it isn't currently supported, and what the customer's underlying value requirement needs, not just an administrative escalation.

Configurability boundaries & value mapping

Develop and maintain authoritative understanding of how, why, and to what extent MindBridge's core models and ensembles can be configured, which parameters are flexible, which are structurally fixed, and the statistical or product reasoning behind each boundary. Map a customer's stated business value requirement onto the specific configuration options actually available, and explain in plain terms what is, and is not, achievable within the current product.

Post-launch feasibility & configuration advisory

Evaluate customer requests to add, modify, or reconfigure a control point or ensemble, and determine whether it is feasible with existing product capability and the customer's available data. Define the specific data requirements: fields, quality, volume, structure — needed to support a proposed configuration. Recommend the configuration approach that best fits the customer's control objective within supported product capability.

Explainability & customer communication

Translate model and ensemble behavior into language finance, audit, and compliance stakeholders can act on: what it measures, how it scores, and why a specific result occurred. Support customers who need to justify or defend MindBridge's outputs to their own internal or external stakeholders, a recurring requirement in audit-facing use cases.

Root-cause diagnostics

When a control point or ensemble underperforms post-launch, determine whether the cause is data quality, configuration, or a genuine product limitation, and recommend the correct fix.

Escalation & product boundary stewardship

Distinguish clearly between a configuration question and a request that requires new product capability, and route the latter through Product/Engineering governance. Do not build bespoke workarounds to cover product gaps; document and escalate them instead.

Enablement & knowledge capture

Convert recurring model and configuration questions into FAQs, decision guides, and training material for Success Engineers, Success Engineering Architects, and Delivery Services.

Bounded support to Delivery Services

Act as an internal subject-matter-expert resource for Solutions Architects and Data Engineers specifically when an implementation calls for a control point or ensemble configuration that has not been built or validated before; not for routine, previously-validated feasibility questions, which remain owned by Delivery Services. This is consultative, time-boxed input at the point a novel configuration is being designed, not ownership of the Technical Requirements Blueprint or any implementation deliverable, which remains with Delivery Services throughout the technical blueprint phase.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of applied experience in data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related technical discipline, ideally supporting enterprise software customers after implementation. Working knowledge of the statistical and machine learning techniques used in anomaly and risk detection — scoring models, ensemble/combination methods, outlier detection — sufficient to reason about why a model behaves as it does, not only what it outputs; building such models from scratch is not required. Strong SQL, Python and data literacy; able to independently investigate whether a data set can support a proposed control point or ensemble configuration. Demonstrated ability to translate technical model behavior into terms a non-technical, often finance, audit, or compliance stakeholder can act on. Direct experience working with enterprise customers on technical questions, in a support, technical account management, implementation, or applied customer-facing data science capacity. Credible enough with model internals and engineering constraints to partner directly with Engineering and AI/ML teams as a peer. This role sits between the customer-facing and product-technical sides, not solely on the customer-facing side. Comfortable operating inside a defined product boundary: recommending within existing capability and escalating clearly rather than building around gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in audit, internal controls, financial risk, or fraud analytics. Familiarity with explainability and interpretability expectations in regulated or audit-facing environments. Experience producing enablement content i.e. FAQs, playbooks, training materials, for internal technical teams. Prior experience in a dedicated post-implementation optimization function, as distinct from initial delivery. Background in ML engineering, applied statistics, or a related technical field with direct exposure to production model constraints; not solely academic or research modeling experience.

Requirements contingent on employment

Fulfill requirements necessary to obtain full background check.

Pay Range The expected base salary range for this position is to $130,000 to $155,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, experience and competencies, and unique qualifications.

Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning.
  • Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency.
  • Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities.
  • Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain.
  • Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact.
  • Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates.
  • Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels.
  • Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy.
  • Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance.
  • Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities.
  • SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences.
  • Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code.
  • Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time.
  • Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently.
  • Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce).
  • This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth.
  • Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation.
  • Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar).
  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations).
  • Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity.
  • Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design).
  • Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives.
  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise.
  • Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations.
  • Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus.

Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead

  • Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy).
  • Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page.
  • Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture.
  • Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression.

The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting.

Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at before taking any further action.

Job Title

Connected Buildings Technical Lead

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Protect What Matters Most—Through Smarter Buildings

In healthcare, buildings do more than provide space—they protect patients, safeguard pharmaceuticals, and support mission critical operations.

As a Connected Buildings Technical Lead, you’ll play a central role in protecting that mission by owning the systems, workflows, and technical decisions that keep our Connected Buildings platform stable, secure, and effective. You will help ensure that Niagara BMS and Skyspark Analytics environments remain reliable, that system changes support evolving operational needs, and that the team has the tools and automation needed to respond faster and work smarter.

This role is ideal for a technically strong operator who enjoys owning live building systems, building practical automation, collaborating across teams, and translating complex technical work into measurable operational impact for a critical healthcare client.

Your Impact

In this role, your work supports:

  • System reliability and secure access, by maintaining stable, well-managed Niagara BMS and Skyspark environments that support uninterrupted operations.
    • Mission-critical building performance, by adapting systems, alarms, graphics, and analytics configurations to meet changing business and operational needs.
    • Operational insight and smarter workflows, by building automation and quantitative tools that help the team measure impact, reduce manual effort, and improve decision-making.
    • Cross-functional alignment, by serving as a trusted liaison with the client’s technology department and helping ensure that technical priorities, dependencies, and risks are handled early.

    What You’ll Do

    Own Core Connected Buildings Platforms

    • Independently manage the day-to-day health, stability, and administration of Niagara BMS and Skyspark environments.
    • Maintain system uptime, secure access, and overall platform reliability in live production settings.

    Adapt Systems to Evolving Business Needs

    • Modify BMS stations, graphics, alarms, and Skyspark configurations to support changing operational requirements.
    • Make thoughtful technical changes that improve performance while preserving system stability and supportability.

    Build Automation That Improves Team Throughput

    • Build, use, and improve Copilot agents and related workflows to automate the exporting, organizing, and digesting of BMS and analytics data.
    • Reduce manual effort and improve the team’s ability to act quickly on technical and operational information.

    Measure and Demonstrate Impact

    • Build quantitative tools and reporting approaches that measure the impact of building performance improvements implemented by the team.
    • Translate system changes, analytics findings, and technical interventions into clear operational or business value.

    Serve as a Technical Bridge With the Client

    • Act as the team liaison with the client’s technology department, coordinating requirements, dependencies, access needs, and technical priorities.
    • Help ensure that system changes and platform decisions are aligned across internal teams and client stakeholders.

    Troubleshoot and Strengthen Operations

    • Troubleshoot issues across building systems and analytics workflows with a focus on restoring service quickly and preventing recurrence.
    • Document configurations, procedures, and changes so the environment remains secure, supportable, and resilient over time.

    Lead Continuous Improvement

    • Support continuous improvement of Connected Buildings workflows, automation, analytics practices, and platform governance.
    • Help move the program toward more scalable, proactive, and insight-driven operations.

    What Makes This Role Unique

    • You are not just maintaining systems—you are protecting mission-critical healthcare operations.
    • Your work helps ensure that building systems, analytics, and automation support safe, reliable, and secure environments.
    • You bridge the gap between hands-on technical ownership, measurable operational impact, and client-facing coordination.

    What You Bring

    • Hands-on experience with Niagara BMS, Skyspark Analytics, and live production building systems
    • Ability to maintain uptime, secure access, and operational reliability across critical technical environments
    • Experience modifying BMS stations, graphics, alarms, and analytics configurations to support changing business needs
    • Experience building automation workflows and using AI tools, including Copilot agents, to improve efficiency
    • Ability to build quantitative tools, reporting, and analytical methods that measure operational or building performance improvements including around energy savings
    • Experience working directly with client or enterprise technology stakeholders to coordinate requirements, dependencies, or access
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across building systems and analytics platforms
    • Highly self-directed ownership and comfort working in a mostly remote environment without continuous supervision - occasional travel may be required
    • Strong prioritization, judgment, and communication skills in settings with competing technical and operational demands
    • A mindset oriented toward reliability, accountability, continuous improvement, and mission impact
  • Experience with energy calculations strongly preferred

    Why Mission-Driven Candidates Thrive Here

    If you’re motivated by knowing that your technical work helps protect critical healthcare operations—and you want to apply your expertise where system reliability, measurable impact, and operational judgment truly matter—this role offers that opportunity every day.

jobs.description:
What’s the Opportunity

PropertyPal is Northern Ireland's favourite property portal, trusted by home movers across Northern Ireland and by the estate agents who power their business. We are a forward-thinking, innovative company built on strong values, a fantastic reputation, and a genuine passion for making moving home easier, smarter and more enjoyable for everyone.

Alongside PropertyPal.com we run PropertyNews, our iOS and Android apps, and around 270 websites for estate agents. PropertyPal is part of Distilled, the group behind Daft.ie, DoneDeal.ie and Adverts.ie.

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to work across our React web app and React Native mobile apps. You will be up to date with modern frontend technologies, enjoy building intuitive experiences for both web and mobile, and want to work in a high-performance, fast-paced and ambitious environment.

We're a small team, so everyone has a real say in what we build and how. That comes with trust and ownership: we expect high standards and good pace, without needing constant direction. If that sounds like where you do your best work, you'll fit right in.

You'll work closely with product, design, QA and backend engineers, and your ideas will help shape what we build.

This is a remote-first role, with the flexibility to work from home.

How You’ll Create with Impact

We build the PropertyPal web app with React, TypeScript and , and our iOS and Android apps with React Native.

As a Frontend Engineer at PropertyPal you will:

  • Build, maintain and own features across the PropertyPal web and mobile apps

  • Take responsibility for defining and delivering the solution for complex features, working closely with product and design

  • Help ship and maintain our iOS and Android apps, including app store and over-the-air releases

  • Build efficient, reusable frontend components and shared code that work across web and mobile

  • Use AI development tools such as Claude Code every day to deliver better products faster

  • Keep our codebase clean, scalable, secure and well tested

  • Look after the health of the systems you work on, in production as well as in development

  • Keep up with new technologies and techniques in frontend and mobile development

Requirements

What You’ll need to Play Your Part

  • 3-5 years demonstrated experience in a similar commercial role

  • Excellent JavaScript and TypeScript skills, with significant professional experience of React

  • Solid experience with HTML and CSS, and experience building fully responsive, mobile-first web interfaces

  • Experience working with RESTful APIs

  • Unit and integration testing experience, using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library or Cypress

  • A daily user of AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot

  • Strong communication skills, and the ability to work on your own initiative while being a strong teammate

Advantage if you have

  • Experience of mobile app releases: App Store Connect, Google Play Console, code signing and over-the-air updates

  • Experience building, shipping and maintaining a React Native app in production

  • Experience with native build tooling such as Xcode, Gradle and CocoaPods

  • Experience with Next.js

  • Experience with Redux Toolkit or styled-components

  • Experience with CI/CD, for example GitHub Actions

  • Web and mobile app performance experience

What's it like to work here

You will join a small, experienced engineering team building products used by a large share of people in Northern Ireland when they move home. You will have real ownership of what you work on and the chance to make a significant contribution to how our products and platform develop.

Why Join PropertyPal

  • Competitive salary

  • Hybrid working + flexible hours

  • Private health cover for you and your family

  • Pension contributions

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • 25 days annual leave + 11 bank holidays

  • Day off for birthday and moving house

  • Work with one of NI’s most recognised digital brands

  • Opportunity to own and grow a meaningful territory

  • Career growth in a scaling marketplace business

More about PropertyPal and Distilled

PropertyPal helps people in Northern Ireland find their next home and helps estate agents reach buyers and tenants.

jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans le cadre d’un programme de modernisation des capacités biométriques et de la gestion des données d’identification, vous pilotez les développements applicatifs liés à une plateforme nationale de gestion d’images et à des solutions d’expertise dactyloscopique et faciale. L’environnement comprend également des interfaces avec les systèmes existants ainsi que l’appui à la migration de données biométriques et photographiques.

La biométrie joue un rôle central dans les processus de recherche, d’identification et de vérification des identités. Le programme ABIS vise à remplacer le système actuel de gestion des empreintes digitales, à améliorer la qualité et la performance des traitements, et à renforcer les capacités de biométrie faciale au moyen d’une plateforme centralisée et évolutive.

En tant que chef de projet senior, vous coordonnez les développements internes et externes, supervisez les équipes impliquées et accompagnez le Program Manager dans le pilotage global du programme. Vous assurez aussi le suivi opérationnel des travaux et livrables réalisés par le fournisseur externe, en collaboration étroite avec les architectes techniques et dans le respect des principes d’architecture, des standards techniques et des orientations technologiques définis.

Fonction

Vous agissez comme coordinateur principal des développements applicatifs du programme. À ce titre, vous prenez en charge la planification, l’organisation, le suivi et la coordination des activités menées par les différentes équipes intervenant dans le développement, l’intégration et la mise en production des solutions.

  • Assurer le suivi des développements liés à la plateforme de gestion des clichés photo associés aux données biométriques.
  • Organiser et coordonner les activités des équipes de développement applicatif, et superviser les projets liés à la gestion et à l’exploitation de la plateforme.
  • Garantir l’interopérabilité entre les différentes solutions, notamment avec les systèmes de gestion d’enquêtes, de dossiers judiciaires et de signalements internationaux.
  • Veiller à une communication fluide entre les équipes techniques, les interlocuteurs de pilotage et les parties prenantes métier.
  • Servir d’interface opérationnelle avec les solutions d’expertise dactyloscopique et faciale fournies par un partenaire externe.
  • Coordonner les activités de développement et d’industrialisation.
  • Mettre en place un reporting périodique à destination des parties prenantes et du management.
  • Consolider, en concertation avec les intervenants concernés, les plannings des équipes internes et externes, suivre les jalons et échéances, identifier les impacts des retards ou dépendances, et produire les indicateurs de suivi.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les architectes techniques afin d’assurer le respect des standards d’architecture.
  • Veiller, avec le chef de projet fonctionnel, à la cohérence globale des solutions mises en œuvre.
  • Contribuer à la mise en place des processus qualité, de testing, de validation et de réception logicielle.
  • Apporter un soutien direct au Program Manager dans les activités de gouvernance, de coordination et de pilotage du programme.

Environnement technique

  • Architecture orientée services et Event Driven
  • Systèmes d’information, architecture applicative, applications métiers et intégration entre applications
  • Méthodologies de gestion de projet, Agile, Scrum et pratiques DevOps
  • GitLab
  • Jira, Open Project, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams
  • Cycle de vie d’une application
  • Gestion de programme multi-acteurs

Organisation du travail

Le télétravail est autorisé.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée comme IT Project Manager, idéalement dans un environnement complexe impliquant plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes.

  • Vous avez une bonne maîtrise de la gestion de projet et du pilotage de programmes multi-acteurs.
  • Vous comprenez les architectures orientées services et Event Driven, ainsi que les enjeux liés aux systèmes d’information, à l’architecture applicative et à l’intégration entre applications.
  • Vous maîtrisez les méthodologies Agile et Scrum, ainsi que des outils comme GitLab, Jira et Open Project.
  • Vous connaissez les processus de testing, de validation et de réception de logiciels.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec le cycle de vie d’une application et la coordination de développements jusqu’à la mise en production.
  • Vous faites preuve de leadership et savez fédérer des profils hétérogènes autour d’un objectif commun.
  • Vous adaptez votre style de management selon les interlocuteurs et savez répartir les tâches en fonction des compétences de chacun.
  • Vous gérez les priorités avec méthode afin d’atteindre les objectifs dans les délais, tout en réajustant si nécessaire en cas d’imprévus.
  • Vous communiquez de manière claire, y compris avec des interlocuteurs non techniques, et gardez une vision transverse des enjeux techniques, humains et organisationnels.
  • La connaissance de cet environnement de travail constitue un atout.

Vous maîtrisez l’anglais ainsi qu’une des deux langues nationales. La connaissance active d’une langue nationale et au minimum passive de l’autre constitue un réel atout.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

Job Description:


Recruiting Job Description

ICUC is the global leader in Social Media solutions for over 20 years. To date, the ICUC team consists of over 350 people, in over 35 countries, covering 50 languages around the clock. In an environment where the only constant is change, we create common ground between brands and audiences across communities and social media. Fueled by a unique culture built in and around meritocracy, we bring the passion, the know-how and the balance necessary to maintain the charted course we set for ourselves: to be the best, we employ the best. Are you ready to be part of the ICUC team?


The Role

ICUC is creating a new leadership role to own our automation and AI strategy across the business. This is a product and innovation mandate, not a workforce-efficiency one: the Director, Product Automation is responsible for how AI and automation get built into the actual work we do for clients — community management, strategy, insights, monitoring, and social listening, so our teams can work faster, with more precision, and with sharper focus on the client.


This is a founding, leadership-level position. You'll set the vision and build the function from the ground up, working closely across leadership to make sure ICUC's AI and automation strategy is as strong internally as it is in how we tell that story to the market.


What You'll Be Doing

Automation & AI Strategy

  • Own ICUC's automation and AI strategy as it applies to our products and service delivery
  • Evaluate, pilot, and select tools and technologies that make our core services - community management, strategy, insights, monitoring, and social listening - faster, more precise, and more scalable, without compromising the quality clients expect.
  • Define a standardized, scalable automation blueprint for ICUC's service offerings, rather than one-off, client-by-client fixes.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure needed to measure automation impact including efficiency gains, quality, and margin — across our platform ecosystem.
  • Bring a product mindset to this work: treat automation and AI capability as a product to be designed, tested, and iterated, not a back-office project.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Operations, Product Marketing and Growth to translate our internal automation and AI capability into external go-to-market positioning and messaging.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to align messaging with ICUC's broader brand and content strategy.
  • Work across delivery, operations, and client success teams to ensure new tools and workflows are adopted in practice, not just approved in theory.

Organizational Leadership

  • Represent automation and AI strategy at the leadership table, helping shape how ICUC positions itself against AI-native competitors and evolving client expectations.
  • Build and champion a clear, company-wide narrative for what "AI-enabled, human-powered" means at ICUC, internally and externally.
  • Mentor and influence teams across the business to build automation literacy and confidence, without a large direct team of your own at the outset.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Proven experience building or scaling a product, automation, or AI/technology strategy function, ideally within a services, agency, or martech environment.
  • A track record of taking automation or AI capability from concept to measurable operational impact.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable partnering with marketing, delivery, and executive stakeholders who may have different priorities.
  • Familiarity with social media, community management, or social listening platforms is a strong asset.
  • Experience navigating the reporting and data limitations of enterprise martech platforms and building workarounds or systems to close those gaps.
  • A genuine product-innovation mindset: curious about tools and technology but always tying it back to what makes the client experience better.
  • Comfortable operating as a founding leader in a new function - able to build structure and process without waiting for someone else to define it.

Position Title:

Assistant Teaching Professor - MSN Core

Regular

About the Role:

The Assistant Teaching Professor is responsible for coordinating, leading, and teaching courses in the MSN program.

The MSN Faculty upholds academic integrity, follows standards of practice, and collaborates with the all MSN and SON faculty to ensure curriculum alignment with CCNE Essentials and the national standards applicable to the assigned track.

The role supports graduate preparation for national certification eligibility in the APRN, NEL, or NED track, fosters program effectiveness, and promotes a student-centered, high-quality learning environment.

‌

Organizational Relationship:

  • Workload assigned by the Associate Director/MSN Program Director and SON Director

  • Evaluated annually by the Associate School Director and/or SON Director and with input from peer faculty

  • Maintain regular, proactive communication with MSN Faculty and Program Director regarding course operations, student concerns, and any emerging issues, ensuring alignment with program expectations and timely resolution.

Program Leadership:

  • Actively engage in SON, MSN program, course, and university meetings, as designated by the SON Director and Associate Director/MSN Program director to support shared governance and program effectiveness.

  • Collaborate regularly with other MSN Faculty to address MSN curriculum, course content, grading practices, student concerns, and faculty or university-related matters. Escalate unresolved issues to the MSN Program Director following appropriate communication pathways.

  • Contribute to program success through participation in activities related to student admission, progression, and orientation, as well as curriculum review and enhancement for students enrolled in or applying to the MSN program.

  • Ensure alignment with CCNE Standards, the national competencies applicable to the assigned track (NONPF for APRN; AONL and NLN for NEL and NED), and other professional standards as appropriate.

Faculty Leadership:

  • Maintain an active presence and engagement throughout the MSN program by monitoring responsiveness, grading practices, and interactions with students.

  • Collaboratively review and discuss student assignments receiving a grade of 80% or below to ensure timely academic support and consistency in evaluation.

  • Plan, teach, manage, and evaluate lectures and course activities while ensuring instructional excellence and innovation in content delivery.

  • Review course materials, including readings, textbooks, and learning resources, to ensure alignment with current evidence-based practice, CCNE Standards, the national competencies applicable to the assigned track (NONPF for APRN; AONL and NLN for NEL and NED), and other professional standards as appropriate and communicate any necessary updates to the applicable MSN Track Coordinator(s) to maintain curricular relevance and accuracy.

  • Collaborates closely with the MSN Program Director/Associate Director and MSN faculty to maintain the quality of courses and overall program effectiveness while fostering an enriching learning experience for students.

Other duties include:

  • Be accessible and available to students, supervisor, staff and colleagues during NKU operation hours (8:00 am – 4:30 pm EST).

  • Serve on SON and program committees as assigned and attend SON, program, and other meetings in person or virtually; be an active participate in SON, program, and university needs.

Education

Doctoral degree in Nursing or related field required. For APRN track positions, an Advanced Practice Certification in a nurse practitioner specialty (FNP, AGACNP, PMHNP). For NEL and NED track positions, MSN in nursing with graduate preparation in nursing leadership/administration or nursing education, respectively

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of two years of clinical nursing practice required.

  • Must possess an active and unencumbered registered nursing (RN) license in State of residence and, for APRN track positions, an advanced practice license

  • For APRN track positions, at least five years of full-time, past and current direct patient care as an APRN in the designated specialty area.

  • For NEL and NED track positions, comparable full-time professional experience in nursing leadership/administration or nursing education, as applicable

  • Previous graduate- level teaching required

  • Previous online teaching experience required

  • Experience or expertise with course content

  • Pass pre-employment criminal background check as mandated by state law

Professional Expectations:

  • Maintain active unencumbered RN licensure and, for APRN track positions, APRN certification/licensure; NEL and NED faculty maintain any certifications relevant to their track

  • Maintain current knowledge of professional discipline and educational methodologies through continuing professional development

  • For APRN track positions, maintain part-time clinical practice as needed to maintain APRN certification/licensure; ensure clinical practice (max release is one day weekly) does not interfere with faculty duties

  • Maintain current knowledge of program policies, procedures, and student progress

  • Adhere to faculty professional standards as delineated in the NKU Faculty Handbook

  • Utilize nku.edu email for ALL course communications – students are required to do the same

  • Teach and precept as needed to meet program needs

Required Training:

  • Completes required Faculty Development courses annually

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

This role is a 13 month secondment to cover caregiver leave within our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team in Customer Operations.

Our VAIB team⭐

Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

As our VAIB Strategy Lead, you’ll set direction within your area of expertise and turn VAIB priorities into sustainable, well-governed improvements across Monzo.You’ll bring together regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience to understand where change is needed and help the business deliver it effectively. You’ll work closely with Strategy Managers and Analysts, Operations leaders, Product, Risk, Compliance, Data, Engineering and teams across Monzo. You’ll make sure our strategic priorities are understood, appropriately governed and translated into measurable improvements for customers.

  • Leading the development, integration and embedment of VAIB strategies, standards and regulatory expectations across Monzo’s products, customer journeys and operational processes. Turning the strategy into clear roadmaps, outcomes and priorities, giving strategic direction to the teams responsible for delivering them.
  • Assessing our products, services and customer support against relevant legal, regulatory and industry standards, identifying gaps, risks and opportunities and driving improvements. As well as horizon scanning, regulatory analysis and gap assessments, turning emerging legal, regulatory and industry developments into practical recommendations for Monzo.
  • Acting as a senior subject matter expert on complex vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement issues, including situations where there isn’t an established answer, whilst building VAIB capability across Monzo by sharing your expertise, coaching colleagues and supporting the development of Strategy Managers and Analysts.
  • Working closely with first and second line Risk and Compliance teams to understand regulatory expectations, strengthen governance and controls, and make sure VAIB risks are identified and managed appropriately. Whilst taking ownership of significant VAIB risks, controls, formal actions or remediation programmes where needed, making sure activity is delivered to the right standard.
  • Setting clear expectations and measures for customer outcomes, using data and insight to understand whether our strategies and standards are working and where our approach needs to change.
  • Work closely with Operations and Senior Operations leaders to improve customer support pathways, service standards and outcomes, constructively challenging where performance or strategic alignment falls short.
  • Using complaints, customer insight, operational data and other relevant information to identify systemic barriers or poorer outcomes and turn those findings into strategic action.
  • Working with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other teams to make sure VAIB priorities are understood and embedded in the way we design, deliver and improve products and services.
  • Providing strategic direction on customer communications linked to VAIB, helping make sure information is clear, accessible, accurate and consistent with our approach.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have deep expertise in vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement, and understand how to identify and reduce barriers that can prevent people from accessing products and services.
  • You have strong knowledge of the legal, regulatory and industry standards relevant to VAIB, such as FG21, Consumer Duty, the Equality Act 2010, WCAG and the European Accessibility Act, and can turn regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience into clear strategic priorities and practical recommendations.
  • You have experience developing and embedding strategy at scale, including setting outcomes, roadmaps and measures of success.
  • You’re comfortable working with Risk and Compliance teams and have experience identifying and managing risks, controls, governance requirements or remediation activity.
  • You can provide credible challenge and influence senior stakeholders, including when an issue is complex, ambiguous or there isn’t an established solution.
  • You have experience using customer and operational insight to identify systemic issues and improve customer outcomes.
  • You can work effectively across different teams and disciplines, bringing people together around a clear strategic direction.
  • You enjoy sharing your expertise and helping others build their capability.
  • You’re excited about what we’re doing at Monzo and want to help us make money work for everyone.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)
  • Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)
  • Technical interview with a task (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

Job Description:

Merkle is seeking an experienced Data Architect to lead the design and delivery of product modernization initiatives for enterprise customers migrating legacy Adobe solutions to modern platforms across Analytics, Content, and Commerce domains. You will architect and operationalize the end-to-end data foundations that power our customers' digital marketing, content, and commerce ecosystems — spanning data strategy, modeling, integration, and governance across Adobe Experience Platform, content operations, crm systems, and commerce applications.


As an enterprise data architecture, you'll design the schemas, pipelines, and governance frameworks behind secure, scalable solutions that support unified profiles, segmentation, journey orchestration, and campaign activation for our customers.


What You'll Do

  • Provide deep experience to build data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy.
  • Engage closely with customers and Adobe team to facilitate data discovery by evaluating systems and business processes. Analyze customer sources, data movement, data granularity, relationships, data format, etc.
  • Unify disparate data (e.g., sales, CRM, analytics data, etc.) to meet customers’ digital marketing use cases. Lead and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for multi-solution delivery.
  • Showcase and follow frameworks for data quality, define standards, master data management, data services, data governance, data modeling, tools, data security, privacy, and compliance with industry regulations (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).
  • Engage with cross-disciplinary groups and Adobe professionals to identify customer demands. Provide data layout and strategic blueprints, advocating for scalable, secure resolutions. Assume the role of a liaison to promptly tackle technical obstacles.
  • Provide solutions for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations, while aligning to customers’ objectives.
  • Deliver Adobe platform data lake and real-time customer profile to get ready for data ingestion and activation. Employ REST APIs, Postman, and basic scripting to automate and streamline the implementation and setup.
  • Develop and construct data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing, online and offline data within AEP. Collaborate with data engineers to develop and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for data collection and extraction.
  • Improve data query performance across platforms by tuning models and adhering to guidelines and ensure product guardrails are followed and deployed in solutions
  • Drives end-to-end data migration initiatives, transforming and migrating large-scale datasets while maintaining data quality, integrity, and compliance.
  • Audit existing Adobe solutions to establish current state baseline and identify technical debt, governance gaps, and data quality issues.
  • Assess platform maturity: evaluate taxonomy consistency, content metadata tagging practices and standards compliance, and commerce product data enrichment levels; flag redesign opportunities prior to modernization.
  • Identify platform-specific reconciliation and integration points and document data consistency requirements.
  • Unify disparate data sources (CRM, call center, marketing, sales, content operations, commerce/order data) to meet customers' digital marketing, content, and commerce use cases within a single AEP foundation.
  • Map legacy platform infrastructure to AEP schemas and CJA data views; determine what migrates directly, what requires transformation, and what should be redesigned for improved governance and cross-domain insights.
  • Design AEP data models (conceptual, logical, physical) across Analytics, Content, and Commerce domains—including event schemas, entity relationships, attribute hierarchies, identity resolution, content asset structures, and product data models.
  • Develop relational and dimensional data models for analytics spanning multiple customer datasets (CRM, marketing, offline, point-of-sale, content, commerce) across RDBMS, columnar, data warehouse, and data lake environments.
  • Architect AEP data ingestion pipelines (streaming, batch, online, offline) across Analytics, Content, and Commerce data sources; collaborate with data engineers to build automated ETL/ELT workflows maintaining data freshness and quality.
  • Support end-to-end modernization migrations, preserving metric definitions, historical accuracy, content governance, and commerce data integrity through transition phases.
  • Develop validation and reconciliation documentation for legacy-vs-modern platform comparisons in pilot and production

Core Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on data architecture, data modeling, SQL development, and analytics platform experience working with enterprise customers.
  • Expert proficiency in crafting customer-centric database models, datasets (e.g., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.) with relational, hierarchical (e.g., RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer modeling, Data Lakes, OLTP & OLAP, etc.).
  • Demonstrated experience auditing, assessing, and documenting data components of implementations; ability to translate complex data configurations and data models into clear business requirements and technical documentation.
  • Advanced SQL skills including window functions, complex joins, aggregations, stored procedures, and query optimization for analytics workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including data ingestion, schema design, unified profiles, segmentation, real-time activation workflows, and native AI tools.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution, data privacy frameworks, and consent management in a multi-domain context.
  • Proficiency in API-first integration patterns (REST, webhooks, Postman) and basic scripting (Python or Bash) for data pipeline automation and validation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and strong organizational skills; proven ability to balance concurrent customer engagements and distill complex architectures and migration strategies for executive and technical audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Adobe Certified Expert (ACE) in CJA or AEP Data Architect.
  • Adobe Certified Associate (ACA) in Real-Time Customer Data Platform or Analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform for Content or Commerce (Content Hub, Commerce product data, personalization).
  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics API (Report API, Admin API) for automated assessment and documentation.
  • Experience with Analytics-to-CJA migration patterns, common reconciliation challenges, and metric mapping best practices.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for data solution deployment.
  • Track record of presenting modernization audits and migration strategies to C-suite and line-of-business stakeholders.

Preferred Background

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related technical field; equivalent work experience in a senior data architecture role considered.

The annual salary range for this position is $113,000-$160,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

jobs.excerpt: Company Description At PayNearMe, we’re on a mission to make paying and getting paid as simple as possible.
jobs.description:
Company Description

At PayNearMe, we’re on a mission to make paying and getting paid as simple as possible. We build innovative technology that transforms the way businesses and their customers experience payments. Our industry-leading platform, PayXM™, is the first of its kind—designed to manage the entire payment experience from start to finish. Every click, swipe or tap is seamless, fast and secure, helping non-commerce businesses boost customer satisfaction, accelerate payments, and reduce costs.

Our single platform handles it all: cards, ACH, digital wallets such as PayPal, Venmo, Cash App Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and even cash at more than 62,000 retail locations nationwide. Today, thousands of businesses across consumer lending, iGaming and online sports betting, property management, and tolling trust PayNearMe to deliver a payment experience that drives real results.

In September 2025, we raised a $50 million Series E funding round to accelerate our growth.

We’re a team of 300+ employees across 41 states, headquartered in Silicon Valley with satellite offices in Dallas, TX and Holmdel, NJ.

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of payments—one experience at a time.

About the Role

PayNearMe is looking for a Vice President of Product Management to lead our Payments & Money Movement portfolio.

This portfolio sits at the center of the PayNearMe platform, spanning payment acceptance and orchestration, risk and compliance, money movement and disbursements, settlement and reconciliation, and the APIs that expose these capabilities to clients and partners.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, this leader will oversee the product teams responsible for Payments & Trust, Money Movement and API capabilities.

The mandate is both operational and transformational. This leader will drive execution across the existing portfolio while helping evolve the underlying payments platform to support the next stage of PayNearMe's growth.

As we scale, these capabilities must become increasingly reusable, configurable and extensible across our existing verticals, new markets and future products without requiring one-off solutions.

The portfolio also powers critical internal operations across Finance, Accounting, Risk, Compliance and Operations, making strong cross-functional partnership essential as transaction volume and complexity grow.

Success requires deep payments experience, strong product leadership and demonstrated experience scaling or modernizing complex transaction platforms.

What You'll Lead

Payments & Orchestration

Capabilities that enable clients and consumers to securely accept and process payments across multiple payment methods, processors and rails, including:

  • Payment capture across card, ACH, digital wallets, cash and emerging rails
  • Smart Switch and payment routing/orchestration
  • Payment performance and optimization

Risk & Compliance

Products that help clients and PayNearMe safely manage payment risk and regulatory requirements, including:

  • Risk decisioning and controls
  • Compliance capabilities
  • Configurable operational and business rules

Money Movement & Disbursements

Capabilities responsible for moving, settling and accounting for funds across the platform, including:

  • Disbursements and funding
  • Clearing and settlement
  • Client and collector reconciliation
  • Billing and pricing capabilities

APIs & Access

APIs and related platform capabilities that allow clients, partners and PayNearMe products to securely integrate with and extend the payments platform.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and execution of the Payments & Money Movement portfolio.
  • Lead, coach and develop experienced product leaders and their teams.
  • Drive near-term execution while balancing investments in platform modernization and future growth.
  • Partner closely with Engineering leadership to scale and evolve PayNearMe's transactional platform.
  • Define the future of Smart Switch and payment orchestration across processors, rails and payment methods.
  • Generalize core platform capabilities so they can support existing and future verticals without requiring one-off solutions.
  • Partner deeply with Finance, Accounting, Operations, Risk and Compliance to ensure the platform supports the operational needs of the business as we scale.
  • Drive product decisions that improve reliability, payment performance, operational efficiency and economics.
  • Bring a commercial perspective to platform strategy, identifying opportunities to expand the value of PayNearMe's payments and money movement capabilities.
  • Partner across Product, Engineering and Revenue teams to translate platform investments into measurable client and business outcomes.
  • Serve as a key member of the Product Leadership Team and help shape PayNearMe's broader product strategy and operating model.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Improve execution and accountability across the Payments & Money Movement portfolio.
  • Build and develop a strong product leadership team capable of operating with increasing autonomy.
  • Establish and execute a clear roadmap for scaling and modernizing the transactional platform.
  • Advance Smart Switch as a strategic payment orchestration capability.
  • Improve platform reliability, scalability and operational efficiency.
  • Make core capabilities more reusable across products and verticals, reducing the need for bespoke development as PayNearMe grows.
  • Strengthen the products and systems Finance, Accounting and Operations rely on to manage money movement at scale.
  • Advance our Risk and Compliance products to support clients, protect the platform and enable growth.
  • Enable faster introduction of new payment methods, products, capabilities and verticals.
  • Identify and advance opportunities that improve the commercial value and economics of the payments platform.

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years of product management experience, including significant experience in payments, fintech or financial infrastructure.
  • 7+ years of progressive product leadership experience, including responsibility for multiple product teams and senior product leaders.
  • Deep payments experience with a strong understanding of payment processing and money movement across areas such as gateways, acquiring, routing, card and ACH processing, settlement, reconciliation or disbursements.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling, modernizing or transforming a complex, high-volume transaction platform.
  • Experience leading products and teams through significant growth, including increasing transaction volume, expanding platform capabilities, entering new markets or supporting new revenue streams.
  • Strong track record partnering with senior Engineering leaders on technically complex platform investments and transformation efforts.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance execution of a critical existing business with longer-term platform investment and modernization.
  • Strong commercial and business judgment, with experience connecting product strategy and investment decisions to revenue growth, economics and client value.
  • Experience developing strong product leaders and building teams that operate with increasing accountability and autonomy.
  • Strong executive communication and ability to operate effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Revenue leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-processor or multi-rail payment orchestration.
  • Experience with payment optimization, routing or gateway products.
  • Experience with both pay-in and pay-out / disbursement capabilities.
  • Experience with payment risk, compliance or financial controls.
  • Experience operating in regulated financial services environments.
  • Experience leading products through periods of significant scale or platform modernization.

Why Join PayNearMe

This is an opportunity to lead the product portfolio at the foundation of PayNearMe's business.

You will help shape how our payments platform scales, modernizes and expands while leading the teams responsible for the capabilities every PayNearMe client and product depends on.

The work will directly influence platform performance, client value, company growth and the next generation of PayNearMe's payments capabilities.

The annual base salary range for this role represents PayNearMe's good-faith estimate of the base salary it reasonably expects to offer for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and work location. PayNearMe may offer compensation outside of this range in certain circumstances. This position will remain posted until filled.
Annual Salary Range
$275,000—$325,000 USD

Why Join Us?:

  • Competitive salary and benefits with growth-company options grant
  • Fast- paced and professional work culture
  • Stock options with standard startup vesting - 1 year cliff; 4 years total
  • $50 monthly communication expense stipend to go towards your phone/internet bill

  • Volunteer Time Off

PayNearMe strives to create a workplace where all employees thrive. Our core values represent who we are today and we take pride in the way we work with each other as well as with our stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: About Dynamo AIDynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there.
jobs.description:
About Dynamo AI

Dynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there. Our products cover risk assessment, evaluation, runtime guardrails and observability for generative AI and agentic systems. We work with enterprises in regulated industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare and defense.

The Role

Enterprises want to deploy AI agents that read internal data, call tools and take actions. Their security teams often lack the means to approve these agents with confidence. AgentWarden secures agents across that lifecycle, from risk assessment before deployment through runtime monitoring and incident response. As its Product Manager, you will own the problem of getting agents approved and operating safely in production. You will work with our engineering and research teams and directly with customers' security, platform and AI teams.

In your first months you will focus on agent risk assessment. This includes identifying risky combinations of tools and permissions, such as agents that pair access to private data with exposure to untrusted content and the ability to communicate externally. It also includes analyzing the third-party tools agents connect to and how agents behave when they run. You will spend significant time with customers as well: narrowing down which agent risks block their deployments, identifying economic buyers, and turning pilots into scoped product requirements.

What You'll Work On

  • Pre-deployment risk assessment for agents: analysis of agent tools, permissions and runtime behavior, and the evidence security teams need to approve an agent.
  • Red teaming for agents, covering multi-step attacks, tool misuse and indirect prompt injection.
  • Runtime controls for agent actions and tool calls, kept current as new attack techniques are published.
  • Alerting and investigation for agent incidents, where a single session can span many steps and systems.

Responsibilities

  • Own the AgentWarden roadmap against a defined set of customer problems and success metrics.
  • Lead customer discovery and pilot engagements with enterprise security and AI platform teams, and present to senior security stakeholders.
  • For each deployment, identify the buyer, the approver and the operator, and shape pilots around what each of them needs in order to proceed.
  • Write requirements that engineering and research can build and evaluate against, including test sets and acceptance criteria.
  • Track agent frameworks, MCP, agent platforms and related threat research, and update the roadmap as they change.
  • Work with the DynamoGuard and DynamoEval PMs on shared policies, evaluations and alerting.

Requirements

  • 2 to 4 years of product management experience, preferably in security, developer tools, or AI/ML products sold to enterprises.
  • Hands-on familiarity with how agents are built, including tool calling, MCP, and at least one agent framework such as LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK or CrewAI. You should be able to build a simple agent yourself.
  • Working knowledge of LLM and agent threats, such as prompt injection, excessive agency and data exfiltration, and of references such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Ability to read Python or TypeScript well enough to review scanner findings and discuss detection approaches with engineers.
  • Experience running customer discovery with technical buyers and converting it into scoped requirements.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting to enterprise security leaders.
  • Willingness to spend 4 to 6 weeks per year at customer sites, and more during large contract engagements.

Nice to Have

  • Background in security engineering, application security, red teaming or detection engineering.
  • Experience with products that produce findings or alerts for SOC or AppSec teams.
  • Experience deploying into financial services or other regulated industries.

Why Join Us

  • Define how enterprises secure AI agents while the category is still forming.
  • Work directly with Fortune 500 security teams on production deployments.
  • Own a product line end to end at a founder-led startup.
  • Competitive compensation, equity and benefits.
