The Climate and Land Use Alliance (CLUA) is a collaborative of foundations seeking to amplify the power of people and the potential of forests for a just and climate resilient world. CLUA member foundations are the ClimateWorks Foundation, the David and Lucile Packard Foundation, the Ford Foundation, Good Energies Foundation, and Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. Margaret A. Cargill Philanthropies also awards grants in alignment with the CLUA strategy. By bringing together our resources and diverse expertise, CLUA supports policies, practices, and partnerships that halt and reverse forest loss, advance sustainable land use and development, and secure the rights and livelihoods of Indigenous and forest communities. For more, please visit climateandlandusealliance.org.

CLUA coordinates with other funders to accelerate progress toward shared goals of raising more support and moving more resources to organizations working to halt and reverse tropical deforestation by hosting Forests, People, Climate (FPC), a collaborative of philanthropic donors, civil society, and community-based organizations seeking to halt and reverse tropical deforestation while supporting just, sustainable development. Learn more at forestspeopleclimate.org.

Position Description

Reporting to the Director of Communications for CLUA & FPC, the Communications Manager, Funder Engagement is responsible for planning, managing, and implementing funder-specific communications. As FPC and CLUA deepen their focus on engaging foundations, new climate donors, and other potential funders, this role provides the dedicated donor communications capacity needed to support effective funder engagement. This role is a core part of the Communications Team, ensuring coherent and consistent communications about our collaborative across all audiences. Working in close coordination with the Development Team, who leads donor relationships and funder engagement strategy, this role translates strategy into effective funder-facing messaging and materials. It also works closely with the Monitoring & Learning Team (M&L), turning monitoring and learning into funder updates and stories of impact.

Location

The ideal candidate will be based in a timezone between UTC -8 (Pacific) and UTC -3 (Brazil/Buenos Aires), inclusive. The position will require working remotely with a flexible work schedule that may include early and late calls and activities to support colleagues in multiple time zones in the Americas, Europe, Indonesia, and Africa.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Director of Communications, the Communications Manager will be primarily responsible for the following:

Align Communications

  • As part of the Communications Team, develop and manage funder-facing communications that turn funder engagement strategies into effective fundraising narratives, messaging, and materials.
  • Ensure all funder-facing content is coherent, consistent, and aligned with the overall organizational communications strategy while being effectively tailored to specific audiences.

Support Development

  • In close coordination with the Development Team, plan, manage, and implement funder communications to support effective funder engagement.
  • Bring dedicated donor communications expertise to translate strategy into compelling materials that strengthen the organization's capacity to mobilize resources.

Ensure Collaboration

  • Collaborate across the Development, Program, M&L, and Communications Teams to support funder-facing outreach and convenings through effective messaging and high-quality materials, including talking points, donor briefs, presentations, annual reports, newsletters, and staff training and preparation.
  • Work closely with the M&L Team to turn monitoring and learning into funder updates and stories of impact.

Streamline Process

  • Support the Communications Team in facilitating effective communications processes, including review and approvals, to ensure our communications and identity, while targeted to appropriate audiences, remain consistent across the organization.

Preferred Experience & Competencies

Applicants will ideally have many of the following competencies and some of the following experience:

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in communications, with a meaningful focus on donor or funder-facing work.
  • Demonstrated experience developing fundraising narratives, donor reports, or impact communications in a nonprofit or philanthropic context.
  • Strong ability to translate complex strategy and technical content into clear, compelling messages for non-specialist audiences.
  • Experience working closely with development or fundraising teams, with understanding of funder engagement cycles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1 or C2 level required). Spanish, Portuguese, French, or Indonesian would be a bonus.
  • Experience working in or with organizations focused on climate, environment, land use, or natural resources is an advantage.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing needs, and work effectively in a remote and international environment.
  • A strong commitment to justice and equity work.

Compensation

jobs.title: Digital Asset Management (DAM) Solutions Architect - AI
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Digital Asset Management (DAM) Solutions Architect to lead the design, configuration, integration, and evolution of digital asset management capabilities supporting modern content operations and AI-enabled content workflows.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Digital Asset Management (DAM) Solutions Architect to lead the design, configuration, integration, and evolution of digital asset management capabilities supporting modern content operations and AI-enabled content workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of technology architecture, content operations, information architecture, and digital publishing. The ideal candidate combines hands-on knowledge of enterprise DAM platforms with a strong understanding of taxonomy, metadata, digital rights, content lifecycle management, publishing requirements, and integration with upstream and downstream enterprise systems.

The DAM Solutions Architect will help translate business and content requirements into scalable DAM solutions—including metadata models, taxonomy structures, asset organization, workflow, governance, publishing patterns, and system integrations.

This role will also help establish DAM and content-management standards that enable content to be discoverable, reusable, interoperable, governed, and consumable by both human users and AI-enabled platforms and workflows.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

DAM Architecture & Configuration

  • Design and configure enterprise DAM solutions aligned to business, content, publishing, and technology requirements.
  • Define asset structures, content models, folder and collection strategies, permissions, workflows, renditions, and lifecycle rules.
  • Assess existing DAM implementations and identify opportunities to improve scalability, usability, governance, and interoperability.
  • Translate business and content-management requirements into functional and technical DAM specifications.
  • Establish patterns supporting modular content, source assets, derivatives, channel-specific renditions, and packaged digital deliverables.
  • Support migration and onboarding of existing content and assets into DAM environments.

Taxonomy, Metadata & Information Architecture

  • Design and maintain scalable metadata schemas, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, and tagging strategies.
  • Establish standards for descriptive, structural, operational, technical, compliance, attribution, and rights-management metadata.
  • Define relationships between asset-level attributes, taxonomy values, keywords, tags, and other content classifications.
  • Develop metadata strategies that improve search, discovery, reuse, automation, and reporting.
  • Establish approaches for capturing AI-related content provenance and attribution, including generated or AI-modified content where applicable.
  • Ensure metadata and taxonomy models can evolve as new brands, markets, channels, content types, and use cases are introduced.

Content Lifecycle, Governance & Digital Rights

  • Define and document content and asset lifecycle processes from creation and approval through publication, reuse, expiration, archival, and retirement.
  • Establish governance standards for metadata quality, taxonomy management, asset stewardship, and content hygiene.
  • Design approaches for managing digital rights, including licensing, usage restrictions, geography, channel, talent, expiration, and other rights-related attributes.
  • Partner with content operations and business stakeholders to define roles and responsibilities for ongoing DAM governance and asset stewardship.
  • Help establish operating models for DAM administrators, content owners, librarians, and other asset-management roles.

Digital Publishing & Content Supply Chain

  • Understand digital publishing requirements across web, email, social, media, CRM, and other digital channels.
  • Define requirements for asset transformation, renditions, packaging, distribution, and downstream consumption.
  • Design DAM capabilities supporting modular and omnichannel content operations.
  • Ensure DAM architecture supports the movement of assets throughout the content supply chain—from creation and approval through publishing and activation.
  • Partner with creative, content, marketing operations, and technology teams to establish scalable publishing patterns.

Systems Integration

  • Design integration patterns between DAM platforms and upstream/downstream enterprise systems.
  • Define APIs, events, webhooks, metadata mappings, authentication requirements, asset-transfer patterns, and integration contracts.
  • Support integration with systems such as:
    • Content creation and design platforms
    • Content management systems (CMS)
    • Marketing workflow/project-management platforms
    • Medical/legal/regulatory review and approval platforms
    • Claims-management solutions
    • CRM and marketing automation platforms
    • Omnichannel orchestration and activation platforms
    • AI-enabled content-generation and content-management solutions
  • Define appropriate integration triggers, audit requirements, exception handling, retry processing, and operational monitoring.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to translate architectural designs into implementation-ready specifications.

AI-Enabled Content Operations

  • Help design DAM capabilities that support AI-enabled content generation, retrieval, reuse, and automation.
  • Establish metadata and content structures that enable assets to provide reliable context to AI applications and agents.
  • Define approaches for distinguishing and governing human-created, AI-generated, and AI-modified content.
  • Partner with AI/product teams to establish integration patterns between DAM platforms and AI-enabled content platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI to improve tagging, classification, metadata enrichment, asset discovery, and content operations while maintaining appropriate governance and human oversight.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Significant experience designing, implementing, configuring, or architecting enterprise Digital Asset Management solutions.
  • Strong understanding of DAM taxonomy, metadata architecture, controlled vocabularies, tagging, and information architecture.
  • Experience with enterprise DAM platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager Assets / Adobe Assets, Aprimo, Bynder, Acquia DAM, Sitecore Content Hub, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong understanding of digital content lifecycle management and content supply-chain processes.
  • Experience designing integrations using REST APIs, events, webhooks, middleware, and related enterprise integration patterns.
  • Understanding of digital publishing requirements across multiple channels and content formats.
  • Experience with asset renditions, transformations, derivatives, packaging, and distribution.
  • Working knowledge of digital rights management and content governance.
  • Ability to translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical and information-architecture solutions.
  • Experience collaborating across business, creative, content operations, product, engineering, and technology teams.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to develop architecture diagrams, metadata models, integration specifications, and governance standards.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Manager Assets / Adobe Assets and the broader Adobe ecosystem.
  • Experience integrating DAM with workflow, regulatory review, CRM, CMS, marketing automation, or omnichannel platforms.
  • Experience with Veeva PromoMats, Veeva Vault, Adobe Workfront, Figma, Adobe Journey Optimizer, or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Experience within life sciences, pharmaceutical, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) content-review processes.
  • Experience supporting modular content and omnichannel content strategies.

  • Ensure compliance with accreditation standards, pharmacy policies and procedures, HIPAA requirements, and applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) required. Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred.

About Omnidian

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. We are a certified B Corp, headquartered in Seattle, WA

The Job

Reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer and sitting on the Strategy team, the Director of Business Process Excellence sets and leads Omnidian's enterprise process improvement agenda. This role looks across the whole business, from Go-To-Market through Operations and Field Services, to decide where process change will have the biggest impact on cost, risk, and service quality, then drives that change in partnership with functional leaders. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope: you'll own enterprise process standards, partner directly with C-suite leaders, and be accountable for measurable improvements in how work moves across the company.

What You'll Do

    At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you’ll be doing:

    Enterprise Process Architecture & Optimization (25%)

  • Enterprise Process Architecture: Own enterprise process architecture and standards, and lead the redesign of priority end-to-end workflows across business functions and core systems, partnering with functional owners across US and Australian operations.
  • Current-State Assessment: Lead current-state baselining to identify handoff friction, cycle-time lag, rework drivers, and capacity constraints, staying close enough to the details to challenge assumptions with data.
  • Target Future-State Design: Define target operating models and future-state workflows, and drive their adoption with functional and executive leaders.
  • Commercial Alignment: Partner continuously with Product Leadership to ensure operational process designs support commercialized product profitability and client service commitments.
    • Core Operations Re-Architecture & Upstream Integration (25%)
  • Core Operations Re-Architecture: Partner directly with Operations and Field Service leadership to re-architect high-friction value streams—including diagnostic triage, technician dispatch protocols, schedule density, and back-office handoffs to drive operational cost efficiencies.
  • Upstream Process Integration: Trace operational workflows upstream into Go-To-Market, Lead-to-Quote, contracting structures, pricing rules, and sales-to-onboarding handoffs to isolate and resolve root-cause friction at inception.
  • Platform Migrations & Expansion: Lead process baselining and workflow integration for global platform migrations, system integrations, and regional expansions.

    • Collaborative Capability Model & Functional SME Partnership (15%)

  • Direct Enterprise Process Work: Set direction for process leads embedded in functional departments on enterprise-level work, while they continue to report to their functional managers.
  • Co-Design with Functional Owners: Set enterprise process mapping standards, workflow notation, and documentation templates, and work alongside functional SMEs and team leads who build detailed operating procedures.
  • Capability Development: Coach and embed structured process engineering and continuous improvement methodologies across cross-functional teams to elevate overall organizational capability.

    • Governance, Enterprise Guardrails & Systems Alignment (15%)

  • Enterprise Standards Authority: Set enterprise process standards and cross-functional handoff requirements that functional SOPs must meet. Functional leaders own the day-to-day procedures within their teams.
  • Independent Enterprise Guardrail: Evaluate cross-functional handoffs, challenge localized sub-optimization, and ensure local functional designs serve the broader enterprise value stream.
  • Executive Alignment & Decision Driving: Bring cross-functional conflicts to executive leadership with a clear recommendation, backed by value-stream data and trade-off analysis, and drive the decision to closure.
  • Business Architecture Requirements: Define business architecture and technical system requirements for enterprise software, ensuring technology automates optimized workflows rather than digitizing operational complexity.
  • Technology & IT Translation: Partner closely with Technology and IT leadership to translate recommended target-state process designs into clear platform configuration specifications.

Who You Are

  • Business strategist first: you think about how process design helps Omnidian win, not just how to make it more efficient. You're comfortable challenging C-suite leaders and still willing to get into the details.
  • Self-directed: you can take a broad mandate, figure out where the biggest problems are, and build the plan without someone handing you a list.
  • Systems thinker who views end-to-end workflows holistically to eliminate root-cause friction at inception.
  • Collaborative facilitator adept at aligning matrixed teams and driving co-design models without direct line authority.
  • Data-driven decision maker who surfaces bottleneck metrics and trade-off recommendations to guide executive alignment.

Experience You’ll Need

  • 8–10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise process engineering, value stream mapping, or operational excellence, including leading at least one enterprise-wide or multi-function improvement program.
  • Track record partnering with and influencing C-suite leaders without direct authority.
  • Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (or Master Black Belt / equivalent formal continuous improvement pedigree).
  • Deep technical experience integrating operational workflows into major enterprise CRM and Field Service Management platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Systems Engineering, or a technical/quantitative field.

Experience That’s a Plus

  • Experience in clean energy, renewable technology, technical field service, logistics, or complex operational environments.
  • Advanced degree or MBA.
  • Proven track record supporting global operations, regional expansions, or platform migrations.

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Learning Experience Designer.

About the job

This position is needed within our Learning Experience Design team which is the engine that helps our GTM organization achieve their revenue goals. We are seeking an innovative Senior Learning Experience Designer to revolutionize how our global sales team learns, adapts, and executes. In this role, you will bridge instructional design, sales effectiveness, strategic priorities, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence. You won't just create training modules—you will design high-impact, AI-enhanced learning journeys, a range of modalities to match the sellers’ needs, interactive simulations, and performance support tools that shorten ramp times and drive revenue.
The ideal candidate is an agile instructional designer who actively tests, adopts, and masters modern AI design tools (generative text, AI video, code blocks, voice synthesis, automated assessments, and interactive simulation builders) to multiply design output quality and speed.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Leverage AI authoring tools, large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering to rapidly draft, iterate, and refine learning materials, roleplay scenarios, pitch guides, and sessions.
  • Build AI-driven roleplay simulations (e.g. objection-handling exercises, discovery calls, uncovering use case exercise, etc.) where sales reps can practice realistic customer conversations with generative AI personas.
  • Develop content into enablement that is driven by adult learning theory; enablement modalities are selected based on what best supports the seller.
  • Collaborate with Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, and Revenue Operations to map learning pathways directly to seller competencies, product launches, and strategic sales methodologies
  • Design just-in-time performance support assets (FAQs, Playbooks) integrated directly into seller workflows (CRM, Slack/Teams, Sales Engagement platforms).
  • Transform complex product specifications and market insights/positioning frameworks into easily digestible, highly actionable learning experiences.

  • Implement AI-based automated feedback loops that evaluate sales reps' video pitches, call recordings, and written communications.
  • Continually research, test, and integrate emerging AI tools and software into the enablement tech stack to accelerate enablement development cycles, increase outcome quality, and increase enablement impact.
  • Establish guidelines, prompt libraries, and best practices for the team's ethical and effective use of AI design tools.
  • Monitor learning metrics, tool adoption, sales ramp time, and quota attainment to continually optimize enablement programs.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in instructional design, learning experience design (LXD), or sales enablement—preferably within a fast-paced B2B SaaS or technology environment.

At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.


ROLE OVERVIEW


The Director, Brand Strategy & Partnerships leads the development, governance, and activation of the LifeStance Health brand across enterprise audiences, markets, partnerships, and growth priorities. This role is responsible for strengthening how LifeStance shows up with patients, clinicians, teammates, referral partners, recruits, business partners, and external stakeholders by building a clear, differentiated, and scalable brand platform.


This leader will serve as a senior strategic partner across the organization, translating enterprise priorities into brand strategies, creative systems, partnership opportunities, and activation plans that build awareness, trust, preference, and long-term affinity. The role oversees brand governance, creative services, branded partnerships, sponsorship strategy, and cross-functional brand activation, ensuring LifeStance presents a consistent, credible, and compelling brand experience across every touchpoint.

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES

Enterprise Brand Strategy

  • Lead the development and evolution of LifeStance’s enterprise brand strategy, positioning, narrative, and messaging architecture.
  • Translate business priorities into brand strategies that support consumer growth, clinician relevance, referral confidence, recruiting, business development, reputation, and stakeholder trust.
  • Ensure the LifeStance brand reflects the company’s long-term vision, growth strategy, care model, and role in the outpatient mental health category.
  • Partner with marketing, clinical, operations, people, business development, M&A, and executive stakeholders to ensure brand strategy is embedded across enterprise initiatives.
  • Develop audience-specific brand strategies for patients, clinicians, teammates, referral partners, recruits, payors, community partners, and external stakeholders.

Brand Governance and Architecture

  • Own enterprise brand governance, standards, and usage across internal and external channels.
  • Develop and maintain brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, visual and verbal identity standards, and brand decision-making processes.
  • Lead brand architecture strategy for specialty services, partnerships, de novos, M&A activity, service-line expansion, and future growth initiatives.
  • Ensure consistency across digital, physical, internal, patient-facing, clinician-facing, and partner-facing touchpoints.
  • Establish processes and tools to help teams activate the brand consistently and efficiently at scale.

Creative Services Leadership

  • Oversee creative services strategy, prioritization, and execution across enterprise marketing needs.
  • Lead the development of scalable creative systems, campaign assets, templates, toolkits, and branded materials.
  • Partner with internal teams and external agencies to ensure creative work is strategically grounded, brand-aligned, and built for reuse across audiences and markets.
  • Manage creative workflows, intake, prioritization, and quality standards to improve efficiency and brand consistency.
  • Help evolve the creative services model, including the right mix of internal resources, agencies, contractors, and production partners.

Brand Partnerships and Sponsorships

  • Develop and lead branded partnership strategy across healthcare, mental health, employer, community, consumer, and out-of-category opportunities.
  • Identify and cultivate partnerships that increase brand awareness, credibility, trust, and cultural relevance.
  • Evaluate sponsorships, collaborations, thought leadership opportunities, and strategic relationships through the lens of brand fit, audience reach, reputation impact, and business value.
  • Partner with business development, clinical, people, PR, and market leaders to activate partnerships that support enterprise goals.
  • Build frameworks to assess partnership ROI, brand lift, stakeholder engagement, and long-term strategic value.

Campaign and Activation Strategy

  • Partner with marketing leadership to translate brand strategy into campaign platforms, activation plans, and market-level storytelling.
  • Support development of top-of-funnel campaign strategy, creative briefs, audience segmentation, and activation plans.
  • Ensure campaigns are grounded in consumer insight and flexible enough to support multiple audiences, service lines, geographies, and business priorities.
  • Partner with performance marketing, content, PR, social, reputation, and field teams to connect brand-building efforts with demand generation and stakeholder engagement.
  • Define how brand activation supports awareness, trust, preference, discoverability, referral confidence, clinician pride, and long-term loyalty.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic brand advisor to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Support enterprise initiatives requiring brand strategy, storytelling, positioning, or change management.
  • Partner with M&A and de novo teams to ensure new practices and markets are integrated into the LifeStance brand in a consistent and thoughtful way.
  • Collaborate with People / Talent teams on employer brand, EVP activation, recruiting materials, and clinician engagement.
  • Collaborate with PR, communications, and clinical leadership to strengthen thought leadership, reputation, and external storytelling.

Measurement and Optimization

  • Establish brand health measurement frameworks, including awareness, familiarity, trust, preference, reputation, share of search, stakeholder engagement, and campaign contribution.
  • Partner with analytics and performance teams to connect brand-building activity to business outcomes over time.
  • Develop executive-facing reporting that communicates brand progress, opportunities, and impact.
  • Use insights, research, and performance data to continuously improve brand strategy, creative execution, and partnership activation.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Healthcare, behavioral health, consumer health, retail health, or similarly regulated category experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and govern brand systems across multiple audiences, channels, markets, and stakeholders.
  • Experience managing creative teams, agencies, production partners, or cross-functional creative workflows.
  • Experience developing or activating strategic partnerships, sponsorships, or branded collaborations.
  • Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate strategy into clear recommendations.
  • Proven ability to balance strategic vision with operational execution.
  • Strong understanding of consumer behavior, brand health, reputation, content strategy, digital experience, and integrated campaign development.

Leadership Attributes

  • Deeply collaborative, with the ability to influence across functions without direct authority.
  • Strong storyteller who can simplify complex ideas and create alignment.
  • High judgment and strong brand instincts.
  • Comfortable building new capabilities, processes, and systems.
  • Able to balance creativity, consistency, governance, and speed.

As a Security Analyst I, you'll be our first line of defense against cyber threats. By managing routine security tool adjustments and escalating complex issues, you'll ensure our defenses remain effective and responsive, safeguarding our client's assets and data.

  • Synthétiser les données de recherche sous forme de personas, de cartes de parcours utilisateur (journey maps) et d’informations exploitables, puis transformer les résultats en recommandations de conception et de produit influençant les décisions de feuille de route.
  • Assurer la gestion et l’évolution du dépôt de recherche afin que les résultats demeurent accessibles et continuent d’alimenter les travaux actuels et futurs.

Conception

  • Diriger la conception d’interfaces intuitives de l’idéation jusqu’au lancement, en s’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des objectifs utilisateurs, des flux de travail cliniques et des exigences produit. Créer des maquettes d’écran, des modèles d’interaction et des éléments d’interface répondant aux normes d’utilisabilité et aux objectifs d’affaires.
  • Prendre en charge l’ensemble du processus de conception : produire des esquisses fonctionnelles (wireframes), des scénarimages (storyboards), des prototypes interactifs et des spécifications détaillées permettant aux développeurs, analystes en assurance qualité et rédacteurs techniques de comprendre clairement les intentions de conception.
  • Favoriser la création et l’adoption de normes de conception afin d’assurer la cohérence à travers l’ensemble de la suite de produits et accompagner les développeurs dans les décisions et compromis liés au design de l’interface utilisateur.

Communication et collaboration

  • Établir une relation de confiance avec les utilisateurs grâce à l’empathie, à l’écoute active et à de solides compétences d’animation, afin de bien comprendre leurs objectifs, leurs flux de travail et leurs défis.
  • Présenter clairement les résultats de recherche et les concepts de design à différents publics, allant des équipes d’ingénierie jusqu’aux dirigeants produit, et animer des séances de révision critique afin d’assurer l’alignement et la qualité des livrables.
  • Encadrer et conseiller les designers et chercheurs UX moins expérimentés en partageant méthodes, outils et meilleures pratiques.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en interaction humain-ordinateur (IHO/HCI), en expérience utilisateur (UX), en design d’interaction, en facteurs humains/ergonomie, en psychologie, en design graphique ou expérience équivalente.
  • Minimum de 4 ans d’expérience en design UX/UI et en recherche UX, avec un portfolio démontrant à la fois de solides compétences de conception Web et mobile ainsi qu’une expérience complète en recherche utilisateur.
  • Maîtrise des outils de conception standards de l’industrie, notamment Figma et/ou la suite Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD ou équivalent).
  • Expertise démontrée en création de wireframes, de prototypes et de spécifications de conception détaillées.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la planification et la réalisation autonome d’activités de recherche utilisateur utilisant des méthodes qualitatives et quantitatives, ainsi que dans la synthèse des résultats sous forme de personas, de parcours utilisateurs et d’insights exploitables.
  • Familiarité avec des outils et référentiels de recherche UX tels que Dovetail, UserZoom, Optimal Workshop ou des solutions similaires.
  • Excellente connaissance des principes de l’interaction humain-ordinateur (HCI) et des meilleures pratiques en conception centrée sur l’utilisateur.
  • Capacité démontrée à communiquer efficacement les décisions de conception et les conclusions de recherche à des publics techniques et non techniques, y compris à des intervenants de niveau exécutif.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais ou équivalent.

Qualifications privilégiées et exigences particulières

  • Expérience en prototypage avec HTML, CSS ou des outils front-end similaires.
  • Expérience dans le domaine des technologies de l’information en santé ou des logiciels d’entreprise complexes; expérience de recherche auprès de cliniciens ou d’utilisateurs du secteur de la santé.
  • Familiarité avec les normes d’accessibilité (WCAG) et les principes de conception inclusive.
  • Connaissance de la conception de sondages et des notions de base en analyse statistique.
  • Expérience dans des environnements de développement Agile.
  • Expérience en mentorat ou en accompagnement informel de designers ou chercheurs UX.
  • Aucune responsabilité de supervision directe.

Exigences relatives aux déplacements

  • Aucun déplacement requis.

Experience with MacPractice, Weave, Solutionreach, Podium, or similar healthcare communication platforms.

Familiarity with chiropractic terminology, treatment plans, and recurring visit schedules.

Experience with patient reactivation, new patient conversion, and provider schedule optimization.

Prior experience supporting U.S. healthcare clinics.

jobs.excerpt: About Cardiac Care Alliance (CCA)Cardiac Care Alliance is a Management Services Organization (MSO) committed to building a high-performance cardiovascular network.
jobs.description:
About Cardiac Care Alliance (CCA)

Cardiac Care Alliance is a Management Services Organization (MSO) committed to building a high-performance cardiovascular network. We partner with independent cardiologists to deliver value-based care (VBC) models that complement traditional fee-for-service delivery. Our mission is to improve patient access, clinical outcomes, and overall experience through proactive care coordination and evidence-based interventions.

Position Summary

CCA is hiring full-time virtual Care Coordinators to support a growing population of medically complex patients with cardiac conditions, primarily congestive heart failure (CHF). This role is integral to our population health initiatives — proactively supporting at-risk patients with data-informed outreach, continuity of care, and patient-centered engagement.

This role will focus on supporting Principal Care Management (PCM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), and Transitional Care Management (TCM) services via telephonic outreach and technology-enabled documentation platforms. Care Coordinators work collaboratively with a team of Registered Nurses and Cardiologists, escalating clinical concerns and complex care needs as appropriate.

This position does not require RN licensure, but candidates must have strong clinical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate complex care environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct structured telephonic outreach to CHF patients and other complex cardiac patients
  • Maintain a caseload of assigned patients, using risk stratification to prioritize care
  • Complete initial assessments and timely follow-ups addressing current symptoms, medication regimen and adherence, functional and psychosocial status
  • Assess home safety and social determinants of health (SDOH) barriers, including transportation, food insecurity, housing instability, and caregiver support; escalate resource needs where appropriate
  • Advance care planning needs and specialty care follow-up
  • Review and act on population health dashboards to address care gaps (annual wellness visits, missing labs, lack of symptom monitoring, etc.)
  • Provide ongoing patient education and promote evidence-based self-management strategies for CHF
  • Monitor for signs of worsening conditions or gaps in care, and escalate as needed
  • Support transitional care follow-up within 48 hours post-discharge, focusing on medication reconciliation, red-flag symptom screening, and appointment scheduling
  • Document time, interventions, care plans, and patient goals in the care management platform in alignment with CMS billing standards
  • Maintain proactive communication with RNs, Cardiologists, PCP offices, and other clinical partners

Scope of Work – Limitations

This role is non-clinical in license and does not include:

  • Clinical assessment or medical diagnosis
  • Medication prescribing or adjustments
  • Interpretation of diagnostic results (labs, imaging, EKGs, etc.)
  • Clinical triage or emergency response
  • Home visits or in-person patient contact
  • Billing or coding responsibilities beyond required documentation

All clinical decision-making, care plan authorization, and treatment recommendations are made by licensed providers and/or supervising RNs.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active Medical Assistant (MA) certification or equivalent clinical credential (e.g., CNA, EMT, CHW with experience)
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in care coordination, case management, or ambulatory care
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and ability to build rapport by phone
  • Familiarity with CMS PCM, CCM, and/or TCM program requirements

jobs.excerpt: Application Deadline : 16 October 2026 - 17:00 CET Start Date : November 2026Contract Duration : One-year fixed term (full-time) Location : Remote, preferably based in the CET time zone (+/- 2 or 3 hours) BackgroundThe Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) is an independent civil society organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a globally dispersed Secretariat working across 43 countries.
jobs.companyName: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime
jobs.description:
Application Deadline : 16 October 2026 - 17:00 CET

Start Date : November 2026

Contract Duration : One-year fixed term (full-time)

Location : Remote, preferably based in the CET time zone (+/- 2 or 3 hours)

Background

The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) is an independent civil society organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a globally dispersed Secretariat working across 43 countries. Founded in 2013, GI-TOC brings together a global network of more than 810 independent experts and a team of over 150 staff dedicated to understanding and responding to organized crime. Through research, analysis, policy engagement and support to civil society actors, GI-TOC works to deepen understanding of organized crime and strengthen effective, rights-based responses.

The GI-TOC works to:

  • Identify, analyse and map criminal trends and patterns of regional instability, and their impact on illicit flows, governance, development, security, conflict and the rule of law.
  • Connect and support civil society actors working on organized crime and corruption, and on their links to instability and conflict.
  • Strengthen local monitoring and analysis of national, regional and international organized crime and insecurity trends.

Job Summary

The GI-TOC is seeking an Analyst to conduct research and analysis on illicit economies as part of the Global Organized Crime Index project.

The Analyst will engage closely with the core Index and Extra teams and the broader analytic team within the GI-TOC. This role demands strong analytic and interpersonal skills, and time-management skills to deliver high-quality products on tight timelines.

Main Responsibilities and Specific Tasks

Main responsibilities and specific tasks related to the Global Organized Crime Index include:

Assist in the organization, running and follow-up of a series of dissemination activities. These include but are not limited to analytical pieces, podcast series, media engagements and CSO/expert meetings

    1. In performing these duties, the Analyst may have to coordinate between the core Index team and GI-TOC staff, GIN members as well as external experts.
    2. Carry out research, participate in events and represent the Index team
    3. The Analyst will also be responsible for keeping track of progress on different tasks as well as on communication with experts, using appropriate templates as advised by supervisors

Be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day research and subsequent consolidation of country profiles/summaries of countries carried out by a team of assigned Research Assistants (RAs). This includes

    1. Introducing newly recruited RAs to the Index structure, methodology, research process and their roles
    2. Assigning RAs to research and develop country profiles independently and in parallel through desk research (on a rolling basis, upon completion of a country)
    3. Draw on their own knowledge, background and expertise to guide RAs in their research (e.g., sources to search, etc.)
    4. Periodically (daily/weekly), check the work of the RAs to ensure quality, accuracy and alignment with country profile guidelines and answer any questions they may have
    5. If possible, identify RAs with adequate background, language and research skills to join the research team, upon approval by GI-TOC
    6. Periodically (weekly) report back and provide updates to the rest of the core GI-TOC implementation team on the status of country profiles, any challenges faced, issues related to RAs, deadlines, and other related deadlines

In conjunction with managing RA teams, the Analyst will provide support in the scoring and verification phases of the Index by

    1. Identifying and reaching out to key organized crime experts whose knowledge and experience may be drawn upon for scoring/verification of scores for any country(ies) and/ or verification of country rankings for a particular criminal market
    2. Overseeing the day-to-day verification of country profiles and/or thematic areas carried out by organized crime /county experts. This includes:
      • Introducing experts to the Index structure, methodology, research process and their roles
      • Monitoring the verification process to ensure alignment with Index guidelines and requirements and to answer questions experts may have
      • Ensure expert submissions meet set deadlines and periodically follow up with experts to ensure timely submissions
      • Check the quality and accuracy of the verified country profile/thematic area before submitting it to supervisors
      • Send and submit completed expert invoices to the supervisors
      • Maintain index progress monitoring and update records in a timely fashion

Consolidate all expert input and comments into a final internal country profile for all countries assigned to them by the supervisors

    1. Edit for accuracy, repetition, grammar and comprehensiveness
    2. Input major developments for countries if and when they occur
    3. Include/exclude information based on Index guidelines and requirements
    4. Re-write and re-arrange text as needed to ensure text reads well

Other related tasks should they arise as requested by supervisors.

The Analyst will also support the development, research and dissemination of the “SCAR” framework, developed as part of the Global Organized Crime Index award. Key responsibilities will include

  1. Developing, validating and refining the methodology of the “SCAR” framework;
  2. Conducting literature reviews and developing questionnaires to measure the harm and capabilities of organized crime groups featured in the “SCAR” framework;
  3. Conducting research, creating and finalizing lists of actors as well as actor profiles based on the finalized methodology;
  4. Liaising between the core team and relevant Observatories to coordinate the collection of underlying data and the scoring of criminal groups identified under the “SCAR” framework;
  5. Identifying and engaging key experts on organized crime groups, as well as coordinating and overseeing their contributions to the project; and
  6. Undertaking any additional tasks arising during the development, research and dissemination phases of “SCAR”.

The Analyst will also contribute to the drafting, editing and design of publications produced by the Index team.

Requisite Skills and Experience

Experience should include:

  • Bachelor’s or a Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as criminology, countering organized crime, international relations, or criminal justice.
  • Experience in investigations, analysis or research work on organized crime is desirable.
  • Ability to identify information gaps, research, synthesize information, develop analysis and write on tight timelines.
  • Experience in leveraging OSINT techniques as part of research.
  • Native or professional proficiency in spoken and written English, with additional language skills in an UN language a plus.
  • Motivated and enthusiastic to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • High degree of accuracy, detail orientation, and time management is essential

Personal Attributes

  • Operationally resilient: you are comfortable running operating with substantial autonomy.
  • Detailed oriented: you pay strong attention to detail, keep track of deadlines and ongoing task and are committed to accuracy and thoroughness in analysis.
  • A clear writer and communicator: you produce well-written reports/briefs/analytical insights, and are able to clearly communicate requirements and deadlines to consultants and stakeholders.
  • Collegiate: you work well as part of regional and global teams, drawing on the support of the core Index team.
  • Discreet and trustworthy: you exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.

Practical Assignment Requirement - to be uploaded with Application

Pick one of the two assignments below

Option A: Justification for Timor-Leste

Choose one criminal market or one criminal actor type, as defined in the Global Organized Crime Index methodology. Draft a full justification for it in Timor-Leste, covering the period 2025–2026. Your justification should assess the scale, nature and impact of the market or actor in the country during that period, supported by referenced evidence.

Option B: Analytical brief using Index data

Download the Global Organized Crime Index dataset and formulate a focused research question about organized crime that the data can help answer. Your question may centre on a single indicator, a small group of related indicators, or a region. Write an analytical brief of no more than 800 words that answers it, explaining the relationships, patterns or changes over time that you find. You are free to cut, combine and compare the data in whatever way best serves your question.

About Sharesource:

We are a BCorp company whose purpose is to democratise opportunities for individuals from developing countries. With our brand and culture empowering our partners to attract and keep the most qualified members, we share the knowledge to unleash potential and grow scaling teams for Australian and Canadian businesses.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a Senior Solutions Consultant who is responsible for leading client engagements, shaping solution designs, and ensuring that projects are scoped and documented to meet client requirements and organization's standards. This role combines client-facing consulting with technical solution expertise, acting as a trusted advisor while supporting the delivery of complex CRM migration and integration projects. The Senior Solutions Consultant plays a key role in ensuring that solutions are feasible, profitable, and aligned with best practices.

What are you expected to do?

  • Client Engagement & Discovery

    • Be the primary contact point for all project stakeholders, both internal and external.

    • Maintain current HubSpot product knowledge at all times in order to provide best in class guidance to teams and clients alike.

    • Lead client workshops and discovery sessions to gather requirements, define objectives, and scope solutions.

    • Collaborate with clients to document business needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

    • Present solution recommendations in a clear and professional manner, building trusted relationships with clients.

  • Solution Design & Documentation

    • Partner with Solutions Architects,designers and developers to createand validate technical solutions.

    • Develop and maintain detailed documentation including requirements, solution outlines and Statements of Work (SoWs).

    • Ensure all proposed solutions are deliverable, profitable, and aligned with Engaging.io's standards.

    • Identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve solution design.

  • Collaboration & Delivery Support

    • Work closely with delivery teams to ensure smooth handover from scoping into implementation.

    • Provide support during delivery to clarify requirements and maintain solution intent.

    • Contribute to the development of reusable templates, processes,and best practice assets.

  • Leadership & Mentoring

    • Provide guidance and mentorship to Solutions Consultants, sharing knowledge and expertise.

    • Act as a subject matter expert in client engagements, supporting complex scoping and design work.

    • Contribute to the ongoing improvement of consulting practices within the team.

You'll be a great fit if:

  • You have 4 to 5 years of demonstrable experience leading multiple complex CRM end-to-end migrations and integrations within the HubSpot ecosystem.
  • You possess well-developed project management skills and a sound understanding of project methodology and best practice.
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate trade-offs and recommend optimal approaches.
  • You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have a proven ability to build trusted client relationships and influence decision-making.
  • You have experience mentoring or coaching junior team members.
  • You are highly organised with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to prioritise and manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.

  • You show empathy and commitment to the values of the organisation.

What would success look like to you?

  • High-quality solution documentation and Statements of Work consistently delivered.

  • Positive client feedback on consulting expertise and solution recommendations.

  • Projects scoped accurately, contributing to profitable and successful delivery.

  • Effective collaboration across consulting, architecture, and delivery teams.

  • Demonstrated leadership and mentoring of junior consultants.

  • Active contribution to continuous improvement of consulting practices.

Here are the benefits of joining our team:

  • Generous remuneration with discretionary bonuses.

  • Work-from-home flexibility – choose the balance of home, office, or hybrid that works for you.

  • Workcation opportunities – extend your travels and work remotely from anywhere in the world.
  • A fun, trusting, and high-performance environment with colleagues who share our vision of doing good work with good people.

  • Recognition through Great Place to Work as one of Australia's best workplaces for 4 years in a row.

What you gain beyond the role:

  • Remote + Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—collaborative office days when it counts, balanced with the freedom to work from home.
  • Achieve Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Work in an environment where you're trusted and empowered to work independently, while still having the support you need to deliver your best. Here, flexibility isn't just a perk—it's how we help you perform at your best, without sacrificing life outside of work.

  • Open Culture: Your voice matters, we encourage proactive communication and fresh ideas.

  • Supportive Team: From your very first day to every career milestone, we've got your back—with long-term growth and projects you can truly thrive in.
  • Learn and Grow: Training, coaching, and international opportunities to level up your skills and career

  • Be part of a B-Corp company that puts people and planet first while creating meaningful impact.

Please note: This role is remote; however, we require candidates to be based locally in the Philippines. This is to support occasional onsite activities such as team events, client meetings, or equipment handover. Additionally, local residency is necessary for compliance with Philippines labor laws and employment regulations.

Why work for Sharesource?

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire hundreds of skillful individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, genders, and personalities to live out our diverse culture and make a positive impact on the world!

Our 5 Values:

  • Make a social impact: We balance our work for client teams and for society by constantly making a positive impact.

  • Be proactive: We encourage brave thinking and continuous improvement, and drive change through action.

  • Create value: We create measurable values for our stakeholders: our teams, partners, suppliers, investors, and communities.

  • Be fair, open and honest: We foster equality and inclusivity in a supportive environment that embraces diversity and celebrates achievements.

  • Add fun, passion and love: We priorities fun and passion, fostering higher engagement and a positive can-do attitude.

What to Expect in the Process

  • You'll go through 2-3 interviews plus a possible assessment with our client partner. This includes an initial chat, a culture-fit interview, and 1–2 conversations with our awesome client. The whole process usually takes 2-3 weeks, but we'll let you know if things need to move quicker.
  • Our best advice? Be yourself and enjoy the conversations. Well keep you updated every step of the way, and you're always welcome to reach out for updates anytime.
  • If all goes well, well complete reference checks and requirements quickly—so we can get that job offer to you without delay.

We would be grateful if you have these already:

  1. Fit to Work/Health Card (Basic 5 employment medical tests)

jobs.excerpt: This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline.
jobs.description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. Koniag IT Systems, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Middleware Engineer with a Secret security clearance to support KITS and our government customer. The position is remote. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. Koniag IT Systems, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Middleware Engineer to support a critical Government Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) initiative. This role supports a large-scale Application and Systems Enablement effort issued under an ICAM Enterprise Master IDIQ Contract. The Middleware Engineer will serve as a specialized technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and deploying custom middleware solutions, integration tools, connectors, and scripts that enable legacy and non-standard applications to integrate with the centralized ICAM technical stack—leveraging Okta for Identity Provider (IdP) services and SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) for Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)—in direct support of the Department of Defense (DoD) Zero Trust Execution Roadmap. The ideal candidate is a skilled software and integration engineer with deep experience in middleware development, API design, and enterprise application integration. This individual must be comfortable operating in a complex federal IT environment where applications span a wide spectrum of technical maturity—from modern cloud-native systems to deeply entrenched legacy codebases—and where custom engineering solutions are often required to bridge the gap between legacy identity mechanisms and modern ICAM capabilities. This position requires an active Secret clearance and may require occasional travel to Government facilities. Primary work will be performed remotely. The Middleware Engineer will serve as the primary technical expert for custom integration development within the ICAM enablement program, responsible for engineering bespoke middleware solutions that facilitate the onboarding of applications that cannot natively support modern identity protocols. This individual will work closely with migration engineers, the Okta/SailPoint platform engineer, the migration team lead, and application owners to analyze integration requirements, design appropriate technical solutions, and deliver production-ready middleware capabilities that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. The Middleware Engineer is expected to apply sound software engineering principles and federal security standards to all developed solutions while maintaining rigorous documentation and contributing to the broader enablement program. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom middleware solutions, integration proxies, protocol translators, and adapter components that enable legacy applications to authenticate and authorize through the ICAM technical stack when native protocol support is unavailable.
  • Engineer custom connectors, REST and SOAP APIs, scripts, and integration libraries that facilitate the connection of non-standard applications to Okta IdP and SailPoint IIQ, leveraging existing platform connectors where possible and developing bespoke solutions where they are not.
  • Analyze legacy application architectures, authentication mechanisms, and data flows to identify integration gaps and design technically sound middleware approaches that bridge proprietary or outdated identity systems with modern SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM-based ICAM capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain reusable integration libraries, sample code repositories, and middleware components that can be leveraged across multiple application enablement efforts to accelerate onboarding velocity and reduce duplicative engineering effort.
  • Collaborate with migration engineers to support the technical triage of assigned applications, providing middleware feasibility assessments and contributing to the documentation of integration pathways, risk registers, and gap analyses in the Enablement Tracking Database.
  • Provide technical guidance and engineering support to Application Owners who are undertaking their own integration efforts, including advising on middleware architecture, providing sample code for common integration patterns, and troubleshooting application-side integration failures.
  • Support the design and implementation of automated provisioning and deprovisioning workflows, including the development of SCIM endpoints, directory synchronization scripts, and lifecycle management hooks for applications that require custom provisioning solutions.
  • Develop and implement solutions that support the configuration of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) frameworks within target applications, including the development of attribute mapping logic, claims transformation middleware, and authorization policy enforcement components.
  • Participate in the engineering and development of self-service and automated enablement pathway tooling, contributing reusable middleware components and integration accelerators that simplify the onboarding process for application owners navigating the enablement pipeline independently.
  • Conduct rigorous unit testing, integration testing, and security testing of all developed middleware solutions prior to deployment, ensuring solutions are functionally correct, secure, and compliant with applicable DoD standards.
  • Support the testing program by contributing to test plan development, executing technical integration tests, providing sample code and reusable libraries for UAT events, and assisting with defect diagnosis and resolution for middleware-related integration failures.
  • Ensure all developed middleware, connectors, scripts, and custom tools comply with applicable supply chain risk management requirements per DFARS 239.73, including vetting all third-party code libraries and dependencies to prevent the introduction of cybersecurity vulnerabilities, malicious code, or unauthorized data exfiltration pathways.
  • Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for all developed middleware solutions, including architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, API specifications, deployment guides, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of middleware engineering standards, coding best practices, reusable component libraries, and integration playbooks that drive consistency and quality across the application portfolio.
  • Ensure all developed solutions comply with Section 508 accessibility standards and applicable DoD security requirements, including CUI handling, OPSEC, and DFARS 252.204-7012.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving middleware technologies, identity integration patterns, and DoD Zero Trust requirements, proactively applying this knowledge to improve the quality and capability of developed solutions.

Education and Experience:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on software or systems engineering experience, with at least 3 years of direct experience in middleware development, API engineering, or enterprise application integration.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and developing custom integration solutions, including REST APIs, SOAP web services, protocol adapters, or middleware components in a production enterprise environment.
  • Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity platforms using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, or SCIM.
  • Active Secret clearance. Must be able to satisfy requirements for CAC-card issuance and NIPRNet access, including annual DoD CyberAwareness training and certification.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience supporting DoD IT programs, particularly within an ICAM, cybersecurity, or Zero Trust context.
  • Experience working in a federal government IT contracting environment.
  • Experience developing middleware solutions specifically for legacy application modernization or enterprise identity migration programs.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in enterprise middleware and integration development, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, Node.js, C#, or PowerShell.
  • Hands-on experience developing and consuming REST APIs and SOAP web services, including API design, versioning, authentication, and error handling best practices.
  • Working knowledge and practical implementation experience with SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM identity and authorization protocols, including the ability to develop custom protocol handlers, token transformation logic, and claims mapping components.
  • Experience analyzing and reverse-engineering legacy application authentication and authorization mechanisms to design compatible middleware integration approaches.
  • Familiarity with enterprise Identity Provider (IdP) platforms, particularly Okta, and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms, particularly SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ), including their integration APIs and connector frameworks.
  • Experience developing and working with directory services integration, including LDAP, Active Directory, and SCIM-based directory synchronization.
  • Proficiency with source code version control systems such as Git, including branching strategies, code review processes, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience implementing secure coding practices, including input validation, secrets management, least-privilege access, and vulnerability mitigation in developed middleware solutions.
  • Ability to conduct unit testing, integration testing, and security-focused code reviews of developed solutions, ensuring quality and compliance prior to deployment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex legacy application architectures and design pragmatic, technically sound middleware integration solutions.
  • Strong technical documentation skills, including the ability to produce clear and comprehensive architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, API specifications, and operational runbooks.
  • Familiarity with DoD security requirements, including CUI handling, OPSEC, DFARS 252.204-7012, DFARS 239.73 supply chain risk management, and DoDM 8140.03 cybersecurity certification requirements.
  • Strong communication skills in English—both written and oral—with the ability to clearly explain middleware architecture and integration approaches to both technical peers and non-technical application owners.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative cross-functional team.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required DoD cybersecurity certifications per DoDM 8140.03 (e.g., Security+ for IAT II or equivalent).

Clearance Requirement:

  • Secret clearance

Desired Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience with enterprise service bus (ESB) platforms, integration platforms as a service (iPaaS), or API gateway technologies such as MuleSoft, Apache Camel, Kong, or AWS API Gateway.
  • Experience developing middleware solutions specifically for identity protocol translation, including building SAML service providers, OAuth authorization servers, or OIDC relying party components.
  • Familiarity with containerization and container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, including the deployment and management of containerized middleware components.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline development and automation tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps for automated build, test, and deployment of middleware solutions.
  • Okta Certified Developer certification or demonstrated advanced proficiency with the Okta platform APIs and integration frameworks.
  • SailPoint IdentityIQ developer experience, including custom connector development using the SailPoint connector framework and BeanShell scripting.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) principles and their practical application to middleware and integration engineering within a DoD context.
  • Experience developing SCIM 2.0 compliant endpoints and providers for automated identity provisioning and synchronization.
  • Familiarity with claims-based identity concepts, including claims transformation, attribute mapping, and token enrichment in federated identity environments.
  • Experience with enterprise application portfolio migrations or large-scale IT modernization programs in a federal defense environment.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), CompTIA Security+, or related cybersecurity certification.
  • Familiarity with Section 508 compliance requirements for electronic and information technology.
  • Experience with CDRL deliverable contribution and technical documentation requirements in a federal contracting environment.
  • Familiarity with Agile and hybrid Agile-Waterfall program execution methodologies, including experience working in sprint-based development cycles.
  • Experience developing reusable code libraries and integration accelerators in support of large-scale, repeatable application onboarding or migration programs.

Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. We work to comply with our company standards, exceed customer expectations, and drive our Great Place to Work culture. We deliver high-quality services aligned to business needs, driving innovative improvements that support our company strategy and modern operating principles.

We are seeking a Director, Consumer Digital Experience to join the Credit Acceptance marketing team, reporting to the VP of Marketing. Credit Acceptance helps people with credit challenges buy a vehicle and build a stronger financial future. This leader owns the vision for the consumer digital experience across every surface and every stage of that journey — our website, mobile app and web portal — from the first moment someone wonders whether a car is possible, through the purchase, and across the life of the loan.
This is where our emerging consumer value proposition will live. The Digital Vehicle Marketplace — giving consumers the ability to shop for and purchase a vehicle online from a Credit Acceptance dealer — is the future of the company, and it will be delivered through these surfaces. This role owns all of them: the website, the app, the portal and payments, the experience standard that holds them together, and a single prioritized roadmap that decides what gets built and when.
This leader is expected to define the destination state for the consumer digital experience — what it should become over the next several years — and then sequence the work that gets us there. The leaders of Consumer Acquisition and Customer Loyalty & Retention are this role’s closest partners: they bring the business opportunity and the target, and this role is accountable for the experience that delivers it. Success requires someone who moves fluidly between long-range vision and shipping product, and who makes prioritization decisions transparently when demand exceeds capacity.

Outcomes and Activities:

  • This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to our Southfield, Michigan office may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at our Southfield, Michigan office if requested by the team member.
  • Define the destination state for the consumer digital experience and the multi-year path to reach it, and own a single prioritized roadmap across website, mobile app, web portal and payments — directly accountable for digital engagement, collection rate and cost to serve.
  • Set and enforce the experience standard across surfaces so the website, app and portal work as one brand to the customer, regardless of how we are organized internally.
  • Partner with Consumer Acquisition and Customer Loyalty & Retention to translate business opportunities into digital experiences, and sequence competing roadmap demand on value and capacity while making the tradeoffs explicit.
  • Own the website experience that earns the purchase — conversion rate optimization, prequalification, dealer finder and marketplace surfaces, lead capture and dealer matching.
  • Own the app and portal experience that owns the relationship — self-service, benefits delivery, progress and next-loan re-entry, and the work with Servicing to reduce assisted contacts.
  • Own end-to-end digital payments — the payment methods and channels we offer, how payments are processed, retried and recovered, governance and compliance, and the processor, card network and financial institution relationships behind them.
  • Build the shared foundations the roadmap depends on — one login and customer profile across surfaces, notifications, personalization and marketing technology integration — in partnership with Engineering.
  • Define the success measure and expected value for each initiative with the business owner, own the release date and build plan, and hold the team to measured movement rather than delivery milestones.
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing product, design and digital team across payments, app and portal, website and experience design.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Digital Product Leadership: Proven ownership of consumer-facing web and mobile product surfaces — able to define a multi-year destination and break it into work that ships, without losing the through-line.
  • Payments & Self-Service: Working command of digital payment methods and processing, servicing workflows, vendor and processor management, and the economics of reducing assisted contacts.
  • Conversion & Experimentation: Fluent in funnel instrumentation, testing and conversion rate optimization; sets the test agenda and ships winners rather than debating opinions.
  • Prioritization Under Constraint: Able to weigh competing demand from multiple internal partners with a transparent, value-based method, and to hold a sequence once it is set.
  • Quantitative & Insights-Driven: Comfortable with napkin math and sizing opportunities, and draws sharp, metrics-driven implications from qualitative and quantitative data alike.
  • Executive Communication: Confident, polished communicator able to present and influence at the executive level.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds strong partnerships across marketing, product, engineering, servicing, analytics and compliance to deliver shared outcomes.
  • Team Leadership: Builds and develops a high-performing team across more than one product surface, with genuine commitment to treating customers well.

  • Proven track record owning consumer-facing website and mobile app experiences and the business outcomes they drive.
  • Experience leading product managers and designers across more than one product surface.
  • Experience owning or heavily influencing budget/investment decisions for a function or program area.
  • Experience running an experimentation program and using quantitative and qualitative data to inform strategy and measure impact.
  • Experience managing engineering, design and vendor partners to deliver a roadmap on a committed cadence.

Remote Opportunity | US Client

We are looking for a reliable, highly organized, and personable Administrative & Staffing Support Coordinator to support the Recruiting/HR and Intake teams of a growing US-based healthcare services organization.

You will work closely with internal team members, employees, applicants, clients, and families, helping to coordinate staffing and intake activities while providing professional and responsive administrative support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Recruiting/HR and Intake teams.

  • Assist with scheduling and coordinating appointments, meetings, interviews, and other activities.
